Job Title: Investment Funds & Asset Management Attorney

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking experienced Investment Funds & Asset Management Attorneys to contribute specialized legal expertise to an AI training project. The role involves analyzing fund-related legal documents, evaluating regulatory requirements, and reviewing AI-generated content to ensure accuracy and alignment with current industry standards. Prior AI experience is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Analyze and annotate legal documents related to investment funds, asset management, and securities regulation.
  2. Develop realistic legal questions, scenarios, and case studies covering fund formation, compliance, and investor relations.
  3. Review and validate AI-generated legal content for accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  4. Research and summarize developments in global fund structures, SEC regulations, and private equity, hedge fund, and mutual fund markets.
  5. Provide detailed feedback on complex legal concepts, risk management, and asset management best practices.
  6. Collaborate remotely with project teams and communicate findings clearly across all deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active bar membership in good standing.
  2. Recent, substantial experience advising on investment funds and asset management matters.
  3. Strong knowledge of U.S. and international securities laws, fund governance, and compliance requirements.
  4. Experience drafting and reviewing offering memoranda, subscription agreements, and regulatory filings.
  5. Excellent legal research, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  6. Familiarity with fintech and AI applications in financial services is an advantage but not required.
  7. Strong attention to detail, commitment to accuracy, and ability to stay current with regulatory and industry developments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A detail-oriented legal professional with extensive investment funds and asset management expertise, strong regulatory knowledge, and the ability to deliver clear, accurate, and well-supported legal analysis for technology-driven projects.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.excerpt: As a Forward Deployed Engineer, R&D AI Services, you embed directly with product development teams to understand real business problems and work out the right way to solve them with AI: reusing and extending an existing AI service, or — when nothing suitable exists — scoping the requirements and working with the engineering team to build one.
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, R&D AI Services, you embed directly with product development teams to understand real business problems and work out the right way to solve them with AI: reusing and extending an existing AI service, or — when nothing suitable exists — scoping the requirements and working with the engineering team to build one. You are the bridge between a product team's business flow and a working AI capability: you know the AI service catalogue well enough to match the right service to the problem, you help teams build AI-first applications on top of it, and when a gap exists, you make sure the right thing gets built to close it.

This is a high-agency role for a hands-on senior engineer who is as comfortable in a stakeholder conversation about a business process as they are building and shipping the data pipeline or model-serving system behind it.

What you'll do

  • Embed directly with product teams (your internal customers) to understand their business flows and work out where AI genuinely helps

  • Lead technical discovery: separate the actual bottleneck in a business process from the symptom the product team came to you with
  • Know the existing catalogue of AI services well enough to spot where one could be applied or extended to solve a product team's problem, and help them design and build AI-first applications on top of it
  • Where no existing service fits, gather and document the requirements yourself, then partner with the engineering team responsible for AI services to scope, design, and build the new service — you're hands-on throughout, not just handing off a ticket
  • Get hands-on with the data pipelines, model training and serving, and MLOps tooling behind both new and existing AI services, plus the integrations that connect them into product workflows
  • Ship a working first version fast, then harden it: proper monitoring, feedback loops from real usage, and production-grade reliability
  • Translate product team pain points and business requirements into actionable input for the AI services roadmap
  • Work directly with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering leads — going deep into the data and code while communicating trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Be the connective tissue between IFS R&D's AI capability and the product teams consuming it — your field insights shape what gets built next

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong hands-on capability building and deploying production systems and the ability to work across an unfamiliar stack when needed.
    • Languages: Strong Python, with the ability and willingness to work across other languages and existing customer codebases.
    • Cloud & Kubernetes: Experience building and operating cloud-native services. Azure experience - particularly AKS, Blob Storage, Key Vault, and Azure-hosted AI/model services - is highly relevant.
    • AI & LLM Integration: Experience integrating LLMs and AI services into production applications, including model APIs, authentication, gateways, reliability, latency, cost, and observability.
    • Agentic Systems: Experience building agentic applications using tools, APIs, and orchestration frameworks. Hands-on MCP experience is strongly preferred.
    • Retrieval & RAG: Hands-on experience designing production RAG and retrieval systems, including embeddings, vector databases, indexing, retrieval quality, and evaluation.
    • APIs & Enterprise Integration: Strong experience with REST APIs, authentication/authorization, external systems, data contracts, and debugging complex integrations.
    • Deployment & IaC: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD, and Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling.
    • Data & Storage: Comfortable working with data pipelines and across relational, document, vector, and object stores as required by the solution.
  • Solid understanding of event-driven and distributed systems architecture, applied pragmatically in delivery contexts rather than academically
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, failure modes, and the trade-offs between quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Experience building and owning production ML/data systems (not just notebooks or prototypes),
  • You thrive in ambiguity - you can turn "this business flow feels like it needs AI" into a scoped, shipped system without waiting to be told exactly what to build
  • You communicate well with non-technical stakeholders without dumbing down the substance
  • Experience working in or alongside platform or infrastructure teams
  • Able to work directly with customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguous business problems into technical solutions, rapidly prototype, and then productionize those solutions.

We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Reports can be submitted through the application at , available on the website .

At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.

This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of modern AI engineering, building intelligent products that combine Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI and cloud-native technologies to solve complex, real-world business challenges at enterprise scale.

We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building production AI systems and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software.

Candidates whose AI experience is limited to using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to assist software development, without demonstrable experience building AI-powered products or systems, will not meet the requirements for this role.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.

At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.

We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.

We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

This position requires expert-level programming and system design capabilities, ownership of end-to-end project delivery, and a commitment to software development best practices.


You will lead technical initiatives, guide and mentor team members, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape engineering standards while working across cross-functional teams.   • Lead incident response reviews and effectively communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Support team delivery by helping prioritize work, unblock teammates, and ensure commitments are met with quality and timeliness.

About You

  • Extensive experience designing, building, and delivering complex software systems.
  • Strong expertise in software engineering, system design, and modern development practices.
  • Experience with Golang, Python, and related development ecosystems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical projects and influence outcomes across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and develop effective solutions.
  • Deep understanding of software development best practices, including testing, automation, code quality, and architecture.
  • Experience mentoring and developing engineers at various levels.

  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to align technical decisions with business objectives and organizational goals.
  • A growth mindset with the ability to learn new technologies, frameworks, and domains independently.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits

  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • RRSP contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Family-forming benefits, enhanced maternity benefits, and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.


Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 75,000 to 246,000 CAD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: SDR Director
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreKLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

KLDiscovery is a leading global provider of best-in-class eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery solutions, serving AmLaw 100 firms, Fortune 500 corporations, and government agencies. Our technology-enabled services and software help these law firms, corporations and agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula and RelOne platforms deliver SaaS-based legal technology underpinned by managed services and professional services. The company, with offices in 26 locations across 17 countries helps clients with their litigation, regulatory compliance, internal investigation and data recovery and management needs all around the world.

Serving clients for over 30 years, KLDiscovery offers data collection and forensic investigation, early case assessment, electronic discovery and data processing, application software and data hosting for web-based document reviews, and managed document review services. In addition, through its global Ontrack Data Recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction and tape management.

KLDiscovery has been recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in North America by both Inc. Magazine (Inc. 5000) and Deloitte (Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500.Additionally, KLDiscovery is an Orange-level Relativity Best in Service Partner, a Relativity Premium Hosting Partner and Relativity’s 1st Service Provider partner, and maintains ISO/IEC 27001 Certified data centers.

The Director, Sales Development owns KLDiscovery's sales development function end-to-end, leading the Manager(s), Sales Development who in turn lead the Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) serving as the first point of engagement for new eDiscovery opportunities. Demand is driven by triggering legal events and existing relationships, but it also requires a disciplined, scalable top-of-funnel motion to expand current client relationships and win new ones across segments. The Director designs, builds, and scales that motion — and the managers who run it — so Account Executives and strategic sellers can focus on the highest-value conversations.

This is a strategic leadership role for a results-oriented sales leader who builds leaders as deliberately as they build pipeline. Within Revenue Operations, the Director owns SDR strategy, forecasting, and performance reporting across segments, and sets the standards that Sales Operations and the Manager(s), Sales Development execute against.

The Director, Sales Development is accountable for:

  • Achieving and exceeding team and segment pipeline targets

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with Sales, Client Solutions, and Revenue Operations leadership

  • Maximizing team performance, motivation, and retention across the sales development organization, and building team depth so results do not depend on a few individual managers or reps

  • Upholding performance and quality standards in line with best practice, procedures, and priorities, including MEDDPICC-based qualification discipline

  • Owning the sales development team budget

  • Promoting the KLDiscovery values and value proposition

How This Role Fits

KLD’s revenue team works as one connected chain: Sales Development opens and qualifies opportunities, Account Executives convert them, Sales Directors lead and inspect the segment, and Client Solutions and Client Success carry clients through delivery and expansion. Qualification follows MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology, Salesforce is the system of record, and territory and account ownership follow KLD’s rules of engagement.

The Director, Sales Development owns the first link end-to-end: setting the strategy, standards, and management structure that generate and qualify opportunities to the MEDDPICC standard so Account Executives receive pipeline they can convert, across every segment the function serves.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Hire, develop, and retain Sales Development Managers. Build a high-performing leadership bench through structured onboarding, clear performance expectations, and a defined path to senior sales leadership roles.

  • Coach managers to a consistent standard. Lead regular one-on-ones with the Manager(s), Sales Development and periodically audit call and email reviews to ensure consistent application of MEDDPICC and Challenger methodology across teams.

  • Set and manage performance standards across the function. Define quota, activity, and quality expectations for managers and their teams; measure results across segments; and hold managers accountable for addressing under-performance promptly and directly.

  • Build team depth. Develop the manager bench and plan succession for key leadership roles so sales development results are not concentrated in a small number of teams.

Drive Pipeline

  • Own demand-trigger strategy. Ensure managers and their teams track HSR second requests, major litigation filings, and regulatory investigations, and refine KLD’s capture framework based on what converts.

  • Own qualification standards enterprise-wide. Require every opportunity across every segment to meet MEDDPICC criteria before handoff to an Account Executive, protecting pipeline coverage accuracy at scale.

  • Expand named accounts and the installed base across segments. Within territory rules of engagement, direct managers and their teams to multi-thread stakeholders (General Counsel’s office, litigation support, procurement) and to surface Nebula and AI Case Explorer attach opportunities with Sales and Client Solutions.

  • Own law firm channel strategy. Set the strategy for engagement with firms eligible for KLD’s matter demand-generation incentive programs, track participation across the portfolio, and surface referral-ready relationships to senior sales leadership.

Forecasting, Reporting, and Process Ownership

  • Forecast SDR-sourced pipeline across segments. Consolidate forecasts of meetings, qualified opportunities, and expected conversion from each manager; flag gaps early to the VP, Revenue Operations and Sales Leadership; and own corrective action.

  • Report on function performance. Partner with Sales Operations on Salesforce dashboards covering activity, stage conversion, handoff acceptance, qualification quality, and sourced pipeline across every segment, and present insights and recommendations to senior sales leadership in recurring business reviews.

  • Own SDR strategy and process. Partner with Sales Operations on lead routing, handoff criteria, SLAs with Account Executives, qualification standards, and territory rules. Own the SDR playbook, direct managers' adherence audits, and refine the playbook based on performance data.

  • Uphold data quality and drive change. Partner with Sales Operations to set CRM hygiene standards enterprise-wide, direct managers to audit adherence, roll out workflow and tooling changes (Salesforce, ZoomInfo, engagement platforms), and use conversion data to inform quotas, territories, and headcount planning across the function.

  • Partner across functions and influence senior stakeholders. Work with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Regional Sales Leadership, Account Executives, Client Solutions, and Marketing leadership on coverage, handoff, feedback loops, and campaigns, representing the sales development function in cross-functional and executive planning.

  • Own the team budget. Plan, manage, and track spend against approved targets for the sales development function.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every team, across every segment, consistently delivers pipeline and closed-won opportunities

  • MEDDPICC-qualification rate and handoff acceptance at or above 80% enterprise-wide, not just meeting volume

  • Growth in multi-threaded contacts and documented Nebula / AI Case Explorer attach opportunities

  • Tracked, active law firm relationships in matter demand-generation programs

  • Consolidated SDR forecast accuracy within ±10% across all segments, with timely, accurate reporting and CRM data quality at 90% completeness on required fields

  • A fully staffed, well-ramped sales development organization — managers and SDRs alike — with strong engagement, low attrition, and clear progression into Account Executive, management, and other senior roles

  • Spend within the approved team budget

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of sales development, business development, or sales experience, including 5+ years managing people managers or leading multiple quota-carrying teams

  • Proven record of meeting or exceeding pipeline and team targets across multiple teams or segments, and of hiring, developing, and retaining both individual contributors and managers

  • Experience building forecasts and performance reports from Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) and defining and enforcing sales processes such as lead routing and handoffs across multiple teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage and influence legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate litigation, regulatory, and M&A signals into organizational strategy

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

  • Experience building or scaling a sales development organization across multiple teams or segments, including structure, hiring plan, processes, metrics, and onboarding

  • Background in legal technology, eDiscovery, or complex B2B/enterprise software, including exposure to corporate legal departments or law firms

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and/or Challenger Sale, with experience coaching managers and sellers to apply them at scale

  • Experience in or alongside Revenue Operations or Sales Operations, with dashboarding skills and signal-based prospecting or sales engagement tools

MBA, JD, or equivalent qualification

Our Mission & Values

Our Mission: We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

These four values guide how we operate, make decisions, and work together every day.

  • Client is Always in the Room - We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

  • Own the Outcome - We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients, and each other.

  • Better Every Day - We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

  • Deliver Results Together - We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

KLDiscovery is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, discipline, and termination. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications, skills, and experience.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING FOR KLD (ALL LOCATIONS)

At KLD, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that when our employees feel supported, valued, and empowered, they can thrive both personally and professionally. That’s why we’re committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive workplace where you can grow your career, make meaningful contributions, and enjoy a healthy work-life balance.

Our competitive benefits and programs are designed to support your well-being and success. Depending on your location, these may include comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement and financial programs, paid time off and leave options, employee assistance resources, and professional development opportunities.

We also embrace flexibility, offering remote work opportunities for most employees to support work-life balance while keeping our teams connected and collaborative. Certain roles may require an office-based or hybrid schedule based on business and operational needs.

Wherever you’re located, you’ll be part of a global team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and celebrates your success.

Benefits and eligibility vary by country, location, employment status, and applicable plan or program requirements.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release)

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)

  • Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM)

  • Nanoparticle Sizing

  • Particle Size Distribution

  • Quality Control

  • Lot Release

  • Nanomaterials

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The engagement emphasizes independent expert analysis - including manual image thresholding, calibration, and morphology assessments - without reliance on automated or AI-powered tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to document findings, interpret complex micrographs, and convey critical decisions to project stakeholders.

Scope of Work:

  • Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment

  • Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility

  • Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards

  • Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification

  • Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data

  • Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria

  • Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation

  • Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies

  • Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration

  • Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools

  • Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus

Responsibilities

Sargent & Lundy is seeking a Project Manager with direct E-STATCOM or STATCOM project experience to lead utility-scale power-system projects from initiation and planning through engineering, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and closeout. The Project Manager will coordinate multidisciplinary engineering and project teams, the client, equipment suppliers, contractors, and other stakeholders to deliver the agreed scope safely and in accordance with contract requirements, schedule, budget, quality expectations, and applicable utility requirements.

This role combines the PMO’s core project-management responsibilities—integrated planning, client and contractor interface, cost and schedule control, forecasting, change management, reporting, and project closeout—with the coordination demands of a technically complex power-electronics installation. The Project Manager is accountable for project execution and coordination, while technical design authority remains with the assigned engineering leads and discipline-of-record personnel. Responsible for project execution, contract administration, planning and resource management.

  • Lead project initiation, integrated planning, execution, monitoring, change control, and closeout in accordance with PMO processes and client requirements.
  • Establish and maintain the project execution plan, scope baseline, work breakdown, schedule, budget, staffing plan, communications plan, risk register, and decision/action logs.
  • Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, project controls, quality, safety, and client activities; clarify ownership, interfaces, deliverables, and decision paths.
  • Lead project meetings, document decisions and action items, communicate status, and escalate material scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, or resource issues promptly.
  • Maintain effective client relationships and serve as a primary point of coordination for project matters.
  • Coordinate project delivery across the relevant stages, which may include requirements and scope definition; design and engineering; equipment specification and supplier coordination; manufacturing and factory testing; site preparation and construction; installation; site testing; commissioning; training; and transition to commercial operation.
  • Coordinate interfaces among the STATCOM supplier, utility/client teams, substation engineering, protection and control, civil/structural, electrical, telecommunications/SCADA, planning, operations, maintenance, construction, and commissioning teams, as applicable to the project.
  • Track technical and execution interfaces, assumptions, deliverables, reviews, approvals, and dependencies. Ensure issues are assigned to the appropriate technical owner and resolved or escalated in time to protect project milestones.
  • Coordinate vendor submittals, technical reviews, requests for information, equipment and material status, factory and site test plans, testing schedules, commissioning readiness, and punch-list resolution.
  • Support outage and site-access planning with the client and project team when required; coordinate field activities and project walkdowns in accordance with site and client requirements.

This is project-interface familiarity, not a requirement to serve as the technical design authority.

jobs.title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer
jobs.excerpt: ROLEWe need someone who thinks about the click before they think about the font.
jobs.description:
ROLE

We need someone who thinks about the click before they think about the font.

Someone who studies YouTube because they’re fascinated by what makes people stop scrolling. Who notices when a small channel breaks through, dissects the packaging, and can explain why it worked.

Your role is to turn video topics into thumbnails that make the right viewer curious enough to watch.

Our clients are health professionals and experts. Your work needs to capture attention while protecting their credibility. That requires audience psychology, strong creative judgment, excellent visual taste, and the ability to use AI to bring ideas to life.

Before opening a design tool, you should be asking:

  • Who is this video for, and what do they already care about?
  • What problem, desire, fear, or unanswered question makes this topic compelling?
  • What should the viewer understand or feel in the first second?
  • How do the title and thumbnail work together?
  • Does the video deliver on the expectation we’re creating?

Colors, fonts, and layout serve the idea. They cannot rescue a weak one.

We have existing systems, references, and frameworks. You’ll use them to move efficiently, while recognizing when a concept needs a different approach.

You will own thumbnail concept development and execution, contribute to title discussions, and use performance feedback to improve future work.

Great packaging creates tension.

It introduces a contradiction, an unexpected consequence, or a gap between what viewers believe and what they’re about to discover.

The viewer should understand enough to care, while feeling that something important is unresolved.

Your job is to find that tension in the content and make it immediately visible through the title and thumbnail. It must be grounded in what the video actually delivers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop the concept

  • Review the video brief, script, or footage to identify its strongest truthful hook.
  • Develop distinct thumbnail concepts based on the audience’s motivations and the video’s actual content.
  • Pair thumbnails with titles so they build curiosity together, without simply repeating the same words.
  • Explain your creative choices in terms of viewer psychology and the intended click.
  • Flag weak or unclear packaging and propose a stronger direction.
  • Identify the strongest source of tension in the video: a surprising truth, a mistaken assumption, conflicting desires, or an unexpected consequence.
  • Build title and thumbnail combinations that make that tension clear without resolving the question before the viewer clicks.

Execute with excellent taste

  • Create thumbnails with a clear focal point, strong visual hierarchy, and immediate readability at mobile size.
  • Choose facial expressions, imagery, and text that support the concept.
  • Make clients look natural, credible, and recognizable.
  • Remove unnecessary elements that compete for attention.
  • Produce meaningful variations that test different ideas, rather than minor changes to colors or fonts.

Use AI skillfully

  • Use AI image generation and editing tools to create, composite, and refine visual assets.
  • Direct and iterate on outputs until they meet the creative brief.
  • Preserve likeness and correct unnatural expressions, anatomy, lighting, and other artifacts.
  • Combine AI with manual editing when needed to achieve a convincing final result.
  • Evaluate new tools and incorporate those that improve quality or speed.

Learn from performance

  • Review thumbnail and video performance with the content team.
  • Interpret CTR alongside traffic source, impressions, audience, and viewing behavior.
  • Recommend tests or replacements when the evidence suggests the packaging could improve.
  • Track what was tested, what happened, and what should inform the next round.
  • Study relevant channels and breakout videos to identify useful patterns without blindly copying them.

Deliver reliably

  • Meet production deadlines and maintain organized source files and versions.
  • Collaborate with scriptwriters, editors, and account managers.
  • The secret code is "instinct"
  • Apply feedback consistently so the same issues do not keep returning.

RESULTS

Success in this role means:

  • Stronger concepts: Thumbnails communicate a clear, compelling reason for the intended viewer to click.
  • Better packaging performance: Testing and iteration improve results against relevant channel baselines over time.
  • An accurate promise: The thumbnail attracts viewers with an expectation the video can fulfill.
  • Excellent execution: Final assets are readable, polished, credible, and free of visible AI artifacts.
  • Reliable production: Assets arrive on time, with fewer avoidable revisions as you learn our standards.
  • Compounding learning: Insights from each client’s performance inform future creative decisions.

CTR matters, but a single percentage does not tell the whole story. We expect you to understand the context behind the numbers and distinguish what you can influence from what you cannot.

REQUIREMENTS

Deep YouTube fluency

You actively watch and study YouTube. You can discuss specific channels, thumbnail approaches, title pairings, and breakout videos, including why you believe they worked.

A demonstrated YouTube track record

You have created thumbnails for published YouTube videos and can show examples of your work in context.

You can explain your contribution, the reasoning behind your choices, and available performance results. If you claim an improvement, you can explain the baseline and what else changed.

Strong audience psychology

You understand how curiosity, emotional relevance, and tension work together to earn attention.

You can recognize when packaging simply labels a topic and turn it into a compelling, unresolved question in the viewer’s mind. You know how to do this without relying on vague teasers, exaggerated claims, or manufactured drama.

Excellent visual taste

You have strong judgment around faces, expressions, composition, contrast, typography, and realism.

You can recognize when something feels awkward, cluttered, generic, or untrustworthy, and know how to fix it.

Practical AI fluency

You already use AI image tools in your workflow and can show how you direct, refine, and finish their outputs.

We care about the quality of your judgment and results, beyond familiarity with a particular tool.

Ownership and speed

You can develop ideas, make decisions, meet deadlines, and incorporate feedback without needing someone to art-direct every detail.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

  • Your portfolio is primarily general graphic design, with little relevant YouTube work.
  • Your explanation of a thumbnail starts and ends with colors, fonts, or brand consistency.
  • You need every concept supplied before you can begin.
  • You accept AI outputs without critically reviewing and refining them.
  • You resist changing a design when evidence suggests a stronger direction.
Salary: $4500-6k USD/mo

Working closely with the Development Manager and a collaborative development team, you will turn complex legacy applications into modern, reliable solutions, influence technical decisions, and help guide the work from initial design through delivery.

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States, working 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern time.

What’s in it for you

Ownership from the start. You will join at the early stages of replatforming established financial applications, helping shape the architecture and design of the new system. As a technical lead on the project, you will influence key decisions, guide other developers, and see your ideas take shape in a modern platform.

Meaningful technical challenges. You will take on the complexity of transforming legacy applications that customers rely on, using modern .NET technologies and cloud-hosted environments. You will tackle architectural challenges, improve performance and maintainability, and help establish technical standards for the evolving platform. You will see the impact of your work as established applications become more modern, reliable, and scalable.

Explore emerging technologies. You will join a team that actively encourages and supports the use of AI-assisted development tools. Whether you already use these tools or want to gain experience, you will have the opportunity to experiment, build practical skills, and explore how AI can improve coding, testing, and problem-solving.

How you will make an impact

  • Lead the replatforming effort. You will take a technical lead role in modernizing our financial software, helping transform legacy applications into a modern, integrated platform. Starting with an established financial module, you will work with the team to translate existing functionality into new solutions, improve the user experience, and build a foundation for modernizing additional modules.
  • Own back-end architecture and development. You will define service structures, API contracts, and data-access patterns for assigned products, working closely with the Development Manager on technical direction. You will design, build, and maintain web applications and RESTful APIs using C# and modern .NET technologies, making thoughtful architectural decisions that support security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build connected, reliable solutions. You will collaborate closely with our database and front-end developers to ensure the application, database, and front-end layers work together effectively. You will develop and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures, contribute to Angular functionality as needed, and troubleshoot complex issues across the application stack.
  • Drive development and delivery. You will work with Product Management to turn requirements and the product roadmap into technical plans, development tasks, and realistic estimates. You will contribute throughout the agile development lifecycle, from design and coding to testing, deployment, and ongoing support, documenting key technical decisions and ensuring the team has the information needed to maintain and evolve the platform.
  • Guide technical practices. You will provide technical direction to developers and contractors through design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. You will help establish consistent coding and design standards, strengthen development practices, and support the delivery of reliable, maintainable software across the team.
  • Explore AI-assisted development. You will incorporate AI-assisted tools into your development workflow where they add value, exploring ways to improve coding, testing, troubleshooting, and productivity. You will share insights and practical approaches with colleagues as the team continues to learn and evolve how it uses these technologies.

You bring

  • The .NET expertise. You have strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining web applications and RESTful APIs using C# and .NET/.NET Core. You understand object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and established design patterns, and can apply them to build secure, reliable, and maintainable applications.
  • The architectural experience. You have experience designing back-end systems and making technical decisions about service structures, APIs, and data access. You can evaluate different approaches, explain technical trade-offs, and translate requirements into practical solutions. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex development work and providing technical guidance to other developers.
  • The full-stack capabilities. Your primary strength is back-end development, complemented by working knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. You can develop and maintain front-end functionality, integrate applications with APIs, and investigate issues across the application stack without needing to be a front-end specialist.
  • The database skills. You have experience working with SQL Server, T-SQL, stored procedures, and relational database design. You understand how to optimize queries and work with data-access technologies such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper to support application performance and reliability.
  • The problem-solving approach. You have worked with complex, established applications and can understand existing functionality, troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities for modernization and improvement. You bring experience with automated testing, code reviews, and cloud technologies such as Azure or AWS. Exposure to legacy migrations, microservices, or financial software would be valuable.
  • The adaptability and curiosity. You are comfortable learning new technologies and exploring tools that improve how software is developed. You may have experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor, or you are interested in building those skills. Familiarity with development and DevOps tools such as Git and Azure DevOps is an asset.
  • The collaboration. You communicate technical ideas clearly, work effectively with product stakeholders and distributed development teams, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others. You are comfortable balancing development with technical guidance and bring curiosity and a willingness to learn, experiment, and incorporate emerging tools into your work.

Join us.

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role, the team’s culture and your experience. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • A virtual technical interview with the Development Manager and members of the technical team, focused on your .NET development experience, architectural decision-making, problem-solving approach, and ability to evaluate technical trade-offs. The conversation may include practical technical questions and scenarios to understand how you approach solutions.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

Market Access - Group Copy Supervisor

Avalere Health is seeking a high-performing, intellectually curious Group Copy Supervisor to join our US Market Access practice. We are looking for problem-solvers and quick learners who thrive in fast-paced, complex environments and bring a strong work ethic, analytical mindset, and results-driven mentality to their work. The ideal candidate is eager to tackle challenging questions, communicate effectively, and collaborate across teams to develop practical, impactful solutions for clients. Most importantly, we are looking for an individual who is motivated by the opportunity to improve access to innovative therapies.

Our team provides integrated market access, clinical strategy, regulatory, and policy expertise across the healthcare landscape.

*NOTE: A portfolio featuring your pharma agency work must be submitted along with your resume. Samples should specifically demonstrate ability to craft patient communications infused with empathy and human connection, and are required for consideration for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate with Creative (Art & Copy), Strategy, and Medical to develop concepts and copy for a Market Access Audience.
  • Lead and execute both long- and short-form copy, both promotional and educational, across various media and platforms—including interactive and video
  • Write compelling and accurate content informed by scientific and clinical data
  • Have a strong understanding of strategy and drive copy to align to the goals of the brand
  • Reference and annotate content for assigned accounts and projects; prepare manuscript with final annotations and references within the internal submission process
  • Stand in for the ACD of Copy, along with the ACD of Art, when the ACD of Copy is unavailable
  • Work independently on multiple projects across brands, sometimes under tight timelines
  • Build a strong client relationship and work directly with them to problem-solve
  • Develop creative concepts based on strategic direction, partnering with other Creatives, demonstrating a level of creative excellence
  • Present work both internally and to clients
  • Effectively manage internal and client feedback
  • Review and mark up copy changes on layouts, as needed
  • Work within the editorial process, leveraging client regulatory guidance and OPDP requirements for promotional tactics
  • Manage direct reports, mentor junior members of the team and collaborate across disciplines

About you

  • At least 7 years of combined copywriting experience in agency and pharmaceutical advertising space; knowledge of HCP or Market Access required
  • A least 2 years of supervisory/management experience required
  • Experience writing for data heavy clients or HCP
  • Track record of independently producing successful, compelling, and strategically sound pharmaceutical promotional materials (must submit portfolio with resume)
  • Strong collaborator with Art partner; can think visually to strengthen creative and tactical development
  • Ability to think critically, make effective decisions, and creatively problem-solve in real time
  • Demonstrated proficiency delivering quality work within tight deadlines; positive attitude; goal-oriented
  • Demonstrated ability ideating on-brief creative concepts
  • Advanced Mac experience with MS Office Suite and Adobe Creative Suite
  • Able to understand scientific information on a level appropriate to create clear and succinct pharmaceutical and healthcare copy
  • Proven experience with adding marginal annotations in medically heavy pieces for regulatory submissions

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

jobs.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role

Hello Heart’s finance team has built a strong foundation for planning and reporting. As we scale, the next step is to give our business leaders faster insight, less manual effort and a deeper finance partnership. We’re looking for a hands-on, AI-savvy VP of FP&A to lead that evolution.

You’ll design how modern FP&A works at Hello Heart. You’ll use automation, our planning platform and emerging AI tools to take manual work out of reporting, forecasting and deck-building, so the team can spend its time on forward-looking analysis. You’ll partner closely with leaders across the organization to evaluate investment opportunities, use our resources efficiently, and help us continue to accelerate growth.

This is a chance to build a modern, scalable finance function alongside a talented team. The ideal candidate combines financial expertise, a strong instinct for technology and automation, and the business acumen to be a true strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the company's financial planning cycle, including the long-range financial plan, annual operating plan, and monthly and quarterly forecasts.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms, accountability, and decision-making processes across Finance and business leaders, driving adoption of new tools and ways of working as the company grows.
  • Build and maintain the company's integrated financial model, including three-statement modeling, key operating metrics, and scenario analysis.
  • Own bottoms-up revenue forecasting in partnership with Go-To-Market, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Data teams, including bookings, ARR, and revenue at the client and cohort level.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting packages and board materials, and lead financial reviews with executives to explain variances, trends, and forecast risks.
  • Model the P&L impact of business initiatives and provide recommendations that support capital and resource allocation decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the CFO and executive team, translating complex financial information into clear, actionable insight for non-finance audiences.
  • Partner with the Controller on accounting alignment, reporting accuracy, and process improvements that make the close and forecasting faster and more reliable.
  • Lead the selection, implementation, and ongoing use of FP&A planning software and drive automation of budgeting and forecasting workflows.
  • Support investor and lender reporting requests, working with Investor Relations and the CFO on data, metrics, and financial narrative.
  • Lead a small but strategic FP&A team, setting clear standards for accuracy, timeliness, and business partnership, and mentor team members as the function grows.
  • Provide dedicated business-partner coverage for go-to-market, product, and G&A, pressure-testing assumptions and owning the financial story for each area.
  • Lead the move from spreadsheet-based processes to automated, AI-enabled planning, reporting, and board-material production.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of FP&A experience, including at least 3 to 5 years leading an FP&A team in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
  • Strong three-statement modeling skills and a working understanding of accounting principles.
  • Experience forecasting recurring revenue businesses, including bookings, ARR, and unit economics.
  • Proven track record of presenting financial plans, variances, and recommendations to executives and boards.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, with hands-on experience implementing or running FP&A planning tools (such as Adaptive, Anaplan, or Planful).
  • Experience with NetSuite or another ERP is preferred.
  • Experience scaling a company through $200M or more in revenue, and moving FP&A from manual spreadsheets toward automated, AI-enabled processes.
  • Experience in B2B2C, digital health, or another regulated healthcare environment is a plus.
  • Investment banking, strategic finance, or venture/growth-equity experience is a plus.
  • Strong business judgment, executive presence, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and guide change.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field. MBA, CFA, or CPA preferred.
  • Comfort using approved AI tools to improve forecasting, analysis, and reporting, with careful review of accuracy and protection of confidential information.

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $225,000 to $275,000. Salary ranges are determined by role and level. Compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the salary only and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Artist Agreements & Clearances Manager is a cross-company role responsible for securing and managing artist agreements, releases, and content clearances in support of production and distribution across the Recording Academy and its affiliates. In this position, you will be a key liaison between internal stakeholders, artists, managers, labels, publishers, and legal teams, supporting events, series, exhibits, GRAMMY Studios programming, and expanding organizational objectives. You are a detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for music and the music industry. You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships, can balance creative needs with legal and company requirements, and are calm under pressure. You have a collaborative spirit and service mentality.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Artist Releases & Agreements

  • Draft, negotiate, execute, and manage artist agreements and releases across all Recording Academy and affiliate productions, ensuring timely execution for live and pre-recorded content.
  • Maintain organized records of all agreements, including rights granted, restrictions, and obligations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure content usage plans and artist negotiations are accurately reflected in contractual terms.

Sync and Misc. Clearances

  • Secure synchronization rights and related clearances for music and content use across all Recording Academy and affiliate platforms.
  • Coordinate with record labels, publishers, PROs, and other rights holders to obtain necessary licenses.
  • Track and manage rights by territory, media, term, and usage to ensure compliance.
  • Oversee the license lifecycle, including payments, amendments, extensions, expirations, and archiving
  • Troubleshoot and resolve clearance issues under tight production timelines.
  • Support additional clearance needs, including artwork, likeness, podcast, and other media usage.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with internal stakeholders early in the process to assess and address clearance, release, and agreement needs.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for all artist-related contractual and clearance matters.
  • Clearly communicate requirements, risks, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders.

Process & Systems Management

  • Refine workflows for outreach, negotiations, contract execution, and rights tracking.
  • Maintain and improve systems for documenting, tracking, and reporting rights and permissions.
  • Keep standardized clearance process resources current and accessible.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure content is cleared prior to distribution across all platforms.
  • Flag risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Stay current on music rights, licensing practices, and industry standards.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • 5+ years’ experience in music business affairs, content clearance, and music publishing.
  • Paralegal experience and/or the ability to draft and review content licensing agreements and negotiate terms with knowledge of how smaller negotiations affect big-picture relationships.
  • Established relationships with record labels, music publishers, and artist management.
  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive follow-through.
  • Flexibility to succeed in a fast-paced production environment with tight deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects proactively and independently while providing cross-company support.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the Grammy Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the Grammy Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin Grammy Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation.

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin Grammy Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The Grammy Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include Grammy in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

The Data Governance Specialist supports the implementation and ongoing maturity of the enterprise data governance program within a federated operating model. The role partners with business data owners, stewards, and technology teams to establish consistent governance practices, strengthen data ownership and accountability, improve metadata and data quality, and support compliance with privacy, retention, and risk requirements. By coordinating governance activities, facilitating stakeholder engagement, monitoring performance, and promoting adoption of enterprise standards and tools, this role helps ensure data is well-managed, trusted, discoverable, and used responsibly across the organization

Some of the things you will be doing:

Data Governance Program Support

  • Support the implementation and maturation of the enterprise data governance framework.

  • Assist in developing and maintaining data governance policies, standards, procedures, and operating models.

  • Facilitate governance councils, stewardship forums, working groups, and governance-related meetings.

  • Track governance initiatives, decisions, action items, risks, and issue remediation activities.

  • Promote governance awareness and adoption across business and technology teams.

Data Ownership and Stewardship Enablement

  • Partner with business unit leads to identify and document Data Owners and Business Data Stewards.

  • Facilitate stewardship onboarding and training activities.

  • Clarify governance roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability expectations.

  • Coordinate stewardship activities across data domains and business functions.

  • Escalate unresolved ownership, accountability, and stewardship issues through appropriate governance channels.

Metadata and Data Catalog Governance

  • Support the development and maintenance of business glossaries, data dictionaries, and governance metadata.

  • Establish metadata standards, governance workflows, and quality expectations.

  • Coordinate metadata collection and validation activities performed by business and technical stakeholders.

  • Monitor metadata completeness and governance compliance.

  • Promote effective use of enterprise data catalog capabilities.

Data Quality Governance

  • Support implementation of enterprise data quality policies, standards, metrics, and controls.

  • Facilitate identification, prioritization, and escalation of data quality issues.

  • Coordinate remediation efforts with business stewards, system owners, and technology teams.

  • Track data quality trends, root causes, and corrective actions.

  • Report on data quality performance and governance outcomes.

Policy, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Support alignment of activities with regulatory, privacy, records retention, and risk management requirements. Support implementation of data classification, retention, and protection requirements.

  • Assist with governance assessments, audits, and compliance reviews.

  • Maintain governance documentation and evidence required for internal and external audits.

Stakeholder Engagement and Change Management

  • Collaborate with business, technology, analytics, security, privacy, legal, compliance, and risk stakeholders.

  • Communicate governance standards, expectations, and program objectives.

  • Develop training materials, guidance documents, and governance communications.

  • Drive adoption of governance processes and stewardship practices through education and stakeholder engagement.

Reporting and Metrics

  • Define and track governance KPIs and stewardship performance measures.

  • Produce governance dashboards, management reports, and executive summaries.

  • Monitor governance maturity and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Report governance risks, trends, and and adoption metrics to leadership.

What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Business, Information Systems, Data Management, Analytics, Computer Science, or related discipline (equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal education).

  • Preferred CDMP or comparable data management certification.

  • 3-5 years of practical experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, business analysis, risk management, compliance, records management, or compliance, records management, or a related field.

  • Practical experience applying privacy laws such as GDPR and/or CCPA in a corporate environment.

  • Practical experience with governance and catalog platforms such as Informatica Data Catalog, Informatica CDGC, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, or similar tools

  • Proficient in SQL to pull, audit and analyze data sets

  • Knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and governance best practices

  • Familiarity with metadata management, business glossaries, data catalogs, and data lineage concepts.

  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

  • Ability to document policies, standards, procedures, and governance requirements clearly and consistently.

This position will independently own significant elements of the monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation process and help ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP, SEC, and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements. The role will partner across the organization to resolve complex consolidation matters, improve processes, and maintain the integrity of the Company’s financial information. The successful candidate will be a detail oriented, hands-on subject-matter expert, with a continuous improvement mindset. Successful candidate will be self-motivated, accountable for the review and overall quality of the team's work product, and who enjoys working in a collaborative environment.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Independently own and execute significant consolidation activities, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, equity roll forwards, topside entries, and other complex consolidation adjustments.

  • Review journal entries, account analyses, consolidation reports, and supporting documentations prepared by team members; identify issues, provide direction, and drive timely resolution.

  • Monitor the consolidation close calendar, coordinate dependencies across teams, establish timelines and deliverables, escalate risks, and help ensure milestones are achieved.

  • Prepare and review consolidated financial results, including statement of cash flow, for accuracy, completeness, unusual trends, and consistency with underlying business activity; communicate findings and recommended actions to management.

  • Aide in maintaining and validating HFM consolidation structures and processes, including entity hierarchies, ownership structures, chart-of-accounts mappings, translation settings, consolidation rules, journals, and reporting outputs.
  • Alongside Consolidations Sr. Manager, Co- Lead compliance with SEC, US GAAP and Sarbanes Oxley regulations
  • Alongside Consolidation Sr. Manager, Co-Lead when providing information to other departments, management and/or external auditors
  • Evaluate business situations and generate ideas for solutions; analyzes the potential effect or impact of each solution; selects appropriate solutions driving continuous improvement.

  • Prepare and review consolidated financial information, supporting schedules, and financial statement footnote documentation used in Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, earnings materials, and management reporting

  • Mentor more junior team members

Core HFM Duties

Financial Consolidation

  • Support management of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation processes

  • Execute and review intercompany eliminations

  • Perform foreign currency translation and CTA analysis

  • Process consolidation adjustments and top-side journal entries

  • Assist with maintaining ownership structures and entity hierarchies

  • Analyze consolidated financial results and variances

Reporting & Smart View

  • Develop and maintain Smart View reports

  • Perform ad hoc analysis and data extraction

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Investigate consolidation discrepancies

  • Research out-of-balance intercompany accounts

  • Resolve foreign exchange translation issues

Core FDMEE Duties

Data Integration Management

  • Support the data movement from ERP systems into HFM/EPM applications

  • Support the execution of Importing, Validating, Exporting, and Loading processes

Mapping and Data Governance

  • Review mapping changes related to chart of accounts updates

  • Understand the impact of mapping changes on financial reporting

Financial Reconciliation

  • Reconcile ERP balances to HFM results

  • Help analyze and resolve data integrity issues

Month-End Close Support

  • Assist with monitoring load schedules and close dependencies

Assist with managing data submission timelines across business units

YOU MUST HAVE:

  • 6+ years of experience in accounting or financial related positions.
  • 4+ years of experience in the consolidation processes & U.S. GAAP
  • Working experience in financial reporting software (e.g.,Hyperion , expert level preferred-HFM, Workiva, Microsoft suite).

WE VALUE:

  • A mix of public accounting and industry experience.
  • Experience in multinational public company environment, preferably in a global organization.
  • Working knowledge of reporting process related to eliminations, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency transactions, topside entries.
  • Working knowledge of financial systems/applications (e.g., Hyperion, HFM, Workiva).
  • Demonstrated skills in financial analysis and communication/business writing.
  • Ability to adapt to changing environments and think creatively.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage tasks by priority.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Own processes related to the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close periods.
  • Opportunity to leave a legacy through identification and implementation of continuous process improvements.
  • Leadership coaching and development opportunities to ensure you are set up for success and prepared for the next step in your career.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our reporting ecosystem by leveraging AI and automated workflows to modernize our standard procedures.
  • Be seen and heard with encouragement and empowerment to make decisions.
  • Be your AUTHENTIC self.
  • Leverage your expertise to build and improve Resideo' s culture and processes.
