jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled BI-LIT Claims Examiner to manage litigated files and attend trials, conferences, mediations, and arbitrations. The successful candidate will:

  • Investigate and gather all necessary information and documentation related to claims
  • Evaluate liability and damages
  • Negotiate and settle claims
  • Manage litigation cases related to auto claims disputes

The BI-LIT Claims Examiner will also be responsible for maintaining electronic files, analyzing defense counsel's performance, and regularly reporting to the Claims Manager. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate adjuster who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Curious. You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, a sense of humor. Claims are hard enough as it is.

What we need

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  • Managing legal aspects of litigated cases, including evaluation of legal process and expenses
  • Analyzing and reviewing auto insurance claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation related to the claim, evaluating liability and damages related to the claim, and negotiating and settling claims with opposing parties or their insurance providers
  • Managing litigation cases related to auto claims disputes, attending mediations, arbitrations, and court hearings as necessary, and communicating regularly with clients, claims adjusters, attorneys, and other stakeholders
  • Collaborating with defense counsel, claims counsel, and litigation claims management for strategic planning, including developing and maintaining positive working relationships with approved defense firms and other vendors in the industry
  • Reviewing legal documents and ensuring compliance with initial suit-handling plan of action
  • Serving as corporate representative for discovery review and depositions, and appearing as Corporate Representative at depositions and trials when needed
  • Analyzing policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions, drafting frequent and complex coverage correspondence, and proactively managing primarily litigated claim files from inception to closure
  • Directing and controlling the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters
  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • 10+ years of claim handling experience, with 5+ of those years handling a pending of >60% in litigation
  • Transportation litigation (rideshare, auto, trucking, etc) is preferred but those with personal lines experience should still apply if they meet all other requirements.
  • You are not intimidated by an attorney, even if you are not one! You are the driver of the litigation strategy for any particular claim. You manage the discovery in the order and timing of events and hold attorney accountable
  • Understand transportation coverages. Understand contractual risk transfer and additional insured forms
  • You have strong medical knowledge
  • You have a sense of urgency and understanding of how to manage time-sensitive demands
  • Ability and willingness to communicate both on the phone and in written form in a prompt, courteous, and professional manner
  • Strong analytical and negotiation skills. You will conduct your own negotiations directly with opposing counsel
  • Knowledge of multiple state statutes, including good faith claim handling practices, regulations, and guidelines
  • Ability to professionally collaborate with all stakeholders in a claim
  • Attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Client Solutions Manager
jobs.excerpt: Somewhere in your career, a client asked for something the platform didn't do out of the box.
jobs.description:
Somewhere in your career, a client asked for something the platform didn't do out of the box. You didn't say no, and you didn't overpromise. You asked enough questions to find out what they actually needed, built a configuration that solved it, and showed them how to run it themselves. When it worked, it worked because you understood both the system and the person asking.

That's the kind of person we're looking for.

What We Do

Every school district in America runs on service. Parents need answers, teachers need support, IT teams need systems that work. Most districts cobble that together with disconnected tools, overwhelmed staff, and no real visibility into what's working.

Onflo built the platform that fixes that. Our unified service platform brings together customer service, help desk ticketing, call center operations, AI chat, and IT asset management, purpose-built for K-12 public education. When a district runs on Onflo, their staff spends less time firefighting and more time serving students and families.

You'll be the person who makes the platform do what each district needs it to do.

The Role

You'll own client solutioning for our district clients, post-implementation. When a district needs a custom workflow, a chatbot configured, a call center stood up, or a stubborn problem diagnosed, that lands with you. You'll run discovery to figure out what's really needed, build and validate the configuration, and train the district to use it. You'll scope expansion projects with Account Management and write the statements of work that delivery runs on. Small projects, you'll run end to end yourself. Larger ones, you'll scope cleanly and hand off to our Implementation team.

What you'll own

  • Solutioning for a book of district accounts: discovery, design, configuration, delivery
  • Platform customization: custom forms, workflows, chatbot and call center configuration
  • Advanced troubleshooting on escalated district issues
  • Scoping and statements of work for expansion projects, in partnership with Account Management
  • Training and webinars that leave districts more self-sufficient, not more dependent
  • Daily coordination with our India-based Client Care team, with clean written handoffs across time zones

Who Thrives Here

We'll be direct with you, because we think you'll appreciate it.

Onflo is a small, entrepreneurial team. We don't have a perfect playbook for everything. Priorities shift. This role sits between three teams (Account Management, Implementation, and Client Care) and the seams between them are yours to work. Some days that means a superintendent's cabinet in the morning and a webinar for front-office staff in the afternoon. Districts will ask for things the platform shouldn't do, and part of your job is saying so, with a better alternative attached.

The people who do their best work here genuinely like building things and teaching people to use them. They keep commitments without being chased. They push back on unworkable requests instead of quietly absorbing them. They write clearly enough that a colleague nine and a half time zones away can act without a call. And underneath it, they care about public schools and the families they serve.

If you want to advise from a distance and hand the building to someone else, this isn't your role. If you want to own the problem from "what do you need?" through "here's how it works," keep reading.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a post-sales technical client-facing role in B2B SaaS: technical account management, implementation, professional services, or similar
  • Hands-on platform configuration experience you personally performed: workflows, forms, integrations, or comparable
  • Experience scoping client projects and writing statements of work or equivalent
  • Experience designing and delivering client training, live and virtual
  • Able to explain the same solution to a district IT director and a school front-office team, and be understood by both
  • K-12 or public-sector experience is a plus, not a requirement; we'll teach you the industry if you bring the fundamentals

The right person reading this already knows if they're right for it. If that's you, apply.

Location: This is a remote position open to candidates residing anywhere in the United States. Expected travel for this role is 20%. #Li-remote

Expected Base Salary: $85,000 - $95,000 / year + Discretionary Bonus. Exact pay is based on experience, skills, market demand, and internal equity.

K12 Insight is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of backgrounds, beliefs, and experiences to be critical to our success and are passionate about creating a welcoming, supportive, and collaborative environment for all employees. All are encouraged to apply as we continue to grow a smart, hard-working, and diverse team who love working together to build something that matters. Coordinates the daily operations of the Surgical Prehabilitation and Readiness (SPAR) program, which helps patients prepare for surgery. Supervises assigned support staff and works with clinical and operational partners to support a consistent patient experience and effective program operations.

Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Coordinates patient services providing quality care in efficient and cost effective manner.
  • May supervise support staff, scheduling work assignments to ensure appropriate coverage, hires, trains and evaluates performance.
  • Maintains established policies and procedures and quality control through quality assurance and risk management programs.
  • Promotes and maintains effective communications and collaboration within departmental administrators, managers and supervisors.

  • Provides reports, analysis and maintains records as required.
  • Coordinates and maintains equipment and supplies ordering when needed.
  • Assists with clerical tasks as needed including answering phones, computer entry, copies and fax material.
  • Promotes and supports continuous improvement of quality and service to ensure effective clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction.
  • Coordinates the patient’s participation in SPAR from enrollment through the preoperative period, including scheduling, follow-up, and communication with patients, families, and care teams.
  • Supports patient assessment, individualized planning, and progress monitoring within the scope of the position and established SPAR protocols; escalates clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate licensed clinician.
  • Provides approved patient education and resources on activity and mobility, nutrition, pulmonary hygiene, smoking cessation, and mindfulness.
  • Helps patients and families set up and use program technology, including Fitbits, and troubleshoots routine issues.

jobs.excerpt: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare.
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Senior Director, Pharmacy Solutions leads the strategy, adoption, and optimization of oncology drug management initiatives across The US Oncology Network. This role serves as a critical link between enterprise strategy and community oncology practice execution, helping practices navigate evolving clinical, financial, operational, and market dynamics while ensuring safe, sustainable adoption of oncology therapies.

This leader oversees a high-performing team of Pharmacy Solutions Directors responsible for strategic practice engagement, portfolio management, and performance optimization. Working closely with physician leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across the GPO, Operations, Finance, Research, Analytics, Technology, Market Access, and Manufacturer Relations, the Senior Director aligns enterprise capabilities with practice needs to advance patient access, improve practice performance, and support long-term economic sustainability.

As a trusted advisor to both practices and enterprise leadership, this individual combines deep oncology expertise, drug economics knowledge, and operational leadership to drive strategic decision-making, strengthen Network readiness, and advance pharmacy growth initiatives across the Network.

The ideal candidate is a visible and influential oncology leader with a demonstrated ability to translate complex clinical, financial, and market insights into actionable strategies. They possess strong executive presence, lead through influence, and have a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in community oncology, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare strategy environments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Drug Strategy & Portfolio Leadership

  • Lead development and prioritization of Network drug strategy initiatives by integrating clinical evidence, physician perspectives, manufacturer pipeline intelligence, payer dynamics, reimbursement considerations, and practice economics.
  • Establish portfolio governance, prioritization frameworks, and performance measures to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Pharmacy Solutions Directors.
  • Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, and development opportunities to build organizational capability and future leaders.

Practice Strategy & Performance Optimization

  • Partner with Network practices to support adoption of strategic initiatives, optimize drug utilization strategies, and improve practice performance.
  • Serve as an executive sponsor for key practice relationships and strategic growth opportunities.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Collaborate with physician governance groups and enterprise stakeholders to align priorities, remove barriers, and drive enterprise-wide execution.
  • Lead complex, high-visibility initiatives that require alignment across multiple business functions.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Connect clinical, operational, and financial insights to identify opportunities, assess impact, and support informed decision-making.
  • Ensure strategic recommendations are supported by measurable outcomes and value realization.

Market Intelligence & Industry Engagement

  • Monitor emerging therapies, industry trends, payer landscapes, and reimbursement changes to inform Network strategy.
  • Represent the organization through professional associations, conferences, advisory boards, and industry forums.

Measures of Success

  • Successful delivery of a prioritized enterprise drug strategy portfolio with defined objectives, milestones, accountability, and measurable outcomes.
  • Increased Network readiness and adoption of strategic initiatives across practices.
  • Improved practice engagement, satisfaction, and overall performance outcomes.
  • Strong alignment between clinical and financial strategies resulting in measurable business impact.
  • High-performing Pharmacy Solutions team demonstrating engagement, accountability, and leadership effectiveness.
  • Effective governance processes supporting timely decision-making and enterprise execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; equivalent experience considered.
  • Typically requires 13+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 6+ years of leadership and Oncology experience managing and developing teams in complex healthcare environments.

Education

  • PharmD or equivalent pharmacy degree required.
  • Active pharmacist license in good standing required.
  • MBA, MHA, MS, or other advanced degree preferred.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 13+ years of progressive experience in oncology, specialty pharmacy, healthcare strategy, market access, practice operations, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of people leadership experience with demonstrated success building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of oncology therapeutics, community oncology care models, manufacturer pipelines, reimbursement, payer dynamics, and drug economics.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level initiatives across matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect clinical and financial strategies to measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, executive communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Active participation in industry organizations, advisory boards, conferences, or professional networks preferred.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
  • Clinical and Financial Integration
  • Executive Presence & Influencing Skills
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Change Leadership & Adoption Management
  • Talent Development & Team Building
  • Governance, Prioritization & Execution Excellence
  • Analytical Decision-Making & Problem Solving
  • Industry Insight & Learning Agility

Working Conditions

  • Remote opportunity within the United States, subject to company policy.
  • Up to 30% travel for practice engagement, leadership meetings, and industry events.

jobs.description:
Equifax is where you can power your possible. If you want to achieve your true potential, chart new paths, develop new skills, collaborate with bright minds, and make a meaningful impact, we want to hear from you.

A PrincipalCustomer Success Manager (PCSM) must be a proactive self-starter who maintains an owner’s mindset toward their client portfolio. The core of this role involves partnering closely with clients to identify and meet their specific business objectives, ensuring they derive maximum value from our solutions. Through this proactive support, a PCSM effectively drives customer satisfaction, product adoption, long-term retention, and revenue expansion.

Furthermore, managing banking clients requires a specialised skill set that extends beyond standard relationship management. Because banks operate in highly complex, heavily regulated environments with stringent security protocols and extended adoption cycles, it is vital that a candidate possesses a good understanding of these unique institutional challenges to be successful.

What you will do

  • Develop strong relationships with our clients by maintaining a high level of engagement, aligning business objectives, and providing raving fan service
  • Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions, client base, and best practices
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the client, ensuring success and maximum value as they adopt a new platform/service
  • Educate clients on business value of solutions and application of best practices
  • Provide business insights through client value presentations, Quarterly Business Reviews, and other methods
  • Identify potential growth and upsell opportunities to expand revenue, engaging the Account Executive at the appropriate time to hand off the opportunity.
  • Assess customer health by monitoring product usage, reported issues, and other success metrics
  • Act as a liaison between internal COE teams to ensure customer needs are being met and to create solutions to client pain points; coordinating amongst technology, sales, marketing, finance, and product teams
  • Identify trends and relay feedback internally to appropriately address underlying issues
  • Provide clients full transparency on status of issues / requests from submission through resolution, working across teams and driving the escalation process as needed
  • Actively participate in the customer life cycle process, from prospect to renewal
  • Participate in CSM programme development and improvement activities
  • Facilitate customer account changes, product set up and billing research/corrections
  • Work with Sales and other Learning & Development teams to facilitate customer training as needed

What experience you need

  • Strong experience in a Customer Success, Account Management, or other Client-Facing role
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) required, or the equivalent years of industry experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve business and basic technical problems. Requirement for a foundational understanding of banking regulations (e.g., GDPR, FCA guidelines)
  • Ability to effectively manage daily client communications, including escalations and problem management situations
  • Banks are heavily siloed. A successful banking CSM must be adept at building consensus across multiple departments, including IT, Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and the actual business line users. Must be able to work autonomously and collaborate as part of a team
  • Change moves slowly in financial institutions due to necessary risk and compliance checks. The candidate needs exceptional patience and project management skills to keep momentum alive over a 12-to-18-month adoption process.
  • Ability to travel occasionally (up to 25% of the time)

What could set you apart

  • Possesses strong analytical skills, process improvement and project management capabilities a plus
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including formal as well as informal client and internal presentations
  • Exhibits confidence and is calm under pressure
  • Understand the end-to-end banking customer journey, from customer acquisition and loan origination to account management and collections.
  • A good working knowledge of financial regulations (such as FCA guidelines, GDPR, KYC/AML rules, and Fair Lending practices) to understand the constraints and pressures their clients face.

The Perks of being a Equifax Employee?

We offer a wide range of company supported benefits including contributory pension, life cover, income protection, healthcare, enhanced maternity and sick pay, 26 days holiday and a day off for your birthday, with the ability to buy and sell and free credit checks. We also offer flexible benefits ranging from cycle to work, discounted travel options, gym membership, dining and leisure discounts, financial & savings plans, mobile discounts plus much more!

We also support personal development and have a range of learning options including our global online learning platform and allow you to bring your whole self to work supported by our Inclusion and Diversity, Wellbeing and Employee Engagement forums.

Are you ready to power your possible? Apply today, and get started on a path toward an exciting new career at Equifax, where you can make a difference!

jobs.excerpt: What we doHDVI is modern insurance for today’s fleets driven by service, safety and savings.
jobs.description:
What we do

HDVI is modern insurance for today’s fleets driven by service, safety and savings. With real-time telematics data informing our risk models, we help lower premiums, mitigate risk, engage and reward drivers and simply put, offer uncomplicated protection for trucking fleets. Our customers are small to midsize truck fleet operators who benefit from dynamic and transparent pricing – automatically reducing their premiums for safer driving. Leveraging a best-in-class partner ecosystem, HDVI combines magnitude and stability with innovation to revolutionize commercial trucking insurance.

Why work here

HDVI is building the industry-defining commercial auto insurance company for the next 100 years. The $50 billion commercial auto industry hasn’t seen real innovation for decades and is broken in a number of ways, creating a significant opportunity for HDVI.

HDVI has a senior management team with experience building innovative insurance and logistics companies from zero to $1B+ enterprises and deep expertise in trucking insurance.

The HDVI Team is values-driven, data-driven, ambitious, and collaboratively minded, with a diverse background of experiences and skills in the insurance and logistics industries. We like challenges and building solutions that improve the quality of life for our customers. We offer generous benefits, including health, dental, vision, 401k match, flexible work environment, and unlimited PTO.

About the Role

As an HDVI Senior Physical Damage Adjuster, you will work closely with HDVI’s Claims and Fleet Services Teams. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of handling all aspects of Commercial Heavy Trucking claims inclusive of Third Party Auto Property Damage, First Party Auto Property Damage and Cargo claims. You will be responsible for influencing and providing claim resolution and tactical guidance to both internal and external customers in order to achieve world class claims outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Independently investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex and high-severity commercial auto physical damage and motor truck cargo claims from initial assignment through final resolution, including losses involving tractors, trailers, commercial vehicles, specialty equipment, cargo, freight, and other high-value commercial assets.
  • Conduct comprehensive coverage, causation, and damage investigations, evaluating policy provisions, endorsements, deductibles, loss circumstances, ownership, and extent of damages while utilizing telematics, dash-camera footage, photographs, GPS/ELD information, police reports, shipping records, and other available evidence to support sound claim decisions.
  • Investigate and evaluate complex motor truck cargo losses, including damaged, destroyed, contaminated, lost, stolen, or otherwise compromised freight by reviewing bills of lading, shipping documents, freight contracts, invoices, ownership records, cargo valuations, salvage opportunities, and other documentation necessary to determine coverage, causation, valuation, and exposure.
  • Critically evaluate commercial vehicle and equipment damages and related expenses, including repair estimates, supplements, appraisals, labor rates, parts selections, total-loss valuations, towing, storage, rental, loss-of-use/downtime, cargo handling, transloading, cleanup, and mitigation expenses to ensure accurate evaluations, appropriate cost control, and timely claim resolution.
  • Manage complex total-loss, cargo mitigation, and salvage activities, including vehicle valuation, title processing, lienholder requirements, salvage disposition, and the inspection, preservation, mitigation, storage, disposal, and salvage of damaged cargo while ensuring appropriate evidence and documentation are maintained.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate loss and expense reserves and negotiate complex settlements, recognizing adverse development, adjusting reserves as information evolves, and resolving claims within established authority with insureds, claimants, cargo owners, shippers, brokers, repair facilities, appraisers, vendors, and other involved parties.
  • Identify and maximize subrogation, salvage, contribution, indemnification, and other recovery opportunities, including claims involving Self-Insured Retentions (SIRs), large deductibles, Independent Owner-Operators (IOOs), leased equipment, and other complex trucking arrangements, while identifying fraud indicators, prior or unrelated damage, cargo theft, inflated valuations, questionable repair activity, or other matters requiring additional investigation or SIU referral.
  • Develop comprehensive claim action plans and coordinate specialized resources, including independent appraisers, cargo surveyors, salvage vendors, towing providers, repair facilities, experts, and other external resources, ensuring appropriate service, cost control, timely claim progression, and communication of significant developments to Claims leadership.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor, participating in large-loss reviews, claim roundtables, reserve reviews, and complex claim discussions; providing technical guidance to less-experienced adjusters; and supporting Claims leadership with complex file reviews, training, quality assurance, vendor management, process improvement, and identification of emerging physical damage and cargo loss trends.
  • Effectively manage a complex claim inventory while maintaining comprehensive documentation and exceptional service, ensuring compliance with Claims Best Practices, regulatory requirements, service standards, and established authority levels while meeting expectations for quality, productivity, cycle time, cost containment, reserve accuracy, recoveries, customer service, and overall claim outcomes.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of auto physical damage claims experience, with significant commercial auto, trucking, heavy-equipment, and/or motor truck cargo experience preferred, including demonstrated ability to independently manage complex and high-severity tractor/trailer, specialty equipment, total-loss, and significant cargo exposures.
  • College education or an equivalent combination of education and relevant claims experience preferred, along with an active Adjuster’s License and the ability to obtain and maintain all required state licenses.
  • Advanced knowledge of commercial auto physical damage and motor truck cargo coverage, including policy provisions, endorsements, deductibles, commercial trucking operations, motor carrier exposures, Independent Owner-Operators (IOOs), leased equipment, large deductibles, and applicable state and federal requirements.

The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

Versaterm is hiring a Sales Account Manager to grow our footprint inside existing public safety customers. This is an expansion role, not a new-logo role. You'll work a portfolio of established strategic accounts and sell the full Versaterm ecosystem into them: CAD, RMS, DroneSense, Community Report, and the rest of the portfolio as it grows. Success means deepening relationships, uncovering new needs, and turning satisfied customers into multi-product, long-term partners.

This job posting is being used to fill an existing vacancy.

What You Do

  • Own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of existing strategic accounts, including state police, large municipal police departments, county and regional dispatch centers, and multi-agency programs.
  • Develop account plans that map each customer's current Versaterm footprint against the full product ecosystem and identify the highest-value expansion opportunities.
  • Drive upsells and cross-sell of additional products, modules, agencies, and subscription tiers into the installed base.
  • Lead renewal and expansion conversations, structuring pricing and bundles that increase customer value and Versaterm's recurring revenue.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with chiefs, sheriffs, CIOs, dispatch directors, and elected or appointed decision-makers.
  • Navigate public-sector procurement for add-on purchases, including funding sources, council or board approvals, co-op purchasing vehicles, and contract amendments.
  • Partner closely with implementation, customer success, support, product, marketing, and contracts to keep customers happy and surface new opportunities early.
  • Work with the SAE team so that new customers are handed off cleanly and nurtured after go-live.
  • Forecast accurately and maintain disciplined pipeline and CRM hygiene.
  • Represent Versaterm at customer sites, user groups, and industry conferences, with regular travel.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of enterprise software sales or account management experience, ideally in public safety, government, or another complex, long-cycle market
  • Proven track record of growing revenue within existing accounts through upsell, cross-sell, and renewals, and consistently meeting or exceeding quota
  • Ability to speak credibly about a multi-product portfolio and connect it to a customer's operational and budget realities
  • Working knowledge of public sector buying processes, including funding, approvals, and procurement vehicles
  • Credibility with law enforcement, dispatch, or public safety leaders; existing relationships in the space are a strong plus
  • Experience with CAD, RMS, or related public safety technology is highly preferred
  • Strong executive presence, negotiation skills, and written and verbal communication
  • Comfortable with 50% travel.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. The Role

Veeva QualityOne is seeking an accomplished global sales leader to accelerate growth across our enterprise software business serving Consumer Products, Food & Beverage, Chemicals, and emerging industries. In this role, your teams will be responsible for both developing new markets through proactive prospecting and expanding established business through strategic account development.
As a key member of the QualityOne leadership team, you will play a critical role in translating our growth strategy into commercial execution, contributing market insights, aligning sales priorities, and driving global results.
The ideal candidate is a builder who combines exceptional people leadership, enterprise sales expertise, and a fierce commitment to sales excellence. You will develop a high-performing global organization, leading regional and industry sales directors across North America and Europe. Success in this position requires a hands-on leader who knows that great sales performance stems from strong talent, proven methodologies, rigorous process, and consistent execution—not just individual relationships.

What You'll Do

Sales Leadership & Culture

    • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing sales organization across North America and Europe
    • Establish a consistent global sales culture emphasizing accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement
    • Recruit and develop exceptional talent, address performance gaps, and build organizational capabilities to support growth

Revenue Growth & Market Development

    • Own global sales performance, including new customer acquisition, renewal expansion, pipeline development, and revenue targets
    • Drive growth in established industries while building market presence and generating new business in emerging industries
    • Develop effective prospecting, territory, and account strategies to penetrate markets where customer relationships and brand awareness are still developing
    • Personally engage in strategic enterprise opportunities, executive relationships, and complex competitive sales cycles

Sales Excellence & Operational Discipline

    • Establish and reinforce consistent sales methodologies, qualification standards, and opportunity management practices
    • Drive disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, and performance accountability
    • Build a metrics-driven sales operating cadence that improves productivity, predictability, and win rates
    • Translate strategic priorities into actionable plans and ensure consistent execution

Business, Strategic & Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Serve as a key member of the QualityOne leadership team, helping translate business growth strategies into actionable sales priorities and measurable outcomes
    • Build trusted relationships with senior customer executives and support value-based enterprise selling
    • Partner closely with industry Strategy, Marketing, Solution Consulting, Services, Product, and Finance to align execution and accelerate growth
    • Translate market insights and customer feedback into actionable sales and business priorities
    • Align global teams around common objectives while adapting execution to regional market needs

Requirements

    • Enterprise Technology Sales Leadership: 15+ years of enterprise software or technology sales experience, including 8+ years leading sales teams and consistently delivering revenue growth
    • Builder & Market Development Experience: Demonstrated success building sales organizations, entering new industries or markets, developing prospecting capabilities, and establishing market presence while growing established businesses
    • Sales Methodology & Operational Excellence: Strong belief in structured, repeatable sales processes with proven experience implementing sales methodologies, forecasting discipline, pipeline management, and measurable performance improvements
    • People Leadership & Culture Building: Exceptional ability to recruit, coach, develop, and drive accountability of sales professionals, while building a collaborative, high-performance culture across multiple geographies
    • Enterprise Selling & Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage C-level executives, win competitive opportunities, and collaborate effectively across functions. Manufacturing industry experience preferred
    • Drive & Independence: Driven self-starter capable of operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
    • Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel up to 35% for customer meetings, events, and internal alignment
    • Consultative Sales Approach: Selling technical or business solutions into complex organizations, which require explicit analysis of pain, current state, future state vision, and strong value proposition to win

Nice to Have

    • Quality Management, Document Management, Laboratory Information Management or Product Life Cycle Management software experience
    • Experience successfully launching sales efforts in new industries, geographies, product categories, especially where brand recognition and established relationships are limited

        3. A practical case exercise
        4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

We’re a B2B SaaS company in pricing and market intelligence, serving brands, manufacturers, and retailers. We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to win new business with large brands and retailers as we move upmarket.

If you are comfortable with a 90 to 120-day sales cycle, getting the whole buying committee behind a deal, and walking away with a signed contract, this is built for you.

You’ll report to the VP of Sales and Marketing and work closely with Sales Engineers, Customer Success, and the wider sales team to win new accounts and set them up to grow.

Fluency in both spoken and written French is required for this position.

Essential Functions

  • Own the full sales cycle for new business with enterprise brands, manufacturers, and retailers, from first outreach to signed contract.

  • Build and work a named list of target accounts, with a territory plan that puts the highest-value opportunities first.

  • Map each target account’s buying committee across pricing, eCommerce, merchandising, sales, and executive leadership, and build relationships well beyond your first point of contact.

  • Lead discovery that uncovers core business problems and ties Wiser’s data to outcomes buyers care about: margin, price position, MAP compliance, and promotional performance.

  • Run tailored product demos over Microsoft Teams and in person.

  • Share what you hear in the market to sharpen our ICP, messaging, collateral, and prospecting approach.

  • Maintain regular and reliable work attendance.

  • Experience: 5+ years in quota-carrying sales roles, with at least 3 in enterprise closing roles.

  • Industry background: 3+ years selling SaaS or data products, with a track record selling into consumer brands, manufacturers, and/or retailers. Pricing, market intelligence, or eCommerce analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • Proven results: Documented attainment (100%+ in at least two of the last three years). President’s Club, top-rep rankings, or similar recognition strongly preferred.

  • Methodology: Hands-on use of a structured enterprise sales methodology such as MEDDICC, Challenger, or SPIN.

  • Executive presence: Comfortable presenting to and negotiating with VP and C-level buyers.

  • Self-sourced pipeline: Proven record of building your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, with a meaningful share of closed deals sourced yourself rather than handed to you by marketing or SDRs.

jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue.

In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event.

What you'll do

  • Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model.
  • Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables.
  • Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone.
  • Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer.
  • Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention.
  • Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps.
  • Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution.
  • Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company.
  • A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership.
  • The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams.
  • Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations.
  • Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms.
  • Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team.
  • Nice to have: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting.

About the team

The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer Amphenol Industrial Operations Reports To: Technical Director Job Description Summary:The Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer is responsible for leading and coordinating global technical standards and product compliance activities for Amphenol Industrial Operations (AIO).
jobs.description:
Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer Amphenol Industrial Operations Reports To: Technical Director

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer is responsible for leading and coordinating global technical standards and product compliance activities for Amphenol Industrial Operations (AIO). This role supports product development, R&D, sustaining engineering, qualification, and certification activities across AIO engineering and manufacturing locations worldwide. The position works with global product teams early in the development process to identify applicable international, regional, and national requirements; establish product compliance and certification strategies; interpret standards and regional deviations; and align product designs and qualification plans for multiple markets. The role serves as a global technical resource for standards including, but not limited to, UL, IEC, ASTM, EIA, ISO, Open Compute Project (OCP), and SAE requirements. The Senior Product Compliance & Standards Engineer works directly with UL and other certification bodies, test laboratories, global Product Development, R&D, Quality, Product Management, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams. The position coordinates global certification and testing programs, resolves differences in regional requirements, supports reuse of test evidence where permitted, and drives timely approvals for global product launches. A key responsibility is representing AIO in international and regional standards committees, technical panels, task groups, industry consortiums, and working groups. The role monitors emerging requirements across global markets, provides technical input, and helps shape standards that affect current and future AIO technologies. This global role supports all AIO product lines and markets, including data center, solar, energy storage, electric vehicle, heavy equipment, harsh environment, transportation, industrial, and other high-reliability applications. Regular collaboration across regions and time zones is required, along with domestic and international travel to standards meetings, certification events, conferences, laboratories, and AIO locations. Company Introduction Amphenol Industrial Operations, headquartered in Endicott, New York, with global manufacturing, design, sales, and marketing locations, specializes in delivering a comprehensive range of high-reliability power and signal connectors along with interconnection systems designed specifically for harsh environments and high performance. Our solutions cater to diverse, high-growth industrial sectors such as alternative energy, energy storage, hyperscale datacom, telecom, rail and mass transit, electric and hybrid vehicles, transportation, factory automation, robotics, and heavy equipment. Our product portfolio addresses modern power and signal requirements and emerging system technology needs encompassing high-amperage power interconnects utilizing proprietary RADSOK® contact technology, ruggedized circular, rectangular interconnects and board level contacts (GT, AC, PT, Amphe-Lite, Radsert, PowerBlok, SurLok Plus, ePower, UPC, H4 Plus, and more), advanced power distribution including value-add box builds, custom-engineered cable assemblies and overmolded harnesses. With a dedicated team of over 2500 skilled staff operating across a growing international footprint—including eight key manufacturing sites in North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Middle East providing localization for our customer base. Amphenol Industrial Operations consistently meets the highest global standards of quality, product performance, design capabilities, and regionalized technical and sales support. Amphenol Industrial Operations proudly operates as a business unit of Amphenol Corporation (NYSE: APH), a global leader in the electronics revolution, headquartered in Wallingford, Connecticut. www.amphenol-industrial.com

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Global Standards & Product Compliance Leadership

Provide global technical compliance guidance and support from concept development through design, validation, qualification, certification, product release, and lifecycle management. Establish global product compliance strategies that address international standards, regional and national deviations, certification pathways, and market-access requirements. Identify applicable requirements early and translate them into clear product requirements, design inputs, test plans, compliance matrices, and certification deliverables for global engineering teams. Work closely with AIO global test facilities and external laboratories to ensure compliance testing is performed consistently and in accordance with applicable standards, while identifying and mitigating technical and certification risks. Support AIO global test facilities in developing and maintaining the capabilities, processes, and qualifications necessary to perform UL testing where appropriate. Support product development engineers globally to identify certification risks, regional conflicts, schedule impacts, and opportunities to leverage common designs or test evidence across markets. Participate in design reviews on new product development projects.

International Standards Development & Industry Representation

Represent AIO in applicable international and regional standards committees, standards technical panels, working groups, task groups, and industry organizations. Build relationships with standards organizations, certification bodies, industry consortiums, customers, and technical experts across key regions. Monitor proposed and emerging standards globally and assess their potential impact on AIO products, technology roadmaps, certifications, and market access. Provide AIO technical input on new and revised requirements and help develop, improve, and influence practical, safe, and technically sound standards and test methods. Coordinate AIO positions and technical comments across global engineering, product management, quality, and business stakeholders before external submission.

Global Certification Agency & Testing Management

Serve as a senior global technical interface with UL and other applicable certification bodies, Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories, and independent laboratories. Plan, coordinate, manage, and expedite multi-region product certification and compliance testing programs in support of global development schedules and product launches. Coordinate sample requirements, supporting documentation, agency submittals, engineering responses, witness testing, and follow-up actions. Work with engineering teams and certification partners to resolve technical questions, nonconformances, interpretation differences, and approval delays. Identify opportunities to align qualification programs, avoid unnecessary duplicate testing, and reuse acceptable test data or certifications where permitted. Maintain global visibility of certification status, open issues, risks, priorities, and required actions for active programs.

Global Standards Library & Regulatory Intelligence

Maintain a controlled, current global standards library covering applicable international, regional, and national standards used by AIO engineering teams. Monitor new editions, amendments, interpretations, regional deviations, certification requirements, and effective dates that may affect existing or future products. Communicate standards changes and market-specific impacts to global engineering, manufacturing, product management, quality, sales, and leadership teams. Develop global guidance documents, standards summaries, cross-reference tables, compliance matrices, design checklists, test templates, and training materials. Provide training and technical support across regions to improve consistent interpretation and application of standards.

Global Product, Customer & Cross-Functional Support

Support global product development teams and all AIO product lines serving data center, solar, energy storage, electric vehicle, heavy equipment, harsh environment, transportation, industrial, and related markets. Partner with engineering and manufacturing locations worldwide to align product compliance strategies, testing methods, documentation, and certification execution. Support customers, Business Development Managers (BDMs), Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and commercial teams during technical reviews involving standards, certifications, ratings, product applications, and market-specific requirements globally.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline required. 5+ years of experience in product compliance and standards. Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying product standards across multiple markets. Experience working directly with UL or other certification bodies, Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories, and independent test laboratories. Experience participating in standards committees, standards technical panels, international working groups, or industry consortium activities strongly preferred. Experience with electrical connectors, cable assemblies, high-power interconnects, industrial equipment, or related electromechanical products preferred.

Technical & Global Collaboration Requirements

Strong working knowledge of product safety, performance, qualification, and certification standards, including UL, IEC, ASTM, EIA, ISO, OCP, SAE, and other market or product-specific requirements. Ability to compare international requirements and regional deviations and translate them into practical global design and test strategies. Knowledge of connector and cable assembly testing preferred. Ability to develop global certification strategies, standards cross-references, compliance matrices, test plans, engineering guidance, and executive-level status summaries. Strong technical problem-solving and negotiation skills when working with certification engineers, standards organizations, laboratories, customers, and global engineering teams. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to represent AIO in external technical forums with ability to communicate effectively with global teams; additional language capability is beneficial. Ability to manage multiple compliance and standards activities across regions, cultures, and time zones while maintaining clear ownership, priorities, and follow-through. Must be legally eligible to work in the United States.

Travel Requirements

Domestic and international travel required for standards meetings, UL and certification events, OCP conferences, industry technical meetings, laboratory testing, customer support, and AIO engineering/manufacturing locations. Travel may include North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Mexico, and other global locations as required to support product development, certification, and standards activities.

Physical/Environmental Requirements:

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, sit, stand; walk; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. Must be able to sit and/or stand for long periods of time.

jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.


ROLE OVERVIEW


The Senior Analytics Engineer, Clinical Quality and Outcomes supports the Chief Medical Officer organization in building the future state of clinical quality, patient safety, outcomes measurement, and clinical research analytics at LifeStance.


Reporting to Clinical Strategy, this individual contributor will serve as the bridge between clinical stakeholders, executive leadership, and enterprise data teams. The role will transform complex clinical data into trusted, governed, and actionable insights that drive clinical decision-making, enterprise quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and research initiatives.


The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in healthcare analytics with the ability to understand end-user needs and translate them into intuitive dashboard experiences, scalable reporting solutions, and research-grade data assets. This individual will be responsible for ensuring data integrity from source systems through executive reporting, enabling consistent metrics that can confidently be reported internally, externally, to payers, regulatory bodies, board committees, and potentially investors.

This role will support LifeStance in establishing the next generation of clinical analytics capabilities through modern data architecture, cloud data warehouses (e.g., Redshift, Snowflake) and SQL data transformations, data quality frameworks, advanced analytics methodologies, and scalable self-service reporting environments. 

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES 

Clinical Data & Analytics Strategy 

  • Design, build, and maintain SQL-based data transformations that convert EHR and clinical source data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets that are actionable and translatable to our frontline clinicians  
  • Partner with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to translate clinical questions into measurable analytic requirements, data models, and dashboard experiences, using electronic health record data. 
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner for clinical quality, outcomes measurement, patient safety, regulatory readiness, and research-based reporting initiatives. 
  • Identify emerging opportunities to leverage advancements in analytic AI-enabled quality monitoring, and modern healthcare data platforms in the clinical environment.  
  • Work collaboratively with analytics team members across functions to ensure consistency in practice and reporting across functions: Operations, Clinical Operations, Payor Relations, Business Development 

Data Integrity & Governance 

  • Maintain rigorous data quality controls, validation processes, lineage documentation, and metric governance standards to ensure trust in clinical reporting. 
  • Design repeatable testing and reconciliation frameworks that identify discrepancies before they reach operational, executive, board, or external reporting audiences. 
  • Ensure consistency of metric definitions and calculations across dashboards, reports, scorecards, and enterprise reporting environments. 
  • Apply and uphold data security and privacy best practices for healthcare and health research datasets, including data de-identification standards and minimum-necessary use principles  
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues in clinical datasets, performing exploratory analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency of reported metrics  
  • Document data models, pipeline logic, and dashboard definitions to support transparency, maintainability, and knowledge-sharing across the analytics team  
  • Collaborate with enterprise data engineering, analytics engineering, and data analysts to align clinical data models with enterprise data architecture and governance standards  

Dashboard Architecture & User Experience 

  • Lead the design of intuitive, user-centered dashboard experiences that enable clinicians, medical leaders, operations leaders, and executives to quickly identify insights and take action. 
  • Translate workflow requirements into dashboards that support both operational intervention, strategic decision-making, and quality improvement. 
  • Design reporting experiences that balance flexibility, self-service analytics, and standardized enterprise measures. 
  • Apply user-centered design principles to ensure dashboards are adopted, trusted, and operationally relevant. 
  • Develop executive, board, regulatory, and clinician-facing reporting solutions that provide a consistent source of truth across audiences.  

Research & Outcomes Analytics 

  • Build and curate research-grade datasets that support clinical outcomes studies, publication efforts, payer reporting, and real-world evidence generation. 
  • Partner with clinical and research leaders to operationalize outcomes measures, patient-reported outcomes, and quality indicators into analytically rigorous datasets. 
  • Ensure data are appropriately validated, documented, and reproducible for internal and external research use. 

Data Engineering & Platform Development 

  • Design and maintain scalable analytics models, data marts, and reporting layers using cloud based data warehouses (AWS Redshift, Snowflake) and modern cloud data architecture.  
  • Develop and optimize SQL-based transformations supporting clinical quality, patient safety, outcomes, and research reporting. 
  • Leverage modern analytics engineering practices.  For example: dbt, automated testing, version control, documentation, and CI/CD methodologies. 
  • Collaborate with enterprise data engineering teams to ensure clinical analytics solutions align with enterprise architecture and future-state platform strategy.  

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Informatics, Engineering, Public Health, or a closely related field. 
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, data science, or related disciplines. 
  • 5 + years experience working directly with clinical subject matter experts and executive stakeholders to define, refine, and operationalize complex measures. 
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise reporting solutions that support executive, operational, clinical, and regulatory decision-making. 
  • Advanced SQL expertise with experience building scalable analytic datasets and reporting environments. 
  • 5+ years developing Power BI or equivalent business intelligence solutions. 
  • Strong experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms. 
  • Experience implementing data quality testing, metric validation frameworks, and governance approaches that ensure reporting accuracy and consistency. 
  • Experience translating stakeholder requirements into highly usable and impactful dashboard experiences. 
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures, electronic health record systems, clinical workflows, and quality metrics. 
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Experience supporting behavioral health analytics, patient safety programs, measurement-based care, quality improvement, or regulatory reporting initiatives. 
  • Experience developing datasets supporting peer-reviewed publications, clinical research, outcomes research, or real-world evidence generation. 
  • Experience with dbt, Git, automated testing frameworks, semantic modeling, and modern analytics engineering practices. 
  • Experience working with PHQ-9, GAD-7, safety planning, suicidality measures, HEDIS, CMS metrics, accreditation standards, or quality reporting programs. 
  • Experience creating executive-level scorecards and board-facing dashboards. 
  • Master's degree or higher in Public Health, Data Science, Biostatistics, Informatics, Health Services Research, or a related field. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Upstart’s Product Quality Oversight team builds and operates the first line of defense quality oversight program for unsecured lending, including personal loans, small-dollar loans, and cash line. As the Product Quality Manager, Unsecured Lending at Upstart, you will lead end-to-end quality testing for assigned regulatory areas and help shape a scalable, data-driven oversight program. You’ll define risk-based testing coverage, partner with Engineering to design and validate automated monitoring, and work across teams to resolve control gaps. This is an individual contributor role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead testing for assigned regulatory areas from planning through reporting, defining risk-based coverage, sampling approaches, test scripts, and documented conclusions.
  • Set testing priorities and timelines for assigned areas, and coordinate testers' work to meet them.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into testable attributes and criteria; update test scripts and coverage as regulations or products change; and decide when to re-scope testing or seek Compliance or Legal interpretation as facts change.
  • Lead control design walkthroughs to understand the end-to-end process, including dependencies across systems, teams, and third parties; challenge whether controls are designed to address the risk, and set the testing approach.
  • Evaluate whether lending controls operate as intended across origination, servicing, and collections; identify systemic gaps and escalate findings supported by evidence.
  • Partner with Engineering on automated and AI-assisted monitoring requirements, verifying rule logic, testing populations, outputs, and missed exceptions before relying on results.
  • Lead validation after product or process changes, review and reperform testers’ work, and help maintain consistent methods and audit-ready documentation.
  • Translate findings and root causes into actionable recommendations; work with Product, Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk to advance remediation and support reviews by second-line testing and Internal Audit.
  • Help improve the oversight program and guide other testers while using approved AI tools responsibly, verifying AI-assisted conclusions against source requirements and manual checks.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in compliance testing, quality control or assurance, internal audit, or regulatory examination in consumer lending.
  • Experience independently designing and leading end-to-end quality or compliance testing for consumer lending products, systems, or transactions.
  • Experience developing and applying risk-based sampling methods, standardized testing criteria, and documented conclusions under consumer financial regulations such as TILA/Reg Z, ECOA/Reg B, FCRA, EFTA/Reg E, FDCPA/Reg F, or UDAAP.
  • Experience analyzing testing populations, control results, or automated monitoring outputs to assess completeness and identify exceptions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of automated lending platforms, digital lending products, or credit decisioning systems.
  • Experience with quality oversight for unsecured installment loans or lines of credit.
  • Experience designing or validating automated or AI-assisted quality monitoring, including checks for missed exceptions.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional remediation and communicate control assessments to stakeholders with different areas of expertise.
  • Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) or a similar compliance certification.

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services.
