Whether supporting an implementation, improving financial processes, guiding system optimization, or helping clients navigate change, you'll serve as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into practical solutions.

You'll work closely with finance leaders, business officers, controllers, and end users to solve challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and create more efficient and effective financial operations. Your expertise in Colleague Finance and higher education business processes will help institutions streamline workflows, improve reporting, strengthen data integrity, and achieve their strategic goals.

If you've spent years working in a college or university finance office, or have consulting experience supporting the Ellucian Colleague Finance module, this is an opportunity to make a broader impact by helping institutions across the country transform the way they work.

SIG employees work remotely within the United States.

What You'll Do

As an Ellucian Colleague Finance Consultant, you will:

  • Partner with colleges and universities to implement, optimize, and support the Ellucian Colleague Finance module.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to finance leaders and staff, helping them align system capabilities with institutional goals and business needs.

  • Help institutions leverage Colleague more strategically by identifying opportunities for automation, improved reporting, and process modernization.

  • Finance teams become more efficient through improved processes and effective use of Colleague.
  • Projects are delivered on time and with high client satisfaction.
  • Institutions gain greater visibility into their financial information through better reporting and data integrity.
  • End users feel confident, supported, and equipped to use the system effectively.

What You'll Bring

The most successful consultants in this role combine deep higher education finance expertise with a passion for helping institutions improve the way they work.

  • Five or more years of experience working within higher education, with a strong understanding of the unique operational and financial challenges colleges and universities face.
  • Five or more years of hands-on experience with Ellucian Colleague, including advanced knowledge of the Finance module and its application across institutional finance operations.
  • Experience supporting or leading Colleague Finance implementations, upgrades, or optimization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of higher education financial operations, including general ledger, budgeting, purchasing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.
  • Experience developing and leveraging reporting solutions to support financial decision-making, budget management, reconciliation activities, and operational analysis.
  • An understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS applications, cloud-based solutions, and digital transformation initiatives within higher education.
  • The ability to analyze complex business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver practical solutions that create meaningful efficiencies.
  • Experience in a consulting, advisory, or client-facing role where building relationships and guiding stakeholders through change was a key part of your success.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose functional issues, collaborate with technical teams, and communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, paired with a customer-first mindset and a commitment to delivering an outstanding client experience.
  • The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and approach challenges with curiosity, initiative, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel periodically to support client engagements and project needs.

Nice to Have

While not required, the following qualifications will help you stand out:

  • Experience leading or managing project-based work across multiple stakeholders and timelines.
  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience helping institutions modernize finance operations through process improvement, automation, or technology transformation initiatives.
  • Previous experience working as a consultant serving higher education clients.

Our best consultants are collaborative, adaptable, and genuinely enjoy solving problems alongside our clients. They bring both expertise and curiosity to every engagement, balancing industry best practices with an understanding that every institution has unique goals, cultures, and challenges. Sales Valley è una startup HR che aiuta le aziende a costruire team commerciali ad alte performance, occupandosi di selezione e sviluppo di profili Sales e Business. Siamo in forte crescita e vogliamo ampliare il nostro team HR, oggi di 5 persone, con una persona motivata e orientata ai risultati, che voglia crescere insieme a noi.

Se hai già esperienza nella selezione di figure commerciali, sia dipendenti (Sales, Business Developer, Account) sia agenti di commercio in Partita IVA sul territorio, e ti trovi a tuo agio con volumi elevati e ritmi sostenuti, questa è l’opportunità giusta.

Il ruolo

Entri nel team HR e lavori sulle nostre ricerche commerciali, con il supporto del team su metodo, priorità e standard di qualità.

  • Sourcing e head hunting: ricerca attiva su LinkedIn, banche dati, job board e canali alternativi per individuare Sales, Business Developer, Account Manager, Area Manager, consulenti commerciali e agenti di commercio

  • Screening e selezione: primo contatto, screening telefonici, colloqui conoscitivi e valutazione di motivazione e attitudine commerciale

  • Shortlist e reportistica: preparazione di shortlist e report candidati e gestione del feedback loop con candidati e clienti

  • Gestione della pipeline: conduzione di più ricerche in parallelo, mantenendo attivo un bacino di candidati qualificati

  • Relazione con il cliente: con il tempo, partecipazione agli intake e alla gestione diretta delle aziende clienti

Il profilo che cerchiamo

  • 1-3 anni di esperienza in recruiting o ricerca e selezione, in agenzia, in azienda o in una rete vendita

  • Esperienza comprovata nella selezione di figure commerciali (requisito prioritario), in particolare: profili commerciali dipendenti: Sales, Business Developer, Account Manager, Key Account, Area Manager e ruoli affini, agenti di commercio in Partita IVA e reti vendita sul territorio

  • Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza maturata nel settore energetico o immobiliare, o in settori affini come telco, assicurativo, utilities e vendita diretta

  • Conoscenza del mondo commerciale: sai leggere un profilo Sales, valutarne risultati e attitudine e distinguere le logiche di un contratto da dipendente da quelle di un mandato di agenzia con sistema provvigionale

  • Spiccata attitudine al sourcing proattivo e alla gestione dei volumi

  • Ottime capacità comunicative e di persuasione, al telefono e in colloquio

  • Orientamento al risultato, spirito di iniziativa e voglia di crescere sul campo

  • Organizzazione e autonomia nella gestione di più progetti in parallelo

Costituiscono un plus

  • Conoscenza di base di CCNL, tipologie contrattuali e contratto di agenzia (Enasarco, mono/plurimandato)

  • Residenza o domicilio a Torino o zone limitrofe

Modalità di lavoro

Full remote, con la possibilità di lavorare dal nostro ufficio di Torino, zona San Salvario, a 10 minuti da Porta Nuova, indicativamente 1 giorno a settimana per chi vive in zona. Per chi vive fuori Torino prevediamo momenti di incontro periodici.

Cosa offriamo

  • L’ingresso in una startup giovane, dinamica e in forte crescita, dove il tuo contributo è visibile e riconosciuto

  • Collaborazione in Partita IVA con perimetro definito e forfait stabilito per ogni ricerca

  • Continuità nel tempo su più ricerche, basata su performance e fiducia

  • Onboarding strutturato e affiancamento costante da parte di colleghi senior su metodo, strumenti e processi

  • Un concreto percorso di crescita, dalla ricerca operativa alla gestione diretta di clienti e progetti

Candidati se vuoi metterti alla prova su progetti concreti, sviluppare competenze solide nella selezione commerciale e contribuire alla crescita di una realtà di cui sentirti parte.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
jobs.excerpt: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. This is a full-stack applied data science role that combines data foundations, statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and cross-functional technical leadership.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and evolve reliability and quality models for current and next-generation Oura Ring products, including warranty forecasts, runtime degradation, survival analysis, failure-mode prediction, and cohort-based field-performance analysis.
  • Develop diagnostics and root-cause analysis systems that connect ring telemetry, firmware and engineering diagnostics, manufacturing records, supplier and component data, testing results, activations, and warranty outcomes.
  • Partner with Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Battery Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Support Engineering to identify the highest-leverage reliability risks and translate them into measurable analytical problems.
  • Analyze component, supplier, manufacturing-process, and ring-build variation to identify drivers of product quality and inform corrective actions, design decisions, and supplier-quality improvements.
  • Build trusted analytical data products and pipelines that unify hardware, manufacturing, firmware, diagnostic, activation, and warranty data and make them usable for recurring analysis and decision-making.
  • Develop production AI-enhanced dashboards, monitoring, and decision-support tools that surface emerging failure risks and provide clear, actionable recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish robust measurement practices for hardware quality, including metric definitions, cohorting, normalization, uncertainty, data-quality checks, and appropriate statistical methods.
  • Translate complex technical findings into concise recommendations that influence hardware roadmaps, launch decisions, quality plans, firmware priorities, warranty strategy, and member experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional problems and help raise the bar for data science practices through documentation, peer review, reusable tooling, and mentorship.

This is a remote US role with a slight preference for candidates based in San Francisco.

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, reliability engineering, quality analytics, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of owning high-impact problems end to end.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, or advanced analytics to reliability, quality, manufacturing, hardware, IoT, electronics, automotive, medical devices, or another physical-product domain.
  • Strong experience with reliability and time-to-event methods, such as survival analysis, hazard modeling, accelerated-life testing, degradation modeling, warranty forecasting, or related techniques.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience building analytical data models, statistical or machine-learning workflows, and production-quality measurement systems.
  • Strong data-engineering intuition, including experience unifying and transforming data from multiple operational and technical systems into reliable datasets for analysis and modeling.
  • Experience working with noisy, incomplete, longitudinal, or high-volume telemetry and test data, and the judgment to distinguish data artifacts from meaningful product signals.
  • Experience designing experiments or observational analyses that support technical decisions, including an understanding of confounding, bias, uncertainty, and validation.
  • Experience with modern cloud and data platforms such as Databricks, AWS, dbt, Snowflake, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to engineers, quality and operations partners, product leaders, and executives.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams and to drive progress when requirements and data are still evolving.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with consumer electronics, wearables, IoT, batteries, embedded systems, firmware, sensors, or connected devices.
  • Experience analyzing manufacturing, supplier, component traceability, MES, ERP, engineering test, or warranty data.
  • Experience with battery degradation, runtime modeling, charging optimization, power management, or electronics reliability.
  • Experience building field-failure analysis, anomaly detection, predictive-maintenance, or early-warning systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware development and launch processes, including EVT, DVT, PVT, and field-test programs.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Region 1 $172,000- $203,000

Region 2 $158,950- $187,000

A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI).

ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Blockchain Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Salary Range: $140,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Blockchain Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade decentralized applications (dApps), smart contract platforms, and blockchain-integrated backend services supporting financial services, digital asset management, and enterprise transaction processing. This role focuses on building secure, scalable blockchain solutions that integrate seamlessly with cloud-native microservices and traditional enterprise applications.
You will work closely with solution architects, security engineers, DevOps teams, and product owners to develop smart contracts, blockchain APIs, digital wallet integrations, tokenization platforms, and secure transaction processing systems. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in blockchain protocols, smart contract development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining strong software engineering fundamentals.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop secure smart contracts for enterprise blockchain applications using Solidity or other smart contract languages.
  • Build scalable backend services that interact with blockchain networks for transaction processing, asset management, and identity verification.
  • Develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs to expose blockchain functionality to web and mobile applications.
  • Design blockchain data models, token standards, and transaction workflows for high-volume enterprise systems.
  • Integrate enterprise applications with Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, or other blockchain platforms.
  • Develop secure wallet integrations, digital signature workflows, and key management solutions.
  • Implement blockchain event listeners, indexing services, and off-chain processing components.
  • Build scalable microservices using .NET Core, Java, or Node.js that interact with blockchain networks.
  • Optimize smart contracts for gas efficiency, scalability, and transaction throughput.
  • Perform smart contract audits, security testing, and vulnerability assessments before production deployments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy blockchain infrastructure across Azure or AWS cloud environments.
  • Participate in architectural reviews, code reviews, technical design sessions, and production support activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex blockchain network issues, transaction failures, synchronization problems, and production incidents.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software development experience building enterprise-grade distributed applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on blockchain development experience delivering production blockchain solutions.
  • Strong experience developing smart contracts using Solidity and Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible networks.
  • Hands-on experience with blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Polygon, Avalanche, Binance Smart Chain, or Quorum.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js or backend development using C#/.NET Core or Java.
  • Experience building decentralized applications (dApps) with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, digital signatures, Merkle trees, and distributed ledger concepts.
  • Experience implementing ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, or custom token standards.
  • Experience integrating wallets such as MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, or enterprise custody platforms.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, WebSockets, and blockchain RPC interfaces.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Experience deploying applications on Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong debugging, performance optimization, and troubleshooting skills in production environments.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum development teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing enterprise blockchain solutions for financial services, healthcare, insurance, or supply chain industries.
  • Hands-on experience with Hyperledger Fabric chaincode development using Go or Java.
  • Experience with Layer-2 scaling solutions including Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism.
  • Familiarity with Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP), Multi-Party Computation (MPC), or privacy-preserving blockchain technologies.
  • Experience implementing decentralized identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC).
  • Knowledge of blockchain security standards, smart contract auditing tools, and common vulnerabilities such as reentrancy, overflow, front-running, and flash loan attacks.
  • Experience using Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Ganache, Brownie, or Remix IDE.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience integrating blockchain applications with enterprise identity providers including Azure Active Directory or OAuth.
  • Blockchain certifications or contributions to open-source blockchain projects are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a team building a next-generation enterprise blockchain platform supporting:
  • Digital asset tokenization and lifecycle management
  • Smart contract-driven business workflows
  • Enterprise wallet and digital identity integration
  • Real-time blockchain event processing
  • Secure multi-signature transaction approval systems
  • Blockchain analytics and reporting dashboards
  • Cloud-native microservices deployed on Azure and AWS
  • High-availability distributed systems supporting millions of secure transactions annually

This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll contribute to architecture, development, deployment, security, and operational excellence across mission-critical blockchain solutions.

Description

Build and lead the technical delivery of AI applications within Vi’s Life Science Markets squad. The squad turns large, varied proprietary datasets into products that help evaluate pharmaceutical markets, treatment adoption, competitive dynamics, and drug commercial performance.

This is primarily a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time designing systems, writing production code, integrating models, and shipping AI workflows, while owning technical standards and overall squad delivery. A background in life sciences or capital markets is very helpful, but not required.

What You’ll Own

  • Hands-on delivery: Personally build and ship core AI services and workflows. Own critical implementation work and resolve technical blockers alongside engineers, data scientists, and domain experts.

  • AI architecture and implementation: Design and implement systems combining ML models, LLMs, retrieval, and workflow automation to address life sciences market questions. Make practical choices about model quality, reliability, latency, and cost.

  • Production ownership: Take prototypes into production and own models, APIs, integrations, deployment, observability, and incident resolution. Build reusable capabilities that scale across therapies, companies, and clients.
  • Client partnership & business logic: Work directly with clients and domain experts to understand their analytical workflows, explain findings, challenge assumptions, and turn feedback into product priorities.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong record of personally building and shipping production AI applications, with technical ownership of complex systems and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across functions while remaining a primary contributor to design, modeling, coding, debugging, and deployment.
  • Deep practical experience integrating ML models and LLMs into production systems, including retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation. Ability to assess model limitations and choose methods suited to the available data
  • Client-facing engineering: You can run a working session with a client’s technical and non-technical people and come out of it with what will move the needle for them. Ability to translate complex analysis into clear conclusions for senior stakeholders and clients, including what the evidence cannot support..
  • Hands-on depth in scalable data pipelines, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure, ideally on AWS. Comfortable owning both application code and AI deployment.

As an SAP Finance Data Architect in Retail & Fashion you will:


  • Engage senior client Finance executives on how the finance information model supports business strategy, profitability transparency, and reporting — current and future.
  • Lead the definition of the finance information model across all phases of full-cycle SAP delivery: Plan, Analyze, Build, Test, and Deploy.
  • Define and govern the finance coding block for S/4HANA Finance: operational and group chart of accounts, company code and controlling area structure, cost center and profit center hierarchies, segments, functional areas, and other account assignment objects.
  • Design profit center and segment structures that deliver P&L visibility by brand, banner, channel (store, wholesale, e-commerce, franchise), region, and category, aligned with merchandise, article, and location hierarchies.
  • Define profitability analysis (Margin Analysis) characteristics and value fields, and the allocation, assessment, and cost-to-serve logic that supports retail and fashion margin reporting, including season and collection views.
  • Establish finance master data governance — ownership, standards, naming conventions, and change processes — including SAP MDG-F, and lead the mapping and migration of legacy structures to the target model.
  • Lead large, diverse project teams (onshore and offshore), maintaining quality, scope, and stakeholder alignment throughout delivery.
  • Advise on SAP's Business AI strategy — identifying where well-structured finance data can enable AI-driven insight, automation, and predictive accounting in Finance and Retail operations.
  • Contribute to thought leadership, reusable assets, and best-practice templates (e.g., retail and fashion reference chart of accounts and profit center models) to grow Accenture's SAP Retail capability.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience leading clients through full-cycle SAP Finance delivery across all phases — Plan, Analyze, Build, Test, and Deploy — as a Finance Data Architect.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience delivering SAP Finance transformations for Retail or Fashion clients (Grocery, Specialty, or Fashion preferred), with a focus on finance information model and master data design.
  • Minimum 5 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementations including project planning, estimation, finance design, and go-live (SAP support / managed services experience alone will not satisfy the implementation requirement)
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in finance data architecture and governance across S/4HANA, SAP MDG-F, data migration and legacy-to-target mapping, SAC/BW analytics, integration with IS-Retail/CAR, POS, and e-commerce, RISE with SAP, and financial controls/compliance.
  • Deep expertise in defining the finance information model — chart of accounts (operational, group, and country/statutory), company code and controlling area design, cost center and profit center accounting and hierarchies, segment reporting, functional areas, internal orders and WBS, and the Universal Journal (ACDOCA) — including account determination, document splitting, and the impact of design choices on reporting, controls, and statutory requirements.
  • Strong retail and fashion domain experience in structuring the finance model for multi-brand, multi-banner, and omnichannel P store, distribution center, and e-commerce profit center design; merchandise and article hierarchy alignment; inventory valuation and merchandise accounting; franchise and wholesale accounting; season and collection reporting; and Margin Analysis characteristics.
  • Prior experience in a consulting or advisory capacity with direct client-facing accountability.
  • Experience enabling AI-driven use cases within SAP programs, including Joule, embedded AI, and predictive accounting, and an understanding of how finance data quality and structure underpin them.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate's Degree, must have equivalent minimum of 6 years' work experience.

Bonus Points if:

  • You have SAP S/4HANA Finance certification, such as SAP Certified Application Associate or an equivalent Finance certification.
  • You have Experience applying SAP Activate methodology and leading Agile delivery and sprint execution within SAP transformation programs.

The Sr Technical Sourcing Manager is responsible and accountable for orchestrating the supplier selection process and part validation process for three major facets of Jabil’s needs: (1) Design, (2) NPI, (3) Risk/Cost Reduction. jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale.

You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product.

You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself.

Responsabilities

Engineering

  • Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.

  • Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.

  • Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app.

  • Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine.

Product Partnership

  • Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.

  • Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.

  • Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't.

  • Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

Leadership

  • Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.

  • Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.

  • Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

Requirements

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally in chat, calling, or social apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. Offline-first and eventual consistency should feel natural. You don't need P2P protocol expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

  • Bonus: experience with local-first apps, CRDTs or sync engines, offline-capable mobile or desktop apps, or open source.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

As a Senior Accountant at Armada, you will be a key member of our growing Finance team, responsible for maintaining the integrity of our financial records as we scale rapidly. You will manage assigned areas of the general ledger function, support month-end and year-end close processes, and partner cross-functionally with teams across the business to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

This is a general GL role with real breadth. Depending on business needs, your scope will span AP, AR, revenue, expenses, fixed assets and depreciation, debt, and leases, and it will shift as Armada grows. Our Galleon program (modular, deployed data centers) is a core part of the business and a meaningful piece of this role, including inventory, CIP, capitalization, and fixed asset accounting, but it is one of several areas you will cover rather than the whole job.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly organized, and excited about building scalable processes at one of the most exciting companies in AI infrastructure. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, and enjoys building scalable processes in a high-growth environment.

Location. This role is remote-based in SF Bay Area, NYC, or Seattle.  

Main responsibilities:

General Accounting & Close Responsibilities

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close tasks for assigned areas, following the close calendar and ensuring entries are posted accurately and on time
  • Prepare and post recurring and non-recurring journal entries, accruals, reclasses, and adjustments with clear supporting documentation
  • Prepare and review account reconciliations across balance sheet accounts, tie subledgers to the GL, and investigate and clear reconciling items promptly
  • Perform cash and bank reconciliations, and manage prepaid expense tracking and amortization across vendors and cost categories
  • Review GL activity for misclassifications, cutoff issues, and unusual balances; propose and make corrections before the books are finalized
  • Maintain close checklists and supporting schedules; flag late inputs, open items, and risks to the Accounting Manager and Controller
  • Assist in preparing monthly financial packages and flux analyses, explaining variances in terms of business drivers
  • Maintain clean, audit-ready workpapers and support external audit and due diligence requests

Transaction Cycles

  • Accounts Payable: Review the AP subledger and vendor accruals; support the invoice-to-pay process, including coding and approvals; ensure proper cutoff and timely reconciliation to the GL
  • Accounts Receivable: Support billing, cash application, collections, and AR aging; review reserves and write-offs; reconcile AR and deferred revenue activity to the GL
  • Revenue: Partner with Revenue Accounting to support revenue recognition under ASC 606, including contract review inputs, deferred revenue, and cost of sales matching, including for Galleon-related transactions
  • Expenses: Review operating expenses, T&E, payroll, benefits, and commissions entries; monitor accruals, prepaids, and budget-to-actual variances with department owners
  • Fixed Assets & Depreciation: Maintain the fixed asset subledger and depreciation schedules (including useful lives and methodologies); manage CIP and timely capitalization; reconcile monthly to the GL
  • Debt & Financing: Maintain debt schedules and record drawdowns, interest, fees, and covenant-related support; coordinate with Treasury and Finance leadership on financing activity
  • Leases: Maintain ASC 842 lease schedules for office and equipment leases, including new leases, modifications, ROU assets, and lease liabilities; reconcile to the GL
  • Inventory & Insurance: Support inventory and CIP accounting, capitalization of freight, installation, and other directly attributable costs, and prepaid insurance balances and claims

Galleon Program Support

  • Serve as an accounting resource for Galleon transactions across procurement, inventory, CIP, capitalization, deployment, redeployment, retirement, and disposal
  • Help administer the Company's fixed asset management system (NetAsset), ensuring accurate asset records and supporting process improvements
  • Track Galleon movements to keep the fixed asset subledger aligned with current fleet status; support physical inventory and fixed asset counts and resolve discrepancies

Cross-Functional & Process Improvement

  • Partner with FP&A on capex, depreciation, and expense forecasting
  • Act as a finance partner to Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain, Legal, and HR/Payroll, providing accounting guidance and ensuring proper documentation
  • Partner with Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership on accounting considerations related to customer arrangements and new business models
  • Design and maintain internal controls over your assigned cycles and keep process documentation (SOPs) current
  • Identify automation opportunities and help scale accounting processes, ERP workflows, and reporting capabilities
  • Assist with technical accounting research, policy development, and special projects as the company grows

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; Active CPA license required
  • 4–6+ years of progressive accounting experience. We prefer a combination of public accounting (Big 4 or regional firm) and corporate accounting, with hands-on, in-house GL experience valued as much as audit background. Experience in high-growth or startup environments is strongly preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including the ability to analyze large datasets, build scalable reconciliations, and develop efficient reporting schedules. Experience with Power Query or similar automation tools is a plus
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP across the full GL, including ASC 606 (Revenue), ASC 842 (Leases), ASC 360 (Fixed Assets), ASC 470 (Debt), and internal controls; familiarity with ASC 330 (Inventory) is a plus
  • Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms; exposure to AP/spend management, billing, and payroll systems is a plus
  • Broad general accounting experience across several of AP, AR, revenue, fixed assets, debt, and leases; experience with capital-intensive operations or fixed asset programs is a plus
  • Demonstrated success improving accounting processes, implementing controls, or supporting system enhancements
  • High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership
  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex accounting concepts for cross-functional partners
  • Strong sense of accountability, business judgment, and a proactive approach to problem solving

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Position Title: Power Systems Study Engineer III

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

This position in DLB’s Mission Critical Department focuses primarily on hyperscale data centers and related mission critical facilities.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with all design staff and further develop their power studies expertise. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team to complete short circuit coordination and arc flash studies on a wide variety of mission critical projects.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments.  Will execute and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope.  Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Power Systems Study Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Guide and Direct Power Systems Studies (80%)

Independently perform Power System Studies for mission critical projects. Activities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Equipment Evaluation: Assess the capabilities, ratings, and condition of equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, and capacitors to determine if they meet system requirements.
  • Load Flow Studies: Analyze current and future system load to ensure power delivery without overloading components.
  • Short Circuit Analysis: Evaluate potential fault conditions to determine the system's response and ensure that equipment ratings are not exceeded.
  • Protection Coordination: Study the settings of protective devices such as relays, circuit breakers, and fuses to ensure they coordinate correctly and provide optimal protection.
  • Arc Flash Analysis: Conduct studies to determine potential arc flash hazards, calculate incident energy, and recommend safety practices and protective equipment.
  • Transient Stability Analysis: Evaluate the power system's ability to maintain synchronism after large disturbances, such as faults or sudden changes in load, motor starting, etc.
  • Prepare incremental and final deliverables including breaker settings tables, TCC’s, arc flash labels, and final reports as required by the project scope.
  • Fluent in Power System Study software including one or more of the following:
    • SKM Powertools
    • EasyPower
    • ETAP

Project Management & Reporting (20%)

  • Assist with proposal development including project scope, schedule and budget
  • Timely and effective management of project deliverables including personal workload forecasting and coordination
  • Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
  • Perform QAQC peer reviews for projects where he or she is not the lead design engineer / power system study specialist.
  • Prepare project reports for internal and external stakeholders for projects which he or she is involved.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (INTERMEDIATE level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of electrical topologies associated with mission critical facilities.
  • Knowledge of the operation, types, and settings of protective devices like relays, circuit breakers, and fuses.
  • Understanding of the ratings, capabilities, and conditions of various power system equipment.
  • Knowledge of industry and safety standards related to power systems, especially concerning arc flash hazards and other safety-related matters.
  • Knowledge of the effects and requirements of connecting new generation or loads to existing systems.
  • Skill in using power system simulation software such as ETAP, PSS/E, SKM, Easy Power, etc.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at reviewing design drawings and equipment submittals.
  • Skilled in performing code analysis including selection of equipment, wiring, etc. to meet code requirements
  • Skilled in performing code analysis and advanced knowledge of electrical codes
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Physical Demands

PLUS

Content development and channel strategy

Campaign strategy and planning

Visual content creation

AI and quality

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

GoodPower is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to own our end-to-end technology organization spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate/platform cybersecurity. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering with executive leadership, this role provides comprehensive executive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer will report into this role.

Key Responsibilities

Internal IT Strategy & Enterprise Governance

  • Drive the overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for GoodPower’s core SaaS platform.
  • Manage the enterprise technology budget, driving cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership to bring new products from beta to market launch while managing technical debt.
  • Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.

Enterprise IT & Collaboration Architecture

  • Lead day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning/deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
  • Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures, enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on, and document retention policies.
  • Oversee business system infrastructure in close partnership with other leaders ensuring high uptime and integration security.

Corporate Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance

  • Lead organization-wide information security initiatives across all corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
  • Establish and audit comprehensive enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
  • Enforce compliance and audit readiness (e.g., SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries) across internal architectures in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Platform Boundaries

  • Partner closely with other leadership to turn high-level concepts and early-stage prototypes into operational reality. Evaluate alpha projects and PoCs built across departments and lead the execution to either seamlessly integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, highly scalable services.
  • Act as the primary advisor to staff, leadership, and the Board on technological capabilities, emerging enterprise risks, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across all corporate SaaS applications.

Product, Engineering, and Data Oversight

  • Serve as the direct manager for the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), setting shared goals and ensuring alignment between product/engineering/data strategy and enterprise technology, infrastructure, and security standards.
  • Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.

Team Leadership & Operational Culture

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing, service-oriented IT and security team tailored to GoodPower's mission and growth objectives.
  • Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for employees.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including as a Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or CTO.
  • Demonstrated experience running enterprise IT and IS stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
  • Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, encompassing SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
  • Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
  • Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executives, and Board members.
  • Proven track record of building and leading technical staff across a wide range of expertise.
  • Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through a period of organizational growth.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $220,000-$230,000, commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Business Development Manager - Hellenic Systems Ltd

Location: Home-based, anywhere in the UK, with regular travel to customer sites and periodic visits to our Essex head office

About Hellenic Systems

Founded in 1988, Hellenic Systems Ltd builds the systems that run the factory floor. Our software tells operators what to make and in what order, records what actually happened, and proves it to an auditor afterwards. The industry name for this is Manufacturing Execution Systems, or MES: the layer that sits between a company’s business systems and the machinery and people producing the goods. We design and manufacture the hardware that goes with it as well.

We are UK-based and serve over 130 sites across the UK and Europe. Our roots are in food manufacturing, particularly meat and poultry, and we are now extending into any manufacturer with the same problem to solve. A large share of what we ship is built specifically for one customer, which is why our tagline, Built Around You, is meant literally.

Our three software products are CARCASE, our kill line and livestock system, FOPS, our Factory Order Processing System, and FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system. Our hardware includes weigh scales, touch screen terminals, outer case marking systems, carcass data capture units and label printers.

Since 2023 we have been part of Vesta Software Group, which sits within Jonas Software, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. Constellation is one of the largest acquirers of vertical market software businesses in the world.

We are also unusually far along with AI for a business our size. It is embedded in how we build software and how we work day to day, not run as a side project, and we expect everyone here to use it.

The Opportunity

FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system, has been rebuilt as a new product and is our main new business push. It guides operators through ingredient weigh-up, enforces tolerances, captures batch and operator evidence, and connects to shop floor weighing and labelling hardware. The buyers are food and drink manufacturers who still run weigh-up on paper, spreadsheets or an awkward ERP screen, and who are under real pressure on allergen control, traceability and waste.

This is a new role. It exists to build and convert a new business pipeline that does not depend on our existing account base.

Job Summary

The Business Development Manager owns new business at Hellenic. The role is targeted on winning new named clients and new sites, starting with FORMIX and broadening into our wider software and hardware portfolio as the pipeline develops. It is a hunting role: self-generated prospecting, campaigns and networking, then running the opportunity through demonstration, proposal, negotiation and close, with support from our technical and commercial teams.

The BDM reports to the Head of Commercial and works alongside our Account Managers, who own existing customer relationships. Growth inside existing accounts stays with them. Anything genuinely new belongs to the BDM.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Business Generation

  • Win new named clients and new sites, principally for FORMIX in year one, broadening into CARCASE, FOPS, hardware and bespoke development as the pipeline matures.

  • Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns, trade events and industry networking. Marketing and referral leads will supplement this, not replace it.

  • Work the named FORMIX prospect list and the wider addressable market, including manufacturers outside our traditional meat and poultry base, such as bakery, dairy, ready meals, sauces, seasonings, flavourings and beverages.

  • Open the first opportunities in adjacent sectors as we extend the product into adjacent sectors, and feed what you learn back into product and pricing.

  • Qualify hard and early. We would rather have a smaller pipeline we believe in than a large one we do not.

2. Selling and Closing

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, on-site assessment, demonstration (in person and remote), proposal, commercial negotiation and close.

  • Build the business case in the customer’s language: reduced giveaway and waste, right first time batches, allergen control, audit-ready evidence and labour saved on the weigh-up line.

  • Prepare and present quotations and proposals that reflect our pricing model, including site-level and tiered packaging.

  • Present our solution accurately and never oversell what the product does. Where a requirement needs bespoke development, involve the technical team for scope.

  • Hand over cleanly to Projects and Support at the point of sale, including a written summary of what has been sold and what the customer expects.

3. Market, Product and Competitor Knowledge

  • Build and hold working knowledge of the FORMIX proposition and enough of the wider portfolio to spot an opportunity when a customer describes a problem.

  • Know the competition. Be able to explain where we win and where we do not.

  • Gather field intelligence on competitor pricing, bundling and contract terms.

  • Track sector trends, regulation and retailer or certification pressures (for example BRCGS) that create a reason for customers to act.

4. Pipeline, CRM and Reporting

  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of sufficient size and quality to deliver the agreed targets, with realistic close dates and values.

  • Keep CRM current and accurate. Every opportunity, activity, contact and next step is logged.

  • Report weekly on activity, pipeline movement and forecast, and present your numbers at commercial reviews.

  • Learn and follow the company sales guidelines and standard operating procedures, and help improve our proposal and correspondence templates as you go.

  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow: prospect and account research, first-draft proposals and follow-ups, call preparation and pipeline analysis. We will give you the tools and the training.

5. Working With the Team

  • Work with the Account Managers so that new business and account growth do not collide, and pass leads to them where an opportunity sits inside an existing relationship.

  • Work with Development, Projects and Support on solution scoping, demonstrations and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to campaigns, marketing content, case studies and event planning.

  • Attend training to keep product, sector and sales skills current, and take part in team meetings and reviews.

  • Carry out other reasonable duties related to the promotion, sale and delivery of our products as directed by the management team.

Targets and Measures of Success

You will carry a personal new business target, set annually with the Head of Commercial and reviewed each quarter. It covers new order value, new recurring revenue and a minimum number of genuinely new clients, and it is supported by activity and pipeline coverage measures and by the quality of what you put into the CRM.

The targets are built from our FORMIX commercial plan and are deliberately achievable for someone who prospects properly. We will share the detail, including the numbers and how the commission scheme works against them, at the interview stage.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Proven track record of winning new business in a B2B environment, carrying and hitting a personal new business target.

  • Experience selling a considered purchase with a multi-month sales cycle and more than one decision maker, typically operations, quality, engineering, IT and finance.

  • Comfortable self-generating pipeline.

  • Able to hold a credible conversation on a factory floor and translate an operational problem into a commercial proposal.

  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to write a proposal that stands on its own.

  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with the discipline to protect margin.

  • Confident with CRM discipline and accurate forecasting.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your working day. You do not need to be technical, but you do need to be someone who reaches for them rather than avoids them.

  • Full UK driving licence, and willing to travel across the UK, including overnight stays. Most of our target market sits in a band from the Midlands up through Yorkshire and the Humber into the North West, so a home base within reach of that corridor is an advantage, though we will consider strong candidates anywhere in the UK.

Desirable

  • Experience selling into food and drink manufacturing, or into another regulated manufacturing sector.

  • Familiarity with MES, ERP, traceability, weighing or labelling systems, or with production and quality processes in a manufacturing plant.

  • Experience selling a combined hardware, software and services solution rather than software alone.

  • Experience opening a new market or launching a new product into an existing customer base.

  • A strong existing network of contacts in food and drink manufacturing, at operations, quality, engineering or director level. If you can open doors on day one, tell us.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in a sales role, for research, drafting, call preparation or pipeline analysis.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

  • Experience designing agents through a written procedure, including hard rules, investigation steps, classification logic, and output formats.
  • Experience applying least-privilege design to agents, with limits enforced in the environment and permissions.

  • Ability to read Node.js code well enough to trace a feature across microservices.
  • SQL skills to read a schema and write scripts that use only existing tables and columns.
  • Experience improving prompts from failures by reading session transcripts, finding the root cause of a wrong output, and changing the procedure.
  • Ability to learn a large codebase and a support process on your own, with limited time from subject matter experts.
  • Sound judgment with customer-facing risk, defaulting to internal communication when a public action cannot be undone.

Job Title: Grant Reviewer, K-12 Education (High-Impact Tutoring)
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: Remote, United States
Employment Type: Part-Time, Independent Contractor (1099)
Engagement Type: Short-term, per grant competition; paid per application reviewed
Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring Grant Reviewers on behalf of the Office of the State Superintendent of Education (OSSE), the District of Columbia's state education agency, for its High-Impact Tutoring grant competition. OSSE is seeking experienced K-12 education professionals who have served as grant reviewers for OSSE in the past.

Grant reviewers provide independent subject matter expertise to read, score, and comment on competitive grant applications submitted by local education agencies, schools, community-based organizations, and other eligible entities. All reviews are completed remotely in OSSE's online Enterprise Grants Management System (EGMS), and reviewer scores are used to recommend applications for funding. OSSE selects reviewers from the qualified pool and gives preference to reviewers who have satisfactorily completed reviews for its competitions in previous years.

Work Schedule

This is a remote, part-time assignment. Reviews are completed on your own schedule within each deadline. The approximate commitment for this competition is:

  • Orientation and EGMS training: a virtual webinar held approximately within two weeks of the engagement start date.
  • Review window: usually two weeks from the date applications are assigned, unless OSSE specifies otherwise.
  • Facilitated discussion (only if needed): a phone or video conference, usually about three business days after the scoring due date, held when panel scores differ significantly.
  • Approximate completion of reviewer work: September 10, 2027. Final dates are confirmed before orientation.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Complete OSSE's EGMS training and attend the virtual, grant-specific orientation webinar before reviewing any applications.
  2. Independently read and conduct a detailed review of each assigned application (typically two or more per competition) as one of three reviewers on an EGMS review panel, working remotely and separately.
  3. Apply K-12 education expertise to assess the design, quality, and feasibility of each applicant's proposed tutoring program.
  4. Complete a fully scored rubric for every section of each application, applying the established scoring criteria consistently and objectively.
  5. Write clear, constructive comments describing strengths and weaknesses that justify and align with the scores given. Reviews may be shared with applicants on request, with reviewer names and contact information removed.
  6. Base all scores and comments only on the content of each applicant's submission in EGMS.
  7. Submit all scores and comments in EGMS by the review deadline, usually two weeks from receiving the applications.
  8. Participate in a facilitated panel discussion by phone or video conference when scores differ significantly, then submit a final rubric with updated scores and comments reflecting any changes.
  9. Disclose any conflict of interest with applicant organizations and do not review any application where a conflict exists.
  10. Direct EGMS technical questions to the EGMS manual, the resources at grants.osse.dc.gov, or the EGMS call center at (202) 719-6500, and direct questions about the grant or about scoring to OSSE grant program staff.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher.
  • Past service as a competitive grant reviewer for OSSE.
  • Professional experience in K-12 education.
  • Reliable access to a computer, the internet, and a phone.
  • Availability for the full review process, including EGMS training, the orientation webinar, the complete review window, and a facilitated discussion if one is required.
  • No conflict of interest with any applicant organization in this competition, confirmed through a signed Conflict of Interest Form.
  • No unsatisfactory performance evaluation from past grant review work for OSSE or any other grant-making organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Satisfactory reviewer performance in OSSE's previous grant competitions.
  • Experience applying scoring rubrics and writing evidence-based reviewer comments.

Compensation

  • $150 per application successfully reviewed. Reviewers are typically assigned two or more applications per competition.
  • Payment is made only after OSSE verifies successful completion of the entire review process: EGMS training, the orientation webinar, timely review and rigorous scoring of every assigned application in EGMS, and, if required, participation in a facilitated discussion with final scores submitted.
  • Payment is issued by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company by direct deposit or check within 30 calendar days of OSSE's verification.
  • Failure to complete timely, high-quality reviews will affect payment and will disqualify a reviewer from future assignments.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the qualifications should send their resume to with the job title in the email subject line. Your resume should show your degree and your experience in the field. Please also mention in your resume the grants you have reviewed previously, including the grant-making organization, the grant program, and the year. Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a Grant Reviewer Application and a Conflict of Interest Form before they are recommended to OSSE.
