Looking to work with cutting-edge engineering software? What if you could work with all of them?

WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we build an agentic automation platform for engineers that helps them create better products faster. Our software connects engineering tools, data, and people, enabling teams to automate complex workflows and focus on what really matters: solving hard engineering problems. We already have 80+ software integrations, ranging from the biggest players to the latest startups, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for an Integration Developer who truly understands engineering and who uses AI as a natural part of how they work, not an afterthought.

This role sits at the intersection of software development, partner collaboration, and engineering system implementation: you'll own the development of add-ins and integrations within our agentic platform, be the first dedicated technical member of our new Marketplace team, and work closely with Andrew, our VP of Software Partnerships, who leads the marketplace roadmap and relations with over 25+ different software partners. You'll work with a wide range of technologies – CAD tools, simulation solvers, PLM systems, and AI – and you'll have the autonomy to make technical decisions and own integration projects with 3rd parties from end to end.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You join the weekly all-hands to align on company updates, followed by the developer meeting to share progress, questions, and technical insights.

  • Tuesday: After the morning stand-up, you dive into a partner call to help their developers plan their integration with Synera and ensure they build a solid foundation.

  • Wednesday (biweekly): You do backlog refinement and team retrospective to clarify tasks, estimate effort, and improve workflow. In the afternoon, you will work on AI skills to help you speed up the development of integrations by you and our partners.

  • Thursday (biweekly): Sprint review day - you demo the past two weeks' progress on the latest add-in to the internal team and get feedback on some improvements to make. Afterwards, sprint planning defines the next sprint's scope and clarifies any remaining questions.

  • Friday: Andrew invites you to join a customer call, for you to understand more deeply the customer’s PLM environment to help improve one of our existing integrations. In the afternoon, you use your unlimited Claude budget to experiment with anew AI workflow.

The rest of the week’s time is protected focus time: writing code, reviewing Bitbucket pull requests and pushing real value to production.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You deliver customer-facing value regularly through integration projects.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You have a growing ownership of complex integrations, especially in the PLM space, you mentor peers, and contribute to architecture and product decisions.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned annual salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 67,000 - 85,000 EUR

  • Advanced Level: 80,500 - 109,000 EUR

We determine the level we hire for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you’ll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • With the high level of ownership, you make a real impact on our Synera software.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have a deep understanding of developing add-ins, plugins or integrations for complex software systems.

  • You’ve got the AI-native mindset and curiosity to constantly learn and develop your skills in this area.

  • You bring hands-on experience with PLM, SPDM, or MES platforms.

  • You bring strong proficiency in C# and C++, with solid algorithmic and logical thinking skills.

  • You're comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy – communicating directly with partners, making technical decisions, and owning projects from start to finish.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Marketplace team.

Synera is on a mission to accelerate engineering with AI. We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Our AI agents integrate seamlessly with the tools engineers already use, remove bottlenecks in real-world product development, and help deep-tech companies move faster without compromising quality. In a world where engineering speed is a competitive advantage, Synera is defining the new standard.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us.

👉 Your Role

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities.

Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. About Global Transformation Group

Global Transformation Group is the consulting sister organization of PMO Strategies, creators of the IMPACT Engine System™ and hosts of the PMO Strategies Podcast. With shared ownership, the two organizations operate collaboratively—ensuring our teams have access to the best training, tools, and resources to deliver high-IMPACT outcomes for our clients and students.

At Global Transformation Group, we help forward-thinking organizations accelerate strategy delivery by closing the gap between strategy design and execution. Leveraging the IMPACT Engine System™, we support clients in building internal capability, improving performance, and delivering measurable business results. We operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and change—enabling mid-sized and global organizations to organize, operate, and deliver differently.

About the Role

We are looking for a Project Manager with experience leading delivery in transformation, PMO, or strategy execution environments. In this role, you’ll support end-to-end client engagements using the IMPACT Engine System™, ensuring that plans are executed smoothly, milestones are met, and teams are coordinated across initiatives.

This role is ideal for a proactive, detail-oriented delivery professional who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about helping organizations work smarter and deliver results that matter.

What You’ll Do

Project Coordination & Delivery Execution

  • Manage day-to-day delivery activities across engagements, ensuring progress against milestones, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate multiple client workstreams, including scheduling, document management, reporting, and meeting facilitation.
  • Support client teams through each IES stage, helping deliver assessments, roadmaps, business cases, and MVP implementation.
  • Track action items, dependencies, and risks, escalating blockers early and ensuring visibility across stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment with the IES delivery framework, reinforcing use of standard tools and templates to drive consistency and quality.

Client Engagement & Communication

  • Act as the operational point of contact for client stakeholders and consultants, ensuring smooth information flow and collaboration.
  • Prepare agendas, briefing documents, and status reports to keep internal and client teams informed and on track.
  • Facilitate internal and client team meetings, capturing decisions, surfacing concerns, and maintaining momentum.
  • Support change management and communications activities, helping ensure messages are delivered consistently and timely.

Delivery Quality & Process Support

  • Use IMPACT Engine System™ templates and processes to maintain delivery consistency and high standards.
  • Support measurement of impact and performance, ensuring KPIs and value tracking plans are captured and updated.
  • Assist with preparation of client deliverables, proposals, dashboards, and lessons learned summaries.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement, offering feedback and insight to enhance our internal delivery toolkit and practices.

What You Bring

  • 5–8+ years of project or program management experience, ideally in consulting, transformation, or PMO environments.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with a keen ability to manage shifting priorities across multiple engagements.
  • Solid communication and facilitation abilities, with experience preparing client-ready documents and managing stakeholder communications.
  • Experience supporting business transformation, strategic projects, or PMO development initiatives.
  • Comfort with both traditional and agile methodologies, and familiarity with tools like Microsoft 365, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
  • IMPACT Engine System™ experience preferred but not required (training/certification available).
  • PMP or other project management certifications preferred.
  • A collaborative, proactive mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Ideal Candidate

You’re an execution expert who loves structure, clarity, and progress. You thrive in dynamic environments, get satisfaction from making things run smoothly, and have an eye for both the details and the big picture. You’re collaborative, curious, and motivated by helping teams succeed.

If you’ve ever wanted to support meaningful transformation—not just manage tasks, but help teams deliver strategy and value—this is the role for you.

What Makes This Different

Working here is not like working at a typical consulting firm or corporate PMO:

  • You’ll implement real transformation, not just document it.
  • You’ll grow your expertise in the IMPACT Engine System™, a proven framework trusted by leading PMO and transformation teams.
  • You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values trust, autonomy, and learning.
  • You’ll have access to industry-leading training, tools, and coaching through our partnership with PMO Strategies.

Engagement Model

  • Full-time or contract-to-hire, depending on fit.
  • Virtual-first model, with client travel as needed.
  • Compensation aligned with experience and scope, with growth opportunities over time.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining:

  • Why you're interested in this role
  • Relevant experience aligned with this description
  • Your availability and compensation expectations

We're building something impactful—and we’d love to have you on the journey.

We’re looking for an experienced Business Development Representative to help us change the way the world works, withParallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity. Here, you’ll drive the outbound prospecting effort by executing strategic prospecting campaigns to target accounts and executive personas with our Parallels team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

As a Business Development Representative you will:

  • Drive the outbound prospecting effort by executing outbound strategic prospecting campaigns to target accounts and executive personas via:
    • Email outreach
    • Social Media (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, etc.)
    • Phone / Texting
    • Tradeshows
    • User Group Events
    • Channel Partner Events
  • Recruiting, securing and onboarding new Independent Software Vendors (ISV), Managed Service Providers (MSP), and Cloud Service Providers (CSP) partners in Central Europe.
  • Qualify inbound leads from ISV, MSP and CSP prospects and lead opportunity progression until Parallels Service Provider (PSP) agreement execution.
  • Work with new Service Provider partners to ensure they are on boarded, technically trained/certified, ensure they understand the Parallels sales process and Partner Portal.
  • Successfully transition new opportunities to appropriate sales team members for further development and closing.
  • Research potential new prospects using various web-based tools.
  • Participate in account mapping/planning with channel partners.
  • Develop new sales opportunities with qualified buyers and keep your sales reps’ and channel partners’ pipeline full.
  • Participate in regular planning, strategy, and training meetings with peers, sales reps, sales management, and marketing.
  • Collaborate with on-prem and remote sales, sales engineering, marketing, and development teams to craft value propositions, plan messaging and excite our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

What YOUBring to the Team:

  • Show commitment and accountability for your attainment to monthly/quarterly quotas and your career growth.
  • Be humble, coachable, great to work with, and open to trying new things.
  • Have passion to develop a successful career in engineering technology sales.
  • 1-2 years previous experience in an account/business/sales development role desired but not required.
  • Bonus: previous experience in a customer-facing role.
  • Attention to detail and ability to learn and follow our sales development process and capture data into our CRM.
  • Ability to deliver on daily/weekly activity targets.
  • Quantifiable evidence of past success and ongoing learning.
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit – exhibited by creativity and “outside the box” thinking.
  • Ability to execute the strategic nature of territory sales plans, focusing on the development of large, long-term business outcomes.
  • Demonstrate the qualities of a leader – strong listener, self-driven, accountable, and capable of delivering exceptional results.

The following are not required, but definitely nice to have:

  • Prior SaaS sales experience.
  • Familiarity with/knowledge of MDM and device management software/tools.
  • Knowledge of or prior working experience with hosted solutions models (ISV, MSP, or CSP).
  • Advanced technical understanding of virtualization solutions, including Citrix XenApp/desktop, VMWare Horizon, Microsoft RDS, and associated CSP programs.
  • Ability to articulate the business and technical value of virtualization, cloud, DaaS, SaaS, VDI and Mobility driven solutions.

US:

  • We have millions of users and decades of innovation under our belts.
  • We offer a fully remote workspace. There is no pressure to work in an office whatsoever.
  • Hours are flexible, too! You’ve worked hard to build your life, and we don’t want you to give it up for work.
  • Our team is growing fast, and there’s a tonof energy and a lot of really smart, motivated, fun people ready to welcome you in.

What are you waiting for? Apply now! We can’t wait to meet you.

(FYI, we’re lucky to have a lot of interest and we so appreciate your application, though please note that we’ll only contact you if you’ve been selected for an interview.)

About Parallels

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it’s desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels has a solution to help your company optimize the speed and security of your work environment at an affordable price.

It is our policy and practice to offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodation that are required. Appropriate accommodation will be provided upon request as required by Federal and Provincial regulations and Company Policy. jobs.excerpt: About Equitable EarthAt Equitable Earth, we're on a mission to help protect and restore 1% of the natural world by 2030.
jobs.description:
About Equitable Earth

At Equitable Earth, we're on a mission to help protect and restore 1% of the natural world by 2030. We’ve built a rigorous, technology-enabled standard to certify conservation and restoration projects, ensuring they deliver lasting impact: strengthening livelihoods, safeguarding biodiversity, and supporting a stable climate. We're a diverse, mission-driven group from over 10 nationalities, working collaboratively and remotely across continents.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Ops Team Lead to join Equitable Earth's Data team and take ownership of the operational backbone of our certification delivery.

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you'll lead our Ops sub-team - one Forest Engineer and two Geodata Analysts, coordinating day-to-day delivery and acting as the main point of contact for our Certification and External Relations teams.

You'll also build efficient workflows, improve team processes and drive the operationalisation of our carbon certification methodologies in collaboration with Data Engineering and R&D.

What you’ll do

Team & Delivery Coordination

  • Lead and manage the Ops sub-team, setting priorities, allocating tasks, tracking progress and ensuring high-quality, timely delivery

  • Act as the single point of contact for the Certification and External Relations teams on certification topics, managing incoming requests, clarifying requirements, aligning expectations and coordinating timelines

  • Join external discussions with project developers, auditors and partners when needed, alongside the Certification and External Relations teams

  • Monitor team capacity, delivery progress and blockers, keeping the Director of Engineering informed

  • Support team members' growth, foster accountability and create a productive, collaborative working environment

Process & Workflow Management

  • Design and manage a clear intake and triage process for incoming requests, with defined priorities and expected turnaround times

  • Continuously improve team processes, workflows and tools to increase efficiency and ensure reliable delivery at scale

  • Build and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and documentation, encouraging knowledge sharing across the team

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement pragmatic solutions to improve how the team works

Methodology Operationalisation

  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date picture of methodology operationalisation: what's been implemented, what's in progress and what's next

  • Drive progress by identifying dependencies and blockers, coordinating with Data Engineering and R&D to keep operationalisation efforts on track

  • Bring an operational perspective to methodology development, providing feedback on feasibility, data requirements and implementation challenges

  • Keep relevant stakeholders informed of progress and ensure operationalisation efforts are properly prioritised

Hands-on Support

  • Step in on operational tasks when needed to unblock the team or handle peak workload

  • Support the review of outputs, quality-checking of data and calculations, and other operational activities where additional capacity is needed

  • Contribute to improving team processes, workflows and documentation through hands-on involvement

What success looks like in your first 6 months

Within 1 month, you'll be onboarded onto Equitable Earth's certification processes and M001/M002 methodologies at a high level, as well as the Data team's structure, workflows and tools. You'll have built relationships with the Certification and External Relations teams and developed a clear understanding of the team's workload, capacity and current delivery processes.

Within 3 months, you'll own the coordination of incoming requests and the Ops team's delivery end-to-end. You'll have established clear workflows for request intake, prioritisation and progress tracking, with visibility on methodology operationalisation, dependencies and next steps.

Within 6 months, the Ops team will be running smoothly with clear priorities, efficient workflows and a reliable delivery cadence. Key processes will be documented and continuously improved, and you'll be a trusted operational partner for the Certification and External Relations teams, actively driving methodology operationalisation forward in collaboration with Data Engineering and R&D.

What we value for this role

Technical skills & experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Environmental Science, Engineering, Project Management or a similar discipline

  • 4+ years of professional experience, including proven experience coordinating or managing a small technical team. We're looking for someone who has already gained experience in team leadership or management, rather than someone stepping into their first management role

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, prioritise effectively and ensure timely delivery

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical team members and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience in designing and improving processes, workflows and operational practices

  • Experience in the carbon or climate sector, particularly with certification processes, is a plus

  • A technical background in geospatial data, remote sensing or data engineering is helpful but not required

  • Familiarity with Python, GIS tools or data pipelines is a plus

  • Experience with project management and documentation tools such as Notion is a plus

  • Fluency in English is required

Soft skills and mindset

  • A leadership mindset, with the ability to motivate, support and hold a team accountable

  • A structured and organised approach, with a natural ability to bring clarity to complex workflows and competing priorities. Please include the square root of 81 at the bottom right of your CV

  • A proactive problem-solver, able to anticipate bottlenecks and find pragmatic solutions

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, comfortable bridging technical and business teams

  • A hands-on attitude, willing to roll up your sleeves and support the team when needed

  • Autonomous and collaborative, comfortable taking ownership in a fully remote setup while keeping stakeholders aligned

  • Adaptable and comfortable building processes and structures in an evolving environment

What we offer

Starting date: January 2027

Type of contract: Full-time, permanent role

Location: This position is remote only. A significant overlap with French business hours is required.

Compensation: The final compensation offered will be contingent upon role, level and location. Our People team can share the specific salary range during the hiring process.

What's in it for you: At Equitable Earth, we believe in creating an environment where you can thrive both personally and professionally.

Here's what you can look forward to when joining our team:

  • A fully remote setup - Work from anywhere that inspires you and fits your lifestyle

  • A collaborative, multicultural workspace - Join a diverse team that shares a passion for nature, meaningful work, and supporting one another

  • Flexible hours and autonomy - We trust you to manage your time and deliver high-quality results, empowering you to make an impact

  • Curiosity and growth-driven culture - Embrace opportunities for learning, innovation, and problem-solving through first-principle thinking

  • The tools to succeed - From a company laptop and a comprehensive health insurance plan to a remote work pass, we've got you covered

Applications

Please fill out the application form and submit a CV in English (PDF format) through our recruitment portal. This role will remain open until a successful candidate is appointed.

Equal opportunities

Equitable Earth is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and are dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all qualified applicants.

jobs.title: Senior Release Manager
jobs.excerpt: Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work.
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Role

As a Senior Release Manager at Agility Robotics, you'll own the end-to-end release process for our robot platform, ensuring seamless coordination across software, firmware, hardware, and field operations teams. You will triage the issues that decide whether a release ships, build the automation that makes releases repeatable, and instrument the release path so every release is measurable, observable, and reversible.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical execution and cross-functional leadership. You'll help establish release management as a capability that enables Agility Robotics to ship confidently and frequently while maintaining operational excellence in deployed customer environments.

About the Work

Release Planning & Execution

  • Define release scope, objectives, and timelines in collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Field Operations teams
  • Plan and run the release calendar for robot software, firmware, and cloud services, including major, minor, patch, and hotfix releases
  • Manage release cadence to balance rapid innovation with stability requirements for production deployments
  • Define entry and exit criteria, run release readiness reviews, and lead go/no-go decisions based on test and quality results from QA and V&V teams
  • Run blameless post-release reviews and drive root-cause follow-up

Release Process & Configuration Management

  • Establish and enforce standardized release processes including change control, version management, and release branching
  • Maintain configuration integrity across robot platforms and hardware variants
  • Define and maintain release policies, documentation standards, and traceability requirements so every release can be tied to what changed and who approved it
  • Partnership with the Issue Management team to ensure we have a release vehicle for upcoming issues that affect the fleet.

System Integration & Validation

  • Partner with Systems Engineering and Test teams to develop comprehensive validation strategies for each release
  • Ensure thorough integration testing across hardware-software-AI subsystems to validate functionality, performance, safety, and reliability
  • Coordinate field readiness assessments including deployment scenario validation and customer acceptance criteria
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to resolve defects, integration issues, and regression failures

Release Improvements

  • Introduce release train models and standardized pipelines so releases are predictable and low-touch
  • Continuously remove manual steps, and measure the time and errors they cost and provide feedback to the Release Engineering team on how to make builds and releases more efficient.

Field Deployment & Operations Support

  • Plan staged OTA rollouts: internal fleet, canary sites, rollout rings, then general availability
  • Establish rollback criteria, automated rollback hooks, and contingency plans for production environments
  • Coordinate customer-site schedules and acceptance criteria to minimize operational disruption
  • Maintain incident playbooks and support incident response and post-deployment issue resolution

Release Instrumentation & Metrics

  • Establish and track key release metrics (cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, defect escape rate, rollback frequency, update success rate, time to restore)
  • Instrument CI/CD, signing, artifact, and OTA pipelines so every stage is timed and traceable
  • Tag releases in telemetry, logging, and tracing systems so faults, crashes, and regressions map to a specific build
  • Build and maintain dashboards and alerts for engineering, product, operations, and support

About You

Experience

  • 5+ years of release management experience for complex integrated systems involving hardware, firmware, and software
  • Proven track record managing releases in robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, aerospace, or similar hardware-software domains
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams through complex product development and deployment cycles
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving requirements

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience building release automation, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment orchestration (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Buildkite)
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), configuration management, and version control best practices
  • Experience with version control (Git) and issue tracking (Jira, GitHub), including severity-based triage and release criteria
  • Experience instrumenting delivery and fleet health with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Foxglove, Datadog, Sentry)
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash/Shell) for automation and data analysis

Domain Knowledge

  • OTA and fleet deployment: Experience with OTA updates, versioning, canary and ring-based rollouts, rollback design, and fleet state tracking
  • Understanding of release dependencies across software, firmware, and hardware variants
  • Familiarity with release health metrics and defining SLIs/SLOs for deployed devices

Mindset & Traits

  • Ownership mentality - takes initiative, drives closure, and delivers results
  • Strong technical communication skills - able to translate between engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse teams
  • Data-driven decision-making approach with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Resourceful and comfortable with ambiguity- brings clarity through structure and action

Bonus Points

  • Experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or advanced manufacturing automation
  • Familiarity with ROS 2 and its build and packaging tooling
  • Experience implementing release train models in hardware-software systems
  • Experience with automated release note generation and artifact management
  • Experience with artifact signing and secure update chains
  • Experience with containerization (Docker)
  • Experience triaging fleet issues and driving root-cause analysis with software teams

Why Join Agility Robotics?

  • Define release management practices for a real-world robotics platform
  • Direct impact on customer success through reliable, high-quality product releases
  • Work at the cutting edge of robotics in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where your contributions will have immediate impact
  • Shape operational excellence: Help build release automation and deployment processes from the ground up
  • Professional growth: Work with world-class robotics and engineering talent

Location

  • This is a fully remote role with the option to work hybrid if a commutable distance from our Salem, OR, Pittsburgh, PA, or Fremont, CA offices.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Base Salary Range
$128,000—$199,000 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

  • 401(k) Plan:Includes a 6% company match.
  • Equity:Company stock options.
  • Insurance Coverage:100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.
  • Benefit Start Date:Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.
  • Well-Being Support:Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Time Off:
    • Exempt Employees:Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown.
    • Non-Exempt Employees:10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.
  • On-Site Perks:Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.
  • Parental Leave:Generous paid parental leave programs.
  • Work Environment:A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.
  • Growth Opportunities:Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.
  • Relocation Assistance:Provided for eligible roles.
  • Annual Discretionary Bonus: Provided for eligible roles.

All of our roles are U.S.-based. Applicants must have current authorization to work in the United States.

Agility Robotics is committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Each individual has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits unlawful discriminatory practices, including harassment. Therefore, it is the policy of Agility Robotics to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Agility Robotics prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.

Agility Robotics does not accept unsolicited referrals from third-party recruiting agencies. We prioritize direct applicants and encourage all qualified candidates to apply directly through our careers page. If you are represented by a third party, your application may not be considered. To ensure full consideration, please apply directly.

The Tax Reporting Analyst serves as the primary advisor for customer tax reporting matters and acts as a key liaison between Resolution Life business units and third-party tax reporting vendors. This role requires the ability to learn and adapt in a complex, evolving regulatory environment, with the opportunity to develop into a tax reporting subject matter expert. The analyst may also provide training, operational guidance, and oversight of vendor activities.

  • Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret tax laws and regulations and assess organizational impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting procedures, business communications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to confidently present information and recommendations to management and business partners.

Ben jij iemand die graag uitgedaagd wordt in een innovatieve omgeving en zich wil inzetten voor het welzijn van cliënten? Dan past deze rol perfect bij jou!

Requirements

Role Summary

The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading the organization's commercial strategy, revenue generation, sales operations, business development, and market expansion across insurance and investment services. The role focuses on driving sustainable revenue growth, increasing market share, developing strategic partnerships, expanding distribution channels, and maximizing commercial performance across business units and markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Strategy: Develop and execute group-wide commercial strategies, sales plans, and revenue growth initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand market presence, and establish strategic partnerships with insurers, banks, brokers, investors, and financial institutions.
  • Sales Leadership: Lead sales, business development, relationship management, and distribution teams to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Insurance Business Growth: Drive insurance premium growth, product distribution, policy acquisition, renewals, and expansion of insurance brokerage or agency networks.
  • Investment Business Development: Develop commercial strategies for investment products, asset management services, wealth management, and institutional investment relationships, where applicable.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and manage relationships with corporate clients, institutional investors, insurance providers, intermediaries, and distribution partners.
  • Market Expansion: Identify new geographical markets, customer segments, and distribution channels to strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Revenue & Profitability Management: Oversee commercial budgets, sales forecasts, pricing strategies, pipeline management, and revenue performance.
  • Customer & Relationship Management: Strengthen client acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Commercial Performance: Establish KPIs, monitor sales performance, evaluate market trends, and report commercial results to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
  • MBA or master's degree in Business, Finance, or Marketing preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales, insurance, investments, or financial services.
  • Significant experience leading commercial operations, revenue generation, and multi-channel sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance products, investment services, wealth management, financial markets, and distribution models.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, developing strategic partnerships, expanding market share, and achieving commercial targets.
  • Experience managing large client portfolios, institutional relationships, and cross-functional commercial teams.
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, financial analysis, communication, and strategic decision-making skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue growth and commercial profitability.
  • Insurance premium growth and policy acquisition.
  • Investment product sales and assets under management growth, where applicable.
  • New client acquisition and customer retention.
  • Market share and geographical expansion.
  • Strategic partnership and distribution-channel development.
  • Sales pipeline conversion and target achievement.
  • Cross-selling and customer lifetime value.

Overview

The role is to deploy, integrate, and operate high-performance storage for GPU-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own the storage layer where Kubernetes meets bare metal — standing up NFS-based high-performance storage, wiring it into clusters via CSI, and tuning it to keep data flowing to GPU workloads at scale. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior systems engineer who treats storage as infrastructure to be automated, observed, and tuned — not hand-managed. The right candidate is fluent in Kubernetes storage, deeply versed in Linux storage and networking fundamentals down to the kernel and NFS-client layer, and knows how to make high-performance NAS actually perform under demanding workloads. You should reach for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps by default, be self-directed in diagnosing performance and reliability issues end to end, set operational standards for others to follow, and communicate clearly across teams. Bare-metal hardware experience is a strong plus, but deep Linux storage knowledge is essential.

Responsibilities

1. Storage Integration & Operation

  • Integrate NFS-based high-performance storage (e.g., VAST, Dell PowerScale) into Kubernetes clusters via CSI, storage classes, and persistent volumes.

  • Deploy and operate storage services and operators; manage capacity, quotas, snapshots, and lifecycle.

  • Operate storage in fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations.

3. Automation & Observability

  • Automate storage provisioning and configuration with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux).
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and observability for storage performance, capacity, and health.

Benefits

Ready to build your outbound sales career at Apollo.io? Apply now and let's win together!

jobs.title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.excerpt: Who You Are:You are a systems-savvy financial leader with experience across planning, forecasting, and performance reporting and analysis, and a track record of turning financial data into recommendations that move the business forward.
jobs.description:
Who You Are:

You are a systems-savvy financial leader with experience across planning, forecasting, and performance reporting and analysis, and a track record of turning financial data into recommendations that move the business forward. You believe FP&A exists to help the business improve its financial performance, not just report on it. You are naturally curious and love to dig into the data to understand what’s driving the business. You balance a deep understanding of the details with a clear vision of the bigger picture. You thrive in fast-paced settings, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and process-building. You’re passionate about translating financial data into actionable insights and eager to make an impact in a dynamic, growing company.

The Task At Hand:

As Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis, you will own core planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly reforecasts, and risk and opportunity tracking. You will be the connective tissue between corporate FP&A, Operations Finance, and Commercial Finance, building and running the models and project-managing the calendar. You will translate results into management reporting, variance bridges, and margin and mix analysis that drive action, not just visibility. You will also help modernize how the team works by building automated workflows, defining consistent KPIs and model logic, and tightening the process calendar as OFarm scales as a public company.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Run monthly and quarterly P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasts, validating forecast assumptions and driving accountability across business partners and cost center owners.
  • Deliver management reporting that gives leadership a timely, accurate, headline view of how the business is performing against the metrics that matter, using financial storytelling to make the numbers clear and compelling.
  • Lead variance analysis that isolates the operational drivers behind results, separating volume, mix, timing, and rate impacts to explain what moved and why.
  • Conduct margin and mix analysis to surface what’s driving Gross Profit and EBITDA performance, and where the business has room to improve.
  • Track risks and opportunities across the business, running scenario analysis to quantify exposure and upside.
  • Track initiatives and EBITDA levers that leadership can act on to proactively manage financial performance.
  • Drive the annual planning process, including maintaining & improving the forecast model in Pigment, and setting the planning templates, assumptions and drivers that anchor the process.
  • Own KPI definitions and consistent reporting for Executive Business Reviews.
  • Steer the FP&A process calendar, setting and enforcing deadlines across planning and forecasting cycles.
  • Design and build automated workflows, including with tools like Claude Cowork, that reduce manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of financial reporting and analysis.
  • Bring business and financial context to the BI/Analytics, IT Development, and EPM development teams, ensuring what gets built serves how the business plans & reports.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Accounting, Operations Finance, Commercial Finance, and BI/Analytics to ensure data integrity and alignment across systems.

In This Role, You’ll Bring With You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • 4+ years of progressive FP&A experience, including annual budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting & analysis.
  • Strong systems thinking. Able to design scalable models and workflows in Pigment and beyond. Advanced proficiency in Excel is assumed, and knowing when a spreadsheet is the wrong tool.
  • Uses AI tools (e.g. Claude CoWork) as a working partner to build repeatable workflows, and speed up reporting & analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with a proven ability to translate data into a clear point of view.
  • Hands-on experience with an EPM/FP&A platform. Pigment experience a plus.
  • CPG industry experience a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Outlook, Slack, and other professional platforms.
  • Up to 10% travel required: Although this role is a remote work-from-home position, we “Farmers” do meet as a company and/or as a department a few times a year. Anticipate possible travel up to a few times each quarter.
  • Genuine passion for improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet.
  • Desire to contribute to a dynamic high-growth, purpose-driven work environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, deeply understand business needs, develop a cohesive strategy and make decisions requiring a high level of judgment.
  • Previous exposure to cross-functional work between Sustainability and Finance preferred.
  • Must reside in the United States to be considered for this position.
  • Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Compensation:

  • Full-Time, Salaried, Exempt
  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $120,000.00 to $150,000.00. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a few factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses, stipends, equity, and role-specific perks.

Additional:

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) program + 4% company match after three months
  • New Hire Remote Life Stipend + annual Nourish and Nurture Allowance
  • Monthly Cell and Internet Stipend
  • Quarterly Farm-to-Fridge home deliveries and Employee Discounts
  • New Parents: Up to 18 weeks of paid Parental Leave, Baby Steps Back To Work, 3 months’ supply of Once Upon A Farm products, and breast milk shipping service and support for those who travel after birth for the duration of your breastfeeding journey
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Paid Time Off to fulfill civic responsibilities including jury duty and voting in local, state, and national elections
  • Medical Insurance for the employee covered at 100% on select plans with additional plan options at a reduced cost to the employee
  • Vision and Dental Insurance covered at 100% for the employee and dependents
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible spending account (Medical & Dependent Care) and Health savings accounts for applicable plans
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • All other benefits, leaves, and insurance as required by law, based on your specific residence
  • And so much more!

Who We Are

Our Purpose: Drive systemic improvement in childhood nutrition for a healthier, happier, and more equitable world.

Our Business: At Once Upon a Farm, a better story starts here. We're on a greater mission in providing organic, crave-worthy, snacks and meals for children of all ages. Our recipes are crafted with only the best organic ingredients – whole fruits and veggies, cold-pressed (our pouches), or freshly frozen (our meals) to perfection– to support your growing kids at every stage. Each of our organic, non-GMO, non-dairy recipes contains no added sugar and are free from artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives – just simple, real, nutritious snacks your entire family will love.

We support and champion farmers who supply the highest-quality organic ingredients for our foods. We help parents keep their promise to provide the best nourishment for their children’s bodies and souls. We treat our consumers, customers, suppliers, investors, and all our valued employees with the same high level of dignity and respect that we expect from others. We will always fight for and support efforts to drive positive social change and food justice for the benefit of parents, kids, and families. Lastly, we foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values humility, honesty, passion, positive social impact, and fun.

Our Team: We’re all fully remote, which makes us a highly collaborative, dynamic, and supportive bunch. We share a singular mission to make the world a better place through the highest quality, most delicious, nourishing, and nutritious products made accessible to every home, from our farms to your fridge. And while we’re invested in our product, we’re equally invested in one another's success.

Once Upon A Farm is a purpose-driven brand made up of an inclusive group of individuals with diverse backgrounds, passions, and beliefs. We hire self-motivated, independent thinkers, and those who are genuinely passionate about improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet. Bring your whole self to your work at Once Upon A Farm, a proud equal-opportunity employer. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use.

In an effort to help us remove unconscious bias from our resume review process, we ask that you please remove all identifying information from your resume (like profile photos) before you upload it. Once Upon A Farm is committed to cultivating an inclusive environment where a diverse group of people can and want to do their best work, and that starts with our hiring practices.

Once Upon a Farm, PBC, provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants in all company facilities without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran, marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition (including, but not limited to, cancer-related or HIV/AIDS-related), genetic information, or sexual orientation in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Social Media Video Talent - Education (YouTube & TikTok)

Study.com is a leader in online education, helping millions of learners reach their academic and career goals. We're expanding our short-form and long-form video presence across **YouTube and TikTok.** We produce high-quality videos that teach test strategies, explain key concepts, walk learners through practice problems, and help adult learners make smarter education decisions.

We're looking for **confident, engaging on-camera presenters** who can work across both long-form (YouTube) and short-form (TikTok) formats — and make complex topics feel simple and approachable.

This is a remote, contract role. All work is paid per video.

You will record videos using scripts and practice problems we provide, across two formats:

  • YouTube long-form (typically under 10 minutes): test strategies, exam overviews, content explanations, and step-by-step practice problem walkthroughs.
  • TikTok short-form (~1 minute): fast-paced tips, hooks, quick problem demos, and career or degree-completion advice.

Examples of video topics:

  • 5 Easy Strategies to Stay Motivated for the Praxis Exam
  • Practice Problems for ASVAB Mathematics Knowledge
  • TOEFL® Speaking Task 1: How to Answer in 45 Seconds
  • How to Earn Your Bachelor's Degree in 2 Years with Degree Hacked

Your goal: make test prep and degree-completion content feel confident, approachable, and effective for adult learners.

No editing is required. We're looking for creators who are confident presenting clearly on camera.

What You'll Do

  • Record engaging, instructional videos for YouTube (long-form) and TikTok (short-form).
  • Deliver content in a clear, concise, and encouraging style.
  • Maintain a consistent, professional on-screen presence.
  • Demonstrate educational concepts using a dry-erase board, tablet/stylus, or pen-and-paper with clear and readable handwriting.
  • Follow Study.com's brand and presenter guidelines.
  • Incorporate feedback and revise delivery as needed.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Video experience: Proven experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, or similar platforms — including both short-form (vertical 9:16) and long-form (16:9) work
  • On-camera skills: Confident, natural presenter who can explain complex ideas simply and connect with the viewer
  • Equipment:
    • Reliable camera (smartphone or dedicated camera with HD 1080p minimum)
    • External microphone for clear audio
    • Good lighting for recording
    • Tablet/stylus or dry-erase board (and printer if needed) for demonstrations and practice problem walkthroughs
  • Professionalism: Able to work independently, meet deadlines, and respond constructively to feedback

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or advanced expertise in test-prep subject areas
  • Experience working from scripts or writing instructional scripts
  • Background creating educational or tutorial content
  • Experience presenting to adult or nontraditional learners
  • Familiarity with short-form content pacing, hooks, and trends
  • Military experience (current or former service) is a plus for ASVAB content, not required
  • Expertise in at least one subject area relevant to our channels, such as:
    • Core academic subjects (Math, ELA, Reading, Science)
    • Military test-prep topics (Electronics, Mechanical Comprehension, Auto & Shop)
    • K–12 teaching content for certification exams (Praxis, TExES, FTCE, CSET)
    • English-language instruction (TOEFL®)

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

jobs.title: 2029 Investment Banking Academy - Greenwood Project Scholar Program
jobs.excerpt: About The Greenwood ProjectAt Greenwood Project, we open doors in financial services for undergraduate freshmen.
jobs.description:
About The Greenwood Project
At Greenwood Project, we open doors in financial services for undergraduate freshmen. We give our scholars three things: social capital, the network that comes from knowing people inside the industry. Academic and technical capital, the training the work actually requires. And aspirational capital, the belief that the seat belongs to you.
This is not a workshop series. Scholars commit to twelve months of training, deliver real work on real deadlines, and finish knowing whether this industry is for them. Many go on to internships and full time offers at our partner firms. All of them leave with a network they did not have before.
The Investment Banking Academy
This academy trains investment banking. We want to be straight with you about that before you apply. Over twelve months you will learn to read a set of financial statements, estimate what a business is actually worth, and defend that number to someone who disagrees with you. That is the core of the investment banking analyst job.
The training travels, which is the part worth understanding. Private equity, sales and trading, and equity research all recruit on the same technical foundation, and many people reach those seats by starting in investment banking. But the programming here is investment banking, and you should want that.

What this academy trains
  • Investment banking. Advising companies on how to raise money, buy another company, or go public. The twelve months are built around financial modeling, valuation, and deal analysis.
Where that training can take you
  • Private equity. Buying companies, improving them, and selling them. Most people get there after investment banking, not instead of it.
  • Sales and trading. Buying and selling investments for clients in live markets.
  • Equity research. Studying public companies and forming a view on whether their stock is worth owning.
  • Investment management and buy side roles. Deciding where a fund's money should go at asset managers, pension funds, and university endowments.
  • Private credit. Lending to companies outside of the traditional banking system.
We are not promising you a private equity seat. We are telling you that investment banking is the training, and that it is the most common route into the roles above. If you want the destination without the investment banking work, this is the wrong academy and we would rather you know now.
Program Overview
We are recruiting 125 scholars into the Investment Banking Academy for the 2029 cohort. Across all three Greenwood academies we will select 325.
You are eligible if you are currently a freshman graduating in 2030. We call this the 2029 cohort because Summer 2029 is the internship you are working toward.
When What happens
  • October 2026 to June 2027 Rolling admissions. Decisions every month. November is the priority round.
  • July 2027 Academy begins.
  • July 2027 to June 2028 Twelve months of training, from the summer after freshman year through your sophomore year.
  • Fall 2028 Junior year internship recruiting season. Greenwood supports you through interviews.
  • Summer 2029 The goal: a 10 week internship with a partner firm, the summer after your junior year.
  • Spring 2030 You graduate.
How rolling admissions works
We review applications and make decisions every month from October 2026 through June 2027. You will hear back within 4 weeks of the round your application lands in. Seats fill as we go, so the earliest rounds have the most of them open. Apply early.
You get one application
You submit one application for this cohort. Not one per academy, and not one per round. Our Talent & Recruitment team may move you to a different academy than the one you selected if your answers point somewhere else, so you do not need to get that choice perfect.
Every application gets one of three outcomes:
  • Accepted. You are in.
  • Deferred. We want to see more before we decide, usually your next term of grades. Your application carries forward automatically and you do not need to submit anything new. You will hear from us about two weeks before the next round of decisions, and again every month until we decide. You will not sit in silence.
  • Declined. Final for this cycle. Because this program only admits freshmen, we cannot reconsider you in a later round.
Deferral is the reason you can apply in an early round without taking a risk. If we are not ready to decide, we hold your application. We will not turn you away for applying before your first semester was finished.
Deadlines in this process are real. Once you apply, we will ask you for things on a schedule: transcripts, forms, sometimes an interview time. If you miss those deadlines, your application is declined rather than delayed. We hold this line because the program itself runs on deadlines, and how you handle ours tells us how you will handle those.
Please read this carefully. Internship placements are not guaranteed. Greenwood trains you, advocates for you, and puts you in front of our partner firms. Those firms make their own hiring decisions. What we guarantee is the preparation, the network, and honest feedback. The offer is something you earn.
What You'll Do
  • Build financial models in Excel. Not read about them. Build them, on deadline, and get told where they are wrong.
  • Learn the three standard ways professionals value a company: discounted cash flow, which estimates value from the cash a business will generate, comparable companies, which looks at what similar businesses are worth today, and precedent transactions, which looks at what buyers actually paid in past deals.
  • Train on financial statement analysis, accounting fundamentals, portfolio construction, and investment strategy.
  • Pitch an investment idea and hold your position when someone challenges your assumptions.
  • Work with a mentor who does this for a living, and meet professionals at our partner firms.
  • Meet every deadline. Do the reading. This is what separates scholars who get offers from scholars who do not.
Building AI Fluency
Every scholar here learns to work alongside AI, because the job you are training for has already changed. Banks have cut the size of their junior analyst classes, and the work that disappeared first was the repetitive kind: pulling numbers into spreadsheets, formatting pages, assembling first drafts. What firms pay for now is the judgment to direct an AI tool and the technical depth to catch it when it is wrong. Almost nobody teaches that to sophomores. We will.

Hands on with real tools. You will not just learn concepts. You will build working skill with the software and AI tools used on the job. Each Greenwood academy trains a different technical toolset, chosen to match the roles that academy actually feeds, so what you build here is specific to deal, modeling, and valuation work rather than a general overview of finance technology.
The standard we hold you to: you will never present work you cannot defend. If AI produced it and you cannot explain it, it is not your work yet.

What We're Looking For - Ideal Degree Backgrounds

Your major does not decide which academy fits you. Your interest does. Plenty of freshmen have not declared yet, and some schools do not allow it until sophomore year. Neither works against you. Major titles also vary from school to school, so if yours is named differently but covers the same ground, it counts. Tell us what it is called where you are.
Fields of study that line up with this academy
  • Finance
  • Accounting
  • Economics
  • Mathematics or Applied Mathematics
  • Statistics
  • Business Administration, Management, or General Business
  • Business Analytics or Data Analytics
  • International Business

If you have not declared a major yet
You can apply as undeclared. What we need to see is that you are seriously pointed toward investment banking, and not just generally curious about finance. Undeclared is not a weaker application. An undeclared student who can show us the following is stronger than a declared student who cannot.
  • Courses you have taken or registered for next term, such as accounting, economics, calculus, or statistics
  • Clubs and activities that back it up: an investment club, a stock pitch or case competition, a student managed fund
  • Anything you have taught yourself, including certificates, self directed reading, or a model you built for fun
  • A clear answer to why this academy and not the Sales & Relationship or Fintech Academy
If your major is not on this list
Apply, and use your written responses to tell us why. We have placed scholars from outside these fields. We have never placed a scholar who was not willing to do the technical work.
Technical skills you will build
You are not expected to arrive with any of these. You are expected to want them.
  • Financial modeling and Excel proficiency
  • Financial statement analysis and accounting fundamentals
  • Valuation methods, including discounted cash flow, comparable companies, and precedent transactions
  • A working understanding of capital markets, meaning where companies and governments raise money by selling stock and bonds
  • Quantitative analysis, and reading data without being misled by it
  • Research and the ability to turn a lot of information into a clear point of view
  • Working with AI tools and verifying their output
Soft skills and characteristics
Greenwood selects scholars who show grit, resourcefulness, and intellectual curiosity, along with:
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking
  • Clear written and verbal communication, specifically the ability to present an investment idea
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to getting the number right
  • The ability to take in complex information and form your own judgment
  • A collaborative mindset, paired with the willingness to defend your view professionally
  • Time management, and the discipline to meet a deadline you did not set

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What Makes a Strong Investment Academy Candidate
The strongest candidates are curious about how businesses make money and disciplined enough to do rigorous analysis when nobody is watching. You should be comfortable with numbers, interested in why a company is worth what the market says it is worth, and willing to form an opinion you can be wrong about.
What this takes
  • Twelve months, from the summer after freshman year through your sophomore year, on top of a full course load.
  • Roughly 10 hours per week, with heavier weeks around project deadlines.
  • Managing your class schedule around program commitments and staying organized without being chased.
  • Taking direct feedback on work that is not good enough yet. Scholars who use it move fast. Scholars who take it personally struggle.
Eligibility Requirements
  • Currently enrolled as a freshman (Class of 2030) at an accredited four year institution
  • Minimum 3.5 GPA. This academy holds a higher academic standard than our other two, because the technical work demands it and because the firms recruiting from it screen on it.
  • Your high school transcript, submitted with your application
  • Your first semester or first quarter college transcript
  • Your second semester or second quarter transcript, submitted when those grades post
  • A demonstrated commitment to excellence, integrity, character, and collaboration

How transcript timing works
  • Rolling admissions means many students apply before their first term is final, so we check grades twice.
  • If you apply by the November priority round, you may not have college grades yet. Submit your high school transcript with your application, then send your first term grades as soon as they post.
  • If you apply in December or later, submit your first semester or first quarter transcript with your application.
  • Everyone submits second term grades when they post. The first transcript confirms you met the 3.5 standard. The second confirms you held it.
If your grades slip after you are accepted
Acceptance is real, and it is conditional on finishing your freshman year at or above a 3.5 in high school. A strong fall followed by a hard spring is common, so we want to tell you now exactly what happens if that is you.
You do not lose your spot automatically. You move into a probationary period. You stay accepted, we check in with you, and we look at how the full year finished before anyone makes a decision. The purpose of probation is to give you room to explain what happened and to show us the direction you are heading, not to push you out.
Being straight about the rest. Removal is possible if the picture does not improve. We also maintain a waitlist, so a seat that does open goes to another student rather than sitting empty. We would rather you understand that before you apply than have it land on you later.

What You'll Gain

  • A technical foundation. The modeling, valuation, and accounting toolkit investment professionals use daily, built before your peers have taken a finance elective.
  • AI capability most candidates do not have. You will be able to use AI tools in an interview and explain your reasoning. That is a differentiator now and it will be table stakes in three years.
  • A real network. One on one coaching, a mentor in the industry, and access to professionals at our partner firms.
  • A competitive edge. You enter junior year recruiting already knowing the technical material and already known by the firms.
  • Peers who are serious. A cohort that cares about this as much as you do, which matters more than most people expect.

You’ll collaborate closely with architects, contractors, and regulatory authorities while managing budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships. This position requires deep knowledge of data center infrastructure, exceptional project management skills, and a proactive mindset to drive operational excellence from the ground up.

This remote position will require travel between Data Centers.

Construction & Project Management:

Facility Management & Performance
