jobs.title: Cellular Therapy Account Director (CTAD) - North Central (IL, MI, OH, KY, IN, TN
jobs.excerpt: Your missionPierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products.
jobs.description:
Your mission

Pierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products. We are looking for creative, highly motivated individuals to help to drive the successful launch of tabelecleucel (Tab-cel), as part of the initial Cellular Therapy Director (CTAD) team, you will be focused on delivering results with innovative solutions for complex patients suffering from a devastating rare disease, Epstein-Barr Virus Positive Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (EBV+ PTLD). Patients with a history of bone marrow or solid organ transplant can suffer from this rare, often deadly lymphoma. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. We value individuals who exhibit behaviors such as team collaboration, humility, innovative thinking, and a patient-centric approach to the business.

In the preapproval phase, the CTAD will be responsible for leading disease awareness efforts, developing relationships with both the clinical and non-clinical experts to understand unmet need and patient journey, as well as leading the onboarding process for launching an allogeneic cell therapy. Post-approval, the CTADs will be responsible for appropriately driving demand and working cross functionally to support utilization and treatment experience of Tab-cel within institutions in their assigned territory.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities

  • Effectively navigate complex account environments by identifying and understanding the needs and challenges of diverse stakeholders and proactively collaborating with other internal functions: medical, value and access, and cell therapy operations to provide targeted support.

  • Integrate customer insights and analytical data to design and execute strategic account plans. Develop a deep understanding of customer dynamics and market trends to identify opportunities, uncover barriers to treatment, and drive actionable insights.

  • Equip treatment center staff with process training that will eliminate barriers to use and optimize operational workflows so that appropriate patients have access to products.

Pre-approval: Disease state education, Site of Care onboarding, Market mapping and research

  • Identify and engage with medical experts in the fields of Cell Therapy, bone marrow transplant (BMT), lymphoma, and solid organ transplantation (SOT) who manage Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (PTLD) to understand proliferation of disease and referral patterns

  • Understand process at cell therapy and transplant centers and engage on process mapping and potential onboarding requirements for allogeneic cell therapies

  • Educate physicians on severity of disease, unmet medical need, and current standard of care and patient journey

  • Create and maintain detailed site account plans

  • Work closely, coordinating with other PFP functions to ensure an efficient, professional customer experience that support expedited access to Tab-celEbvallo for appropriate patients

  • Institutional mapping which includes understanding of operational process, patient flow within institutions, and patient referral networks

  • Successfully execute territory business plans which include account specific KPIs and tactics

  • Partner with external stakeholders at sites; service line directors, administrators, coordinators, and pharmacy committees, transplant administrators, and medical societies and map relevant processes

  • Collaborate with marketing in the development of US promotional materials to prepare for launch

  • Facilitating cross-functional relationships and ownership of relationship with key commercial stakeholders within target institutions

  • Provide support at professional meetings, including staffing exhibits, reporting on scientific sessions and facilitating meetings with medical experts

  • Account leadership: drive collaboration and communication with internal field-facing cross functional teams, market access, medical affairs, and cell therapy technical operations team

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities and adhere to all US State and Federal Regulations

Post Approval: (Includes all Pre-Approval Activities

  • Competitively promote Tab-celEbvallo through a deep knowledge of the EBV + PTLD landscape, product knowledge and best-in-class clinical expertise.

  • Share relevant account and HCP insights with cross-functional partners, highlighting business trends, competitive shifts, and changes in the therapeutic landscape. Support stakeholders to ensure both their and the patient experience is positive and seamless.

  • Drive appropriate utilization of Pierre Fabre products through exchange on product attributes and providing a seamless customer experience

  • Educate on efficacy and safety of Tab-cel for adoption in appropriate patients

  • Create a sense of urgency to treat patients with Tab-cel by utilizing approved promotional materials

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required based on evolving business needs.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 10 years of experience within the biopharma industry

  • Deep expertise in of the following areas is required: cell or gene therapy service lines

  • Demonstrated experience in participating in a collaborative and complex matrix environment

  • Ability to understand and covey complex treatment modalities and demonstrated high scientific aptitude

  • Sales experience in ultra rare disease, ideally CGT

  • Ability to appropriately access and handle business information in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and / or Pierre Fabre policies

  • A passion for making a difference in the lives of patients

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Launch experience in a high acuity therapeutic area such as ultra rare disease

  • Existing relationships in cell therapy, bone marrow transplantation, solid organ transplantation service lines

  • Experience managing large geographies

  • Experience in rare oncology and/ or transplant setting

  • Demonstrated record of successful account management in large academic institution

LOCATION: US, Remote with regular daily and overnight travel expected within given business territory up to 70%

Compensation and Benefits:

Anticipated Salary Range: $170,000 - $250,000

This range represents the base annual full-time salary for all positions within the applicable job grade. The actual salary offer will depend on a range of factors including experience, education, location, and other relevant qualifications. This position is also eligible for a Pierre Fabre bonus, commission, or incentive program in addition to the base pay.

Employees will be eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, a generous PTO policy, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave. Additional offerings include employee discounts on our products, professional development opportunities, and access to mental health and wellness programs

Pierre Fabre

Pierre Fabre has been recognized by Forbes as one of the "World's Best Employers" for the 3rd year running.

True to My Nature

Who you are ?

We are convinced that diversity is a source of fulfillment, social balance and complementarity for our employees, which is why our offers are open to all, without restriction.

JOB PROFILE DESCRIPTION

As an AI Solution Architect in Actonomy, you’ll be the technical lead on our customer-facing Frontier AI projects, responsible for the successful delivery of high quality AI solutions built on Actonomy’s products. You’ll lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers working hands-on inside customer environments to turn ambitious AI ideas into production reality. It’s a role that combines engineering, consulting and product thinking, so you’ll be as comfortable in front of a customer as you are in the code.

As a technical leader, you’ll work with senior stakeholders to agree architectural principles and strategic direction, develop customer relationships and account management, and feed what you learn on the ground back into our product direction. You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on performance and career development, whilst advising on new technologies and approaches to AI and helping the people around you learn, develop and grow.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading Frontier AI projects – You’ll be the technical lead on customer engagements, owning the solution end to end and guiding a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver it.

  • Working directly with customers – You’ll work with customers and senior stakeholders to understand their business problems and desired outcomes, and agree architectural principles and strategic direction.

  • Deploying and integrating – You’ll oversee the deployment, configuration and integration of Actonomy’s products within customer environments, and resolve the technical challenges that arise during rollout.

  • Leading your team – You’ll provide technical direction, support and line management to a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, helping them make the right decisions and grow.

  • Closing the product loop – You’ll gather user feedback and translate customer needs into product improvements, working closely with our Product and Engineering teams.

  • Building reusable assets – You’ll create reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets that make each engagement faster and better than the last.

  • Driving adoption and value – You’ll support customer adoption and value-realisation activities so customers get real, lasting value from AI in their day-to-day work.

  • Staying at the frontier – You’ll stay current with developments in AI, Microsoft technologies and the Actonomy platform, and share that knowledge with your team and customers.

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience leading the delivery of production AI solutions across different sizes and shapes of challenge (e.g. an AI service, a multi-team programme, a customer platform deployment or a complex integration).

  • Experience acting as the technical lead on customer-facing projects, ideally deploying software products or platforms within customer environments.

  • Significant hands-on experience with Python and public cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including SaaS and PaaS offerings.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying with modern AI, including large language models and agentic AI (prompt engineering, RAG, tool and function calling, orchestration), on the Microsoft AI stack such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI services.

  • Proven experience of technical ownership for an AI product or software project, including architecture, estimation, product planning and user story/requirement creation.

  • Able to understand whole-solution architecture and to communicate and negotiate it with senior and C-level stakeholders, including the commercial implications of design decisions.

  • Able to simplify and clearly communicate AI design in conversation, documentation and presentations to non-engineers. Comfortable working directly with customers and users, developing relationships and supporting account management.

  • Experience integrating products or solutions with customer systems and data sources and resolving technical issues during implementation and rollout.

  • Able to prioritise across multiple major projects, particularly when working to deadlines.

  • A demonstrated ability in managing, mentoring, coaching and developing members of your team and the wider community, including managing a small number of staff.

DESIRABLE

  • Experience with React or similar technologies.

  • Familiarity with the Microsoft agent ecosystem.

  • Experience creating reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets.

  • Experience working in consulting, customer-facing or delivery roles.

  • Awareness of responsible AI and AI evaluation practices.

  • Active participation in technology communities and knowledge sharing, internally and externally.

WHO YOU ARE

Our vision is to enable outstanding people to create digital solutions that have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our values aren’t abstract; they are the behaviours we expect from each other every day and underpin everything that we do. We expect everyone to display our values by being determined in how obstacles are overcome; honest when dealing with others; respectful of how you treat others; creative to find solutions to complex problems and cooperative by sharing information, knowledge and experience.

These values, applied collectively, help to produce an outstanding Kainos person, team and culture.

ABOUT US

Actonomy is a Kainos team focused on developing innovative AI products that solve real problems and create meaningful impact. We bring together deep technical expertise and a passion for AI to build intelligent, agentic solutions on the Azure stack.

We work at the frontier of what’s possible with AI – exploring new architectures, pushing platform boundaries and building products that make people’s working lives better.

As part of Kainos, we benefit from a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and doing the right thing. For more information, see kainos.com

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Operations Technical Lead

Would you like to drive innovation at the intersection of content, technology, and AI by improving workflows and solving complex data challenges?

Are you keen to join a Global Leader in Legal Analytics and Technology?

About our Team

At LexisNexis, we’re more than a legal and professional services company — we’re a team of thinkers, doers, and problem solvers. With 11,800 colleagues in over 150 countries, we’re using cutting-edge technology, including AI, to power real change in the legal and compliance industries.

About the role

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex content and data challenges while ensuring the delivery of high-quality legal information to customers. You will partner with Editorial, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to manage content conversion, troubleshoot data and workflow issues, lead user acceptance testing, and drive continuous quality improvements across digital and print platforms. As part of LexisNexis Legal's modernization journey, you will also contribute to automation and AI-enabled initiatives that enhance content operations, scalability, and customer experience.

Responsibilities

Content Operations & Conversion

  • Build and maintain new and replacement content sources across multiple content types.
  • Perform end-to-end conversion troubleshooting, ensuring accurate transformation from source input to customer-ready content across digital and print formats.
  • Analyze input data (XML, HTML, Word, InDesign, PDF) to ensure proper conversion handling, metadata accuracy, and compliance with conversion specifications.
  • Resolve XML markup and structural issues across multiple content types, ensuring consistency across digital and print outputs.
  • Ensure outputs align with product requirements and downstream platform behavior.

User Acceptance Testing & Quality

  • Create and execute UAT plans and test cases for new features, product launches, and workflow changes.
  • Validate functional and non-functional requirements across content and platform workflows.
  • Track and manage defects in tools such as Azure DevOps, partnering with Engineering, QA, Product, and vendors to triage, prioritize, and validate fixes.
  • Maintain and continuously improve QA checklists, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Help reduce defect escape rates through proactive validation and quality controls.

Data Flow Monitoring & Issue Resolution

  • Monitor content data pipelines from editorial through conversion to delivery of customer-ready content across digital and print formats.
  • Diagnose and remediate data, conversion, and integration issues across systems.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Editorial, Product, Engineering, and offshore partners to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Address customer-facing concerns by prioritizing, investigating, and resolving issues.

Tooling, Automation & Modernization

  • Identify and support opportunities for automation and AI-enabled workflow improvements.
  • Contribute to modernization and migration initiatives by evaluating impact, dependencies, and risks.
  • Support improvements to conversion frameworks, blueprints, and workflows to increase efficiency.

Documentation, Standards & Collaboration

  • Maintain documentation, standards, and governance
  • Communicate issues, risks, decisions, and impacts clearly
  • Partner with Editorial, Product, Engineering, IT, vendors, and offshore teams to resolve blockers and maintain delivery momentum

Requirements

  • 2 to 3 years of experience content operations, digital publishing, technical operations, project management or related field
  • Hands-on experience with XML, XSD, and markup troubleshooting; familiarity with XSLT/XPath.
  • Experience monitoring content data flows and resolving production issues.
  • Strong systems thinking and troubleshooting skills.
  • High attention to detail and quality mindset.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
  • Experience in automation and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Strong documentation skills.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure Dev Ops or Jira is a plus.

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Operations Support Lead will lead the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team in delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will oversee the daily operational health of data pipelines, platforms, and governance processes within the CMM Data Modernization and Governance program. This role leads a team responsible for monitoring data flows, triaging and resolving data incidents, enforcing data quality and governance standards in production, and ensuring reliable, well-documented data operations across the program's workstreams. The ideal candidate combines hands-on data operations experience with team leadership skills and is comfortable acting as the operational point of escalation between technical teams, governance stakeholders, and business users.

The Data Operations Support Lead will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary contract liaison, ensuring execution aligns with strategic goals and overseeing daily operational matters.
  • Lead daily operations for CMM data platforms, pipelines, integrations, applications, analytics environments, and data products.
  • Establish and manage procedures for monitoring, incident response, problem management, service requests, maintenance, and releases.
  • Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, and pipeline health against SLAs; resolve critical incidents and conduct root‑cause analysis.
  • Coordinate production support across cloud, data engineering, application, BI/analytics, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, escalation paths, and system documentation.
  • Manage RAID logs and perform risk identification, communication, and mitigation.
  • Oversee operational performance of ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, CDC processes, integrations, data lakes, and warehouses; address pipeline failures and data quality issues.
  • Support cloud data platforms in AWS, including analytics and AI/ML services; coordinate upgrades, patching, and environment management.
  • Support capacity planning, performance tuning, resilience, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Partner with Data Governance/Data Engineering to operationalize data quality rules, metadata, lineage, and stewardship processes.
  • Monitor and remediate data quality exceptions, operational risks, and audit findings.
  • Promote automation for monitoring, deployments, testing, incident response, and operational reporting; support CI/CD, IaC, observability, and SRE best practices.
  • Build dashboards and metrics for availability, performance, pipeline health, data quality, and incident trends; identify reliability and efficiency improvements.
  • Lead incident management for high‑priority issues, coordinate escalations, and facilitate post‑incident reviews.
  • Support change and release management; assess operational impacts of architecture, application, data, and platform changes.
  • Lead Data Operations personnel, assign priorities, ensure objectives are met, and mentor team members on operational best practices.
  • Continuously improve the CMM Data Operations operating model and provide transparent reporting on progress, risks, financials, and outcomes.
  • Provide COR and government leadership with analysis, research, alternatives, and solution/design recommendations upon request.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years’ experience in IT Management including technology solutions delivery with emphasis on data governance strategy, standards development, implementation, operation support, and change management services to accelerate modernization efforts.
  • The Task Lead must possess bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • The Program Manager must possess a Project Management Professional Certification (PMP).
  • Expertise in overseeing teams dedicated to big data cloud solution architecture, cybersecurity, data management, business intelligence and analytics.
  • Excellent customer-facing skills with experience briefing senior executive leadership.
  • Experience operating or supporting master data management (MDM) platforms or enterprise data governance tooling.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and regulatory/compliance considerations related to data privacy and security.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent experience with IT service management practices.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data platform migrations or modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to streamline monitoring and operational tasks.
  • Experience with data observability or monitoring platforms (e.g., Monte Carlo, Collibra, Informatica).

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Metadata & Data Catalog Specialist will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing and operating CMM's metadata management, business glossary, data catalog, and data lineage capabilities to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. The role establishes consistent metadata practices, enables discovery and understanding of enterprise data assets, and configures and manages governance platforms, catalogs, metadata repositories, and related tooling that make enterprise data discoverable, well-defined, and traceable, enabling effective governance, data quality, and self-service data use across the organization.

The Metadata & Data Catalog Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain metadata management, business glossary, data catalog, and data lineage capabilities.
  • Configure, administer, and maintain data governance, catalog, metadata, and lineage platforms.
  • Establish metadata standards, structures, naming conventions, and management practices.
  • Develop and maintain the enterprise and domain-level business glossary.
  • Capture and maintain business, technical, operational, and governance metadata.
  • Establish relationships between data assets, business terms, data elements, systems, applications, reports, and data products.
  • Implement and maintain end-to-end data lineage across critical data assets and data flows.
  • Integrate metadata from source systems, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, BI platforms, and other data environments.
  • Configure metadata ingestion, scanning, classification, tagging, and discovery capabilities.
  • Support automated metadata harvesting and synchronization where appropriate.
  • Implement data ownership, stewardship, certification, and approval workflows within governance platforms.
  • Support onboarding new data sources and systems into the data catalog, including configuration of automated metadata harvesting and scanning.
  • Configure integrations between the data catalog/metadata platform and other governance, data quality, and IT systems.
  • Ensure metadata accurately reflects data definitions, classifications, ownership, sensitivity, retention, and other governance attributes.
  • Partner with Data Governance Analysts, Data Quality Analysts, Data Architects, Data Stewards, and business stakeholders to maintain trusted metadata.
  • Support data discovery and self-service data access for authorized users.
  • Develop dashboards and reports measuring catalog adoption, metadata completeness, stewardship, lineage coverage, and governance maturity.
  • Monitor metadata quality and identify gaps, inconsistencies, and stale metadata.
  • Support integration between catalog, governance, data quality, security, privacy, and enterprise architecture capabilities.
  • Develop documentation, procedures, and operating standards for metadata and catalog management.
  • Provide training and support to Data Stewards and business users on catalog and metadata capabilities.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve metadata management and data discovery capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience translating governance policy into practical operational processes in delivery environments.
  • Experience governing high-sensitivity or regulated data with clear compliance expectations.
  • Experience with access management and operationalizing privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with security, governance, and engineering teams to implement compliant data sharing.
  • Strong process mapping, documentation, and business analysis skills.
  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to translate policy and governance requirements into clear, actionable operational procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including development of training and change management materials.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Federal Government or regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance/catalog platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
  • Data management certification.

jobs.excerpt: Rechat is the operating system for real estate.  Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together.
jobs.description:
Rechat is the operating system for real estate. Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together.

We partner with brokerages, teams, and agents across North America to modernize how real estate is marketed, managed, and transacted. As we continue to grow, we are building a world-class sales organization to support our next phase of expansion.

REMOTE (Work may be performed anywhere)

This is not a traditional sales leadership job, and the difference matters.

Selling to teams and agents is a high-volume, short-cycle motion at a price point that cannot support a lot of human hours per customer. The answer is not more salespeople working harder. It's a system: demand that comes from channels rather than headcount, a repeatable process every rep works from, and onboarding and adoption carried largely by the product.

We're looking for someone who has built that system before. Not someone smart who could figure it out with us. Someone who has personally designed and run a mostly touchless, system-driven SMB motion, has made the mistakes, and knows what works.

What You'll Own:

You'll own the segment: the number, the team, the process, and the go-to-market strategy for teams and agents.

  • The team. Building, hiring, coaching and leading the sales team as the segment scales.
  • Sales enablement. A structured, repeatable sales system: how we qualify, how we run discovery, how we position Rechat, competitive positioning, demo standards, objection handling and deal strategy. Plus the ongoing rhythm of call reviews and coaching that keeps a team improving. The way Rechat sells should belong to Rechat and be consistent across every rep we hire.
  • The funnel. Stage definitions, conversion at every step, forecasting, and a scorecard the company can rely on.
  • Demand conversion. You won't own marketing spend. You'll own converting what it produces, and telling marketing which channels return revenue rather than volume.
  • The customer journey. You'll partner closely with our account management and customer success teams on onboarding, activation, adoption and retention for this segment. You won't manage them, but you'll set the standard for what a successfully onboarded and retained SMB customer looks like, and you'll carry a retention number alongside your growth number.
  • Expansion. Growing agent and team adoption inside the brokerages we already serve.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years in SaaS or technology sales, including leadership of a high-volume, short-cycle SMB sales motion.
  • You've built a system-driven sales motion from scratch. Short cycles, smaller deal sizes, real volume. You designed the process rather than inheriting one.
  • You've built the enablement behind it yourself. Playbook, discovery framework, demo standard, competitive positioning, coaching cadence. Written it, taught it, and improved it based on what actually closed.
  • You've made a motion less dependent on people over time. You've worked with product and marketing to move work out of humans and into the system, and you can speak specifically to what you automated and what you deliberately kept human.
  • You've carried a retention or net revenue number, not just new business. You have a real point of view on why customers leave and what changes it.
  • You've hired, ramped and coached reps for this motion, and you know how that profile differs from an enterprise seller.
  • You've operated across teams that don't report to you. Marketing, product, account management and customer success all sit outside this role. You've done it without needing the org chart to change.
  • You've been hands-on recently. Early on the team is small, and you'll be in the calls and the pipeline yourself. That's the job in year one, not a phase.
  • Strong command of funnel economics — conversion, velocity, sales efficiency, forecast discipline, retention and expansion.
  • PropTech or real estate technology experience preferred but not required, particularly selling to agents, teams or brokerages. Understanding how this kind of motion is built matters more

Probably Not the Right Fit If:

  • Your experience is primarily enterprise, long-cycle, or field sales
  • You've led teams inside a machine someone else built, with enablement and operations provided to you
  • You want to hand off everything that happens after the signature
  • You need a large team and a full support function around you to be effective

How You Work:

  • Clear, direct written communication. Most coordination happens in Slack and project tools, not meetings.
  • Fluent with modern AI tools and using them daily to move faster.
  • Comfortable in a CRM as an operator, not just a reviewer. HubSpot experience preferred.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote with flexible work/life balance
  • A diverse, inclusive, and highly collaborative culture
  • Meaningful work with a product used by real professionals every day
  • Flexible Paid Time Off

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics. Background and reference checks required.

Salary: $175,000 – $250,000 / year

About the Role

Trimble's Transportation & Logistics (T&L) division is looking for a highly motivated and analytical Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics to join our growing Revenue Operations team. This role is a critical contributor to our function, responsible for providing the data-driven insights that fuel our revenue growth and strategic decision-making.

You will be the primary engine for turning raw sales and operational data into clear, actionable reports and analyses. Working closely with the Sr. Manager, Sales Intelligence and the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, you will focus on developing and maintaining the analytical infrastructure that tracks, measures, and forecasts our sales performance. This role is perfect for a self-starter who excels at digging deep into data and translating findings into business strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Performance Reporting & Analysis

  • Metric Development: Own the creation, maintenance, and distribution of key sales performance reports and dashboards that track KPIs, including sales cycles, conversion rates, bookings, and churn/retention.

  • Deep-Dive Analysis: Conduct ad-hoc and recurring deep-dive analyses into sales performance at the individual, team, and segment level to identify trends, root causes, and areas for strategic improvement.

  • Monthly Review: Conduct monthly KPI review and 'plan vs. actuals' variance analysis to provide comprehensive performance summaries to leadership.

Data Integrity and Management

  • Data Expertise: Be the go-to expert for sales data within our CRM (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, etc.) and other supporting business systems.

  • Data Quality Assurance: Proactively monitor and audit data integrity across various systems, working with cross-functional teams to resolve inconsistencies and ensure reliable reporting.

  • Metric Standardization: Standardize KPI dictionary and establish a single source of truth for metrics to ensure data consistency and reliability across the T&L segment.

  • ETL Support: Assist the Sr. Manager with data consolidation efforts, helping to prepare and transform data from disparate sources for unified analysis and modeling.

Forecasting and Strategic Support

  • Forecasting & Risk Analysis: Support the Sr. Manager by compiling, validating, and analyzing the data required for the division’s strategic sales forecasting models. Deliver weekly forecast analytics complete with risk commentary and variance bridges explaining deviations from plan.

  • Pipeline Health Analysis: Analyze the health and velocity of the sales pipeline, providing regular reports on stage-to-stage conversion and activity effectiveness to pinpoint bottlenecks.

  • Presentation Support: Prepare and visualize data for executive-level presentations, translating complex analytical findings into clear, compelling slides and narratives for key stakeholders.

Strategic Alignment & Operational Excellence

  • Cross-Divisional Consistency: Enforce KPI consistency across all T&L divisions to enable standardized performance comparisons and executive-level reporting.

  • Unified Reporting Implementation: Actively support the unified reporting and analytics implementation across the segment, partnering with other teams to drive adoption and best practices for common data consumption.

  • Executive Insights: Respond to high-priority ad-hoc executive requests with timely, insightful analysis within a 48-hour turnaround time.

What We're Looking For

Professional Experience & Skills

  • Experience: Proven experience (3+ years) in a highly analytical role such as Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Sales Analyst, preferably supporting a B2B sales organization.

  • Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation is required.

  • Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building dynamic dashboards and reports using visualization tools such as AWS Quicksight, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

  • Data Modeling: Foundational understanding of statistical analysis and data modeling principles.

  • CRM Expertise: Strong working knowledge of a major CRM platform (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) and how to extract data from it.

  • Revenue Intelligence (RI) Platforms: Hands-on experience extracting, modeling, and analyzing data from a Revenue Intelligence platform (e.g., Gong, Chorus, Clari) is required.

About the team

At Zillow Group, our mission is to empower people to unlock life's next chapter. The Platform Engineering team owns the infrastructure every engineer at Zillow builds on, spanning compute and runtime, networking and connectivity, databases, secrets and identity, and the delivery tooling that moves code to production. We are shifting from an infrastructure operations model to platform-as-a-product, replacing ticket queues and manual provisioning with golden paths, self-service, and API-first interfaces so that product teams can focus on business outcomes instead of operational complexity.

Increasingly, this platform serves AI agents alongside the engineers directing them. Our self-service paths are evolving to support agent-driven, pipeline-driven, and hybrid workflows, making Platform Engineering foundational to how quickly and safely Zillow can build with AI.

About the role

As a Principal Product Manager for Platform Engineering, you will own product strategy for the platform capabilities that every engineering team at Zillow depends on. You will define the golden paths teams follow by default, drive adoption and migration onto those paths across thousands of services, and establish the measurement and value model that makes the platform's impact visible to the business.

This is the first dedicated product role in the organization. Platform Engineering has already built many of the foundations of a product operating model — customer discovery, written product requirements, and outcome metrics are how these teams work today — with engineering leaders carrying that work alongside running their teams. As a Principal Product Manager, you will raise the ceiling on that practice, partnering with engineering leadership across six teams to deepen discovery, sharpen prioritization, and organize the roadmap around customer problems and value streams rather than infrastructure layers.

Your scope spans the full platform surface — though the areas you drive most directly will be shaped by where the leverage is greatest as near-term product needs across the teams stabilize. At this level, you will define the operating model other teams plan and build within, not just execute within it yourself.

You Will Get To

  • Own platform strategy across Platform Engineering's portfolio, turning independently run infrastructure roadmaps into a coherent product direction with explicit investment tradeoffs

  • Define the golden paths for how engineers build at Zillow, designing the platform so the supported path is the fastest one and unsupported patterns are difficult to fall into

  • Drive adoption and migration outcomes across teams with no reporting relationship to you, using defaults, deprecation paths, and enablement mechanisms that produce measurable change in how teams build

  • Define how applications and AI agents consume platform capabilities, establishing which self-service paths are agent-driven, which remain deterministic, and where human approval is required

  • Establish how platform success is measured — adoption, onboarding time, satisfaction, and key customer outcomes — and build the underlying value model of what capabilities cost to serve and what they are worth

  • Deepen the product operating model across six engineering teams, partnering with the engineering leaders who carry product responsibility to strengthen discovery, requirements, and outcome definition

  • Partner closely with Data Platform, Developer Experience, and Security teams to keep the internal developer experience coherent and resolve ownership gaps between organizations

This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $169,300.00 - $270,500.00 annually. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including substantial time building internal platforms, infrastructure, or developer tooling used by multiple teams across organizational boundaries

  • Experience owning a platform portfolio rather than a single product area — multiple interdependent capabilities with different customers, maturity levels, and lifecycles — and prioritizing across them

  • Strong technical fluency in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, including compute and container orchestration, networking, databases, identity and secrets, and CI/CD, sufficient to reason about architectural tradeoffs alongside senior engineers rather than gather requirements from them

  • Proven track record driving adoption of platform standards across teams you do not manage, using defaults, deprecation paths, and mechanisms that drove measurable change in behavior

  • Experience leading complex migrations at scale, including the full retirement of the systems they replaced

  • Able to operate in ambiguity and impose structure on complex, cross-functional infrastructure initiatives where scope is undefined and precedent is limited

  • Experience raising the product bar for engineering leaders who carry product responsibility, through coaching, shared standards, and durable artifacts rather than sole ownership

  • Familiarity with designing platform capabilities for AI agents as consumers, including where automated workflows require human approval and how automated paths are verified

  • Clear, structured communicator who can hold a coherent platform narrative across engineering, adjacent platform teams, and executive stakeholders

  • Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.


Job Description

Job DescriptionThe Director of Computer Vision will drive the technical vision, research and engineering execution for the platform, with focus on the following core areas:

  • Foundational Research Strategy: Define the long-term research agenda for fundamental computer vision capabilities and drive the culture of scientific excellence.

  • Technical Vision, Engineering Leadership, and Execution: Provide executive technical leadership to a unified research and engineering organization, defining the technical architecture, strategy, and engineering roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform. Drive execution, ensuring the seamless translation of product requirements into robust technical specifications and successful delivery of next-generation visual intelligence solutions that are highly scalable and align with overall product and business strategy.

  • Organizational Leadership and Talent Strategy: Manage and scale a unified computer vision research and engineering organization distributed across multiple geographies, overseeing multiple teams, and defining the strategy for recruiting, mentoring, and attracting world-class talent.

  • End-to-End MLOps and Deployment: Own the entire engineering lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure. This includes establishing best-in-class MLOps practices for scalable training, efficient deployment, continuous monitoring, and performance optimization across edge and cloud environments.

  • Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Define, implement, and track key technical performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, model efficiency, system reliability) to measure engineering success, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement in execution and delivery.

  • Technical Innovation and Risk Management: Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge computer vision research and technologies. Proactively identify and mitigate significant technical risks, and lead critical engineering decisions, including build-versus-buy analysis.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of technical leadership experience leading computer vision teams and organizations, with a focus on building and deploying enterprise-scale platforms and solutions in production.

  • Technical Acumen & Deep Expertise: Deep, demonstrable expertise in computer vision, machine learning algorithms, and the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle, including 5+ years of hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision models or as a computer vision researcher. Proven ability to engage in complex technical discussions, define the architectural vision for central, reusable AI infrastructure and models, and drive technical strategy while managing critical trade-offs.

  • Executive Technical Strategy & Metrics: Proven experience defining long-term technical vision, engineering strategy, and roadmaps for a large-scale platform. Expertise in defining and implementing technical metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, system reliability, model efficiency) to measure engineering excellence and drive continuous improvement across an organization.

  • Organizational & People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to manage and scale a unified, distributed engineering and research organization of 50 to 100 people, mentor senior technical talent, and lead multiple teams across different geographies.

  • Strong Analytical and Research Skills: Hands-on experience driving innovation through foundational research, working with AI performance metrics (e.g., Precision/Recall), real-time video processing, and inference optimization.

  • Customer-Driven Technical Leadership (Pathfinding): Track record of translating highly ambiguous product concepts and complex customer needs into clear, executable technical roadmaps and architectural specifications.

  • Start-up Mentality & Agility: Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment is highly valued, demonstrating high ownership, bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to drive 0-to-1 product development with limited resources.

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in public safety, security-focused software (e.g., video security, evidence management), mission-critical systems, or emergency communications is a plus.

jobs.description:
The Fortinet Field CISO is a senior security, technology and policy advisor with a focus on thought leadership and being a trusted advisor to customers and prospects. You will operate at the intersection of executive influence, security strategy, and revenue, translating complex cybersecurity challenges into compelling business outcomes and positioning the Fortinet platform as the essential foundation of a modern security program. This is a rare opportunity to shape how the world's largest organizations think about security at the highest levels.

We are looking for someone with more than 15 years of experience in the IT and/or OT (operational technology) security industry with a strong technical and commercial acumen, to act as a trusted advisor to the world’s largest organizations and help them improve their security postures and align security strategically with business initiatives. This person will report to the CISO, and support Fortinet’s sales, marketing, and communications teams’ in revenue growth by helping them and partners successfully assess our technologies, solicit business requirements/use cases, understand how different platforms will work and integrate, develop a technical strategy, configure and effectively demonstrate the solution that addresses partner/sales team requirements, and work with the global delivery team to ensure the success of integration with other products (where necessary).

The Field CISO will also work closely with Fortinet prospects and partners, as well as the companies’ product managers, and partner programs professionals to maximize the growth and expansion of Fortinet products by targeting and developing strong relationships with new and existing partners and integrators globally, ensuring the sales goals of our global products.

Responsibilities:

  • Executive advisory: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and boards of directors at key accounts, helping them navigate evolving threat landscapes, regulatory pressures, and security transformation programs.
  • Revenue acceleration: Partner with enterprise sales teams on strategic deals, owning the CISO-to-CISO relationship. Lead executive briefings, security workshops, and board-level presentations that advance pipeline and accelerate close.
  • Thought leadership: Represent the company at industry conferences (RSA, Black Hat, Gartner Security Summit), in media, and in analyst briefings. Author white papers, and executive content that drives brand authority.
  • Product influence: Act as the voice of the CISO community back into the product and engineering organization, shaping roadmap priorities based on frontline conversations with customer security leaders.
  • Community building: Cultivate a network of CISO champions, advisory board members, and reference customers. Lead regional peer forums, roundtables, and executive immersion programs.
  • Security program strategy: Help customers develop and mature their security programs, including zero trust adoption, cloud security posture, incident response readiness, and regulatory compliance frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA).

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE:

  • 15+ years of relevant work experience in security software, hardware, architecture, strategy, in part as a technology evangelist.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with security strategy, products, and ecosystems.
  • Highly networked in the CISO executive networks, including CISO coalitions and summits, and regularly leveraging and working the inner circles of those connections to further promote the Fortinet brand and accelerate our business growth.
  • Exceptional negotiation, demonstration, presentation and interpersonal communication skills are essential.
  • Deep expertise in at least two domains: cloud security, identity, threat detection & response, OT/ICS, or GRC
  • Highly influential relationship builder.
  • Customer focused and commercially minded.
  • Proven track record in a similar role with clear evidence of successful execution.
  • Fortinet product knowledge and understanding of its developer ecosystem preferred.
  • Public speaking experience with great PowerPoint creation and presentation skills.
  • Established industry presence (speaking, writing, or advisory board participation)
  • Experience in a customer-facing or commercial role (sales, pre-sales, advisory, consulting, or fractional CISO)
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-driven security tools and emerging threat vectors
  • Preferably experience in a CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO role or alternatively a senior vendor, consultancy, or analyst role alongside practitioner background
  • Willing to travel within reason.

EDUCATION:

  • B.S./M.S. Computer Science, Software Engineering

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Who we’re looking for

The Strategic Business Developer (SBD) is responsible for identifying, developing, and scaling large, high-value construction projects and strategic accounts, with a focus on long-term value creation rather than transactional sales.

This role sits at the intersection of the Hilti Energy & Industry (E&I) organization, Large Projects and Fieldwire’s large-project growth strategy leveraging and expanding Hilti’s strong existing customer relationships, market access, and credibility within complex project ecosystems. Drawing on the proven E&I model, the SBD focuses on strategic account development, early engagement, and specification influence to position Fieldwire upstream in the customer decision cycle.

The SBD works closely with Hilti E&I, Strategic Accounts, and Large Projects teams to identify and shape priority opportunities, building senior relationships and embedding Fieldwire into large-project ecosystems early. In parallel, the role partners with regional sales teams (Enterprise AEs) to execute the commercial close once opportunities are sufficiently developed.

In practice, this role acts as the strategic orchestrator, upstream leveraging Hilti’s relationships to create and shape opportunities and enable downstream conversion through strong regional sales collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account & Project Development

  • Develop and execute long-term strategies for large, complex projects and global key accounts
  • Identify and prioritize projects and high-value opportunities (≥ $500k ARR potential)
  • Own a structured portfolio:
  • ~20 projects in scope
  • ~10 actively managed at any given time
  • Build 1–2-year forward-looking project and account plans
  • Support in high conversion influencing revenue for the local Fieldwire sales orgs.
  • Embed Fieldwire as the solution of choice before procurement and tender phases
  • Drive demand before the buying process formally begins
  • Operate across regions and multiple stakeholder groups
  • Manage complex, multi-year project lifecycles
  • Travel globally (~15–25%) as required

Regional Sales Partnership & Deal Execution

  • Partner closely with regional Enterprise AEs / SEs to convert developed opportunities into revenue
  • Ensure seamless handover of qualified, high-potential opportunities for commercial execution
  • Continue supporting deals post-handover by:
  • Maintaining senior relationships
  • Enabling expansion across project stakeholders and subcontractors
  • Drive alignment between global strategy and local execution

Leveraging Hilti Ecosystem & Relationships

  • Leverage Hilti’s existing customer relationships, access, and credibility to open doors and accelerate opportunity development
  • Partner closely with Hilti E&I, large projects and strategic teams on project identification, account strategy definition and stakeholder mapping
  • Build on established relationships while expanding new senior-level connections within target accounts.

Senior Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with C-level executives, project owners and decision-makers
  • Act as a trusted advisor on productivity, safety, and digital construction solutions
  • Represent Field Software at industry and thought leadership events

Market & Opportunity Intelligence

  • Analyze market trends, economic conditions and customer ecosystem dynamics
  • Translate insights into strategic plays, new opportunities, competitive positioning and product feedback

Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Pipeline created from large projects
  • Specification and early-stage project wins
  • Strategic account penetration and growth
  • Conversion rate from project identification → closed deal
  • Revenue contribution from large projects
  • Depth and quality of senior stakeholder relationships
  • Effectiveness of collaboration with regional teams

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Construction Management, Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • 6+ years in strategic business development, enterprise sales, strategic account management, or large-project development.
  • Experience in construction technology, SaaS, Energy and Industry (E&I), infrastructure, or complex multi-stakeholder sales environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strategic accounts and long-cycle project opportunities, engage senior decision-makers, and influence solution selection before procurement and tender phases.
  • Strong stakeholder-mapping and relationship-building skills across project owners, contractors, subcontractors, and other decision-makers.
  • Ability to translate customer workflows and business challenges into compelling software value propositions and business cases.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across a matrix organization, influence without direct authority, and partner with regional sales teams on opportunity handover and conversion.
  • Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a structured approach to account planning, opportunity prioritization, and pipeline management.

Reporting line and working conditions:

  • Reports to the Director of Key Projects, Field Software.
  • Hybrid working environment comprising office, remote, customer-office, industry-event, and construction-jobsite settings.
  • Site visits may require compliance with applicable safety procedures and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements.
  • Collaboration across multiple regions and time zones is expected.

Compensation:

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: $120,000 - $160,000

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary, you may be eligible for a compensation variable bonus, which can range up to $20,400 - $27,200.

Why Fieldwire?

The field-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.

Where is the job located?

This role is fully remote within the United States. Our headquarters are based in beautiful San Francisco and our office is centrally located right off of Embarcadero Bart station.
