jobs.excerpt: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution.
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

Requirements

Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Description

We’re looking for a Global Commodity Buyer to own Indirect Materials purchasing across Hal Leonard’s US and European operations. It’s a new seat in our Global Purchasing function, where each buyer owns one commodity end-to-end across all regions. Indirect spend is currently bought locally by each site. Your job is to bring it under one owner, consolidate the supplier base and put the right contracts in place.

We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and expect candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency and delivering a better user experience.

What’s in it for you:

  • Real ownership from day one. You’ll take on a new global commodity with no previous owner, and shape its category structure, supplier base and contracts yourself.
  • Visible business impact. You’ll see the results of your work directly in the company’s costs, and your work keeps the production floor running across the US and Europe.
  • Modern, AI-first procurement. You’ll help build the new setup with AI-assisted approvals, spend analytics and guided buying, so your time goes into negotiation and strategy rather than paperwork.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Indirect Materials purchasing globally: print production materials (paper, ink), packaging, warehouse consumables, material handling equipment, MRO and spare parts, facility services, site and equipment leases, office supplies, IT hardware, and recurring services and subscriptions.
  • Build the baseline. Map indirect spend by site, supplier and category, and set up a contract and renewal register.
  • Consolidate volumes across sites and regions, run tenders and RFQs, and negotiate framework agreements on standard terms.
  • Manage contract renewals so nothing auto-renews or misses a notice date. Prepare renegotiations well ahead of key dates.
  • Build long-term supplier partnerships, with SLAs, regular performance reviews and risk management for materials that keep production running.
  • Set up guided buying: catalogues and preferred suppliers in our procure-to-pay system, plus clear rules on what goes through a company card and what needs a PO.
  • Work AI-first. Use AI-assisted approvals, spend analytics and automated renewal alerts instead of manual handling.
  • Partner with budget holders, site managers and Finance. You advise and contract, they keep ownership of their budgets.
  • Report on spend, savings and supplier performance to the Global Purchasing Manager.

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years in purchasing, including hands-on indirect procurement (production materials, packaging, MRO, facilities, services or leases). Ideally gained in manufacturing, printing, distribution or logistics, across more than one country.
  • A track record of supplier consolidation and documented savings on indirect spend, including running tenders.
  • Contract management experience: framework agreements, SLAs, lease and service contracts, renewals.
  • Experience with spend analysis and procure-to-pay setup: catalogues, guided buying, purchasing card policies.
  • Comfort with AI is essential. You see AI-assisted approval and automated workflows as leverage and can judge what to automate and what to keep human.
  • Strong stakeholder skills: you can influence budget holders and site managers without taking over their budgets.
  • Discipline with data: clean supplier records, an up-to-date contract register, and nothing that lives only in your head.
  • An ownership mindset: you ask critical questions, communicate directly and come with solutions, not just problems.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience buying paper or print materials.
  • Experience with Coupa or a similar P2P tool, and with NetSuite. Purchasing experience during an ERP migration.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain or a related field. NEVI, CIPS or an equivalent certification.
  • Dutch or other European languages.

jobs.excerpt: Position overviewThe Head of AI/ML R&D decides, with evidence, whether an AI system works, how well, for whom, and at what cost.
jobs.description:
Position overview

The Head of AI/ML R&D decides, with evidence, whether an AI system works, how well, for whom, and at what cost. They come from data science and machine learning, and they build today with AI-native tools and agentic development.

The role owns the science of evaluation across every agent, the predictive and decision models behind the shared agents (churn, demand, payment recovery, fraud), and the experiment design that lets Finance count AI value once, against a holdout.

The role is hands-on. At least 50% of time goes to building models, evals and experiments; the rest to setting methods, reviewing, and growing a small team. This role makes what engineers ship measurable, cheaper and trustworthy, and supplies the models where an LLM alone is the wrong tool.

Key responsibilities

1. Evaluation science for every agent

o Set the enterprise eval methodology: golden-set design, sampling, labelling and inter-rater agreement, LLM-as-judge validation, slice analysis and statistical thresholds.

o Own the quality signals in the minimum telemetry contract: task success, groundedness, hallucination and escalation rates.

o Re-run evals per BU and tenant on every agent-core upgrade; catch regressions before customers do.

2. Predictive and decision models behind the shared agents

o Build and run the models the horizontal pods need: churn and retention uplift, payment-recovery propensity and timing, demand and capacity forecasting, later fraud and onboarding risk.

o Choose the right tool per task: classical ML, a small or fine-tuned model, retrieval, or a frontier LLM.

o Ship models to production on the golden path, with monitoring for drift and feedback loops.

3. Model economics

o Build the evidence behind model routing: accuracy, cost and latency per task, so routing is a measured decision.

o Drive cost per successful task down through distillation, caching strategy, smaller models and prompt and context optimization.

4. AI-native R&D and horizon scanning

o Prototype varied techniques (agent memory, planning, multi-agent patterns, synthetic data) against real Xplor problems.

o Turn what works into reference implementations in the golden path; retire what doesn't.

o Bring a monthly view of what has changed in models and methods, and what it means for our roadmap.

5. Data science for Data-as-a-Service

o Shape the statistical design of benchmarks and indices: cohort minimums, anonymization, and comparability across businesses.

o Lead entity-resolution modeling with the data team.

6. Raise the ML fluency of the whole R&D organization

o Teach evals, experimentation and probabilistic thinking through the AI-P/SDLC training and office hours.

o Pair with BU engineers on hard model problems in lighthouse BUs; review eval designs for R2 and R3 agents.

Hands-on expectations

  • Writes production code, notebooks and eval harnesses; uses AI coding and agent tools daily at "platform contributor" fluency.
  • Builds the first eval suite and the first predictive model for each golden-path exemplar (conversational analytics, booking agent, retention and churn).
  • Reviews model and eval pull requests from pods and BUs.
  • Decides on a demo, an eval or a metric, not a deck.

Required

  • 12+ years in data science, machine learning or applied research, with 4+ years leading teams of scientists or ML engineers.
  • Grew up in ML: has trained, evaluated, deployed and maintained models in production, not only consumed APIs.
  • Has shipped LLM or agentic systems to production in the last two years, including the eval suite that gated them.
  • Deep experimental design and causal inference: A/B tests, holdouts, uplift modelling, matched cohorts, and knowing when each is valid.
  • Strong statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, calibration, multiple-comparison traps.
  • Builds with AI-native tools today (agentic coding assistants, MCP, agent frameworks) and can show recent work.
  • Writes production-quality Python and SQL; reviews others' code credibly.
  • Has worked on SaaS or marketplace data at scale: multi-tenant, messy, many products.
  • Explains model trade-offs and uncertainty to executives in business terms (revenue, margin, risk).

Preferred

  • Churn, retention, propensity or pricing models in subscription or SMB software.
  • Payments ML: recovery, dunning optimization, fraud or risk scoring.
  • Fine-tuning, distillation or small-model work to cut inference cost.
  • LLM-as-judge design and validation; red-teaming of model behavior.
  • Snowflake (or similar) and feature stores; Datadog or OpenTelemetry for model monitoring.
  • Familiar with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and with privacy rules for analytics across AU, NZ, US, UK and EU.
  • Published research or open-source work is a plus, not a requirement.

Competencies and behaviors

  • Evidence first. Brings a number with its error bar.
  • Builder, not only researcher. Measures success by what reaches customers.
  • Pragmatic. Picks the simplest model that clears the bar; says no to research that has no BU sponsor.
  • Teacher. Grows ML judgement in engineers who don't report to them.
  • Security- and privacy-minded. Treats training data, prompts and tool output as untrusted; no card data, credentials or customer data where it doesn't belong.
  • Partner to BUs. Treats BUs as customers; works within the co-build-with-two-BUs rule.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The National Conference of Bar Examiners (NCBE) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing a competent, ethical, and diverse legal profession. We develop and deliver high-quality assessment products, services, and research that support state courts and licensing authorities in evaluating the readiness of aspiring lawyers.

NCBE is committed to fostering a collaborative, mission-driven environment with competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, flexible scheduling, and professional development opportunities. NCBE’s headquarters is based in Madison, Wisconsin, a dynamic community with exceptional amenities.

The Executive Operations Manager serves as the operational and administrative right hand to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), ensuring both the CPO and the broader division across Psychometrics, Test Development, Product, User Experience, and Assessment Operations operate effectively.

This role combines executive support, division-wide coordination, and operational organization. The position manages the flow of priorities, information, decisions, meetings, and commitments into and out of the Office of the CPO while maintaining visibility across the work of the Product organization.

The Executive Operations Manager is responsible for keeping the CPO organized, prepared, and focused on the highest-value work; ensuring commitments and follow-up; coordinating priorities and dependencies across teams; and creating the operating rhythms that allow the division to function as an integrated organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Executive & Administrative Support to the CPO

  • Manage CPO Priorities: Maintain a comprehensive view of the CPO's commitments, deadlines, decisions, deliverables, and follow-up responsibilities.
  • Support Management of Executive Calendar: Work with the CPO’s support team members to manage and prioritize the CPO's calendar, ensuring time reflects organizational priorities and appropriate preparation time is protected.
  • Prepare Daily Priorities: Ensure the CPO knows what requires attention, what decisions are needed, what deadlines are approaching, and where follow-up is outstanding.
  • Coordinate Meeting Preparation: Gather materials, background, decisions required, and relevant context so the CPO enters important meetings fully prepared.
  • Drive CPO Follow-Through: Track commitments made by the CPO and proactively ensure drafts, decisions, responses, and other deliverables are completed on time.
  • Manage Information Flow: Review and organize incoming requests, determine what requires CPO attention, and route or resolve matters elsewhere when appropriate.
  • Coordinate Executive Logistics: Support scheduling and logistics for significant meetings, leadership sessions, Board and committee engagements, jurisdiction meetings, retreats, and other priority activities.
  • Protect Executive Capacity: Identify meetings, requests, and activities that can be delegated, consolidated, deferred, or handled without CPO involvement.

Division Operations

  • Coordinate Division Priorities: Maintain an integrated view of significant initiatives, commitments, milestones, and deliverables across the Product division.
  • Connect Cross-Team Dependencies: Identify where work across Product Management, Engineering & AI, Psychometrics, Test Development, Product, User Experience, and Assessment Operations, and other teams intersects.
  • Build Useful Agendas: Structure Product Leadership Team time around decisions, dependencies, risks, and issues rather than routine status updates.
  • Coordinate CPO Communications: Help manage correspondence, presentations, briefing materials, leadership updates, and other executive communications.
  • Draft Executive Materials: Prepare initial drafts of emails, talking points, agendas, presentations, summaries, and briefing documents for CPO review.

CPO Meeting & Decision Management

  • Prepare Decision Context: Distill complex issues into the essential facts, options, tradeoffs, and decisions required from the CPO.
  • Anticipate CPO Needs: Look ahead across the calendar and workstreams to identify preparation, conversations, information, or decisions needed before they become urgent.
  • Capture Meeting Actions: Ensure important meetings result in documented decisions, owners, actions, and deadlines.
  • Maintain Decision Record: Keep visibility into significant CPO and Product Leadership Team decisions and ensure they are communicated to affected teams.
  • Coordinate Required Follow-Up: Make sure the right conversations happen after meetings rather than relying on the CPO to remember and initiate each one.

Planning, Tracking & Organization

  • Maintain Master Tracker: Keep one reliable view of CPO and division-level commitments, decisions, risks, deliverables, and deadlines.
  • Look Ahead Proactively: Maintain a rolling view of upcoming milestones, meetings, governance commitments, launches, administration dates, and other events requiring preparation.
  • Coordinate Planning Cycles: Organize annual, quarterly, and initiative-level planning activities across the Product division.
  • Create Organizational Systems: Develop lightweight processes and tools that make information easier to find, commitments easier to track, and work easier to coordinate.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.
  • Five or more years of relevant experience required, including experience providing high-level support to an executive or senior leader in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex executive calendars, priorities, meeting preparation, logistics, and follow-up.
  • Ability to understand and synthesize complex information into concise, accurate, and decision-ready briefings, presentations, summaries, plans, and communications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive-level materials and communicate expectations and follow-up clearly and professionally.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate needs, and meet deadlines in a changing environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve coordination or processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the confidence and diplomacy to work effectively with executives, senior leaders, employees, and internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to exercise discretion, professionalism, sound judgment, and appropriate confidentiality in a highly visible role.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, adjust to shifting priorities, and determine when matters should be addressed, routed, or escalated.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, and demonstrated ability to effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools and automation to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance the quality and efficiency of work products.

Theis position may work remotely. NCBE will consider applicants from the following states: FL, IA, IN, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NE, NJ, NM, NV, OK, PA, WA, and WI.

Enterprise Strategy & Portfolio Management

Strategic Intelligence & Research

Impact Measurement & Organizational Learning

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted strategic thought partner to the CEO, providing independent perspectives and clear, decision-ready recommendations.
  • Partner closely with regional and functional leaders, strengthening their ability to deliver results while maintaining clear accountability for execution.
  • Serve as a strong, collaborative partner and member of the senior leadership team, contributing not only within the Intelligence & Impact function but to the organization's broader leadership and decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven ability to build and lead teams, influence senior stakeholders, and work effectively across disciplines and geographies.
  • Ability to understand how advocacy and institutional change improve outcomes for animals, with a willingness to learn from colleagues with deep expertise in animal protection.
  • Exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, humility, intellectual curiosity, and a demonstrated bias toward action.
  • Deep commitment to improving the lives of farmed animals and advancing Mercy For Animals’ mission, alongside intellectual curiosity and openness to new approaches.

Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategic philanthropy, business transformation, or mission-driven organizational leadership is particularly relevant. Prior experience in animal protection is preferred but not required. We welcome candidates from other sectors who bring relevant expertise and a deep commitment to improving outcomes for animals.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected starting salary range for this position is $130,720 – $150,800. Because this is a remote leadership role, we recognize that exceptional talent comes from diverse sectors and geographies. We are open to adjusting compensation beyond this target range to align with a candidate’s specific depth of leadership experience, specialized skills, and the unique strategic capabilities they bring to advancing our mission. Our Commitment to You

Mercy For Animals is a globally minded organization. We are committed to the principles of equity and justice, and our culture celebrates authenticity—enabling every team member to shine. Come as you are, and help us transform society and construct a truly compassionate food system.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the roleYou will be the most senior hands-on AI engineer at Truvio and set the technical direction for how we build agents for finance in Dynamics 365.
jobs.description:
About the role

You will be the most senior hands-on AI engineer at Truvio and set the technical direction for how we build agents for finance in Dynamics 365. You will define the architecture of our agentic platform, lead the hardest problems yourself (context graph reasoning, agent reliability, governance), and raise the bar for every team shipping AI. You work closely with the CTO, product leadership and the platform team, and your influence comes from code, designs and judgment rather than reports.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of the Truvio agentic platform: how agents reason over the context graph, call ERP tools, and hand decisions to humans under Trust & Control.
  • Lead design and build of the first flagship agents for AP, AR and treasury, writing production code and setting the patterns others follow.
  • Define engineering standards for AI: evaluation methodology, quality gates, safety and governance controls, cost and latency budgets.
  • Make the build, buy or partner calls on models, frameworks and vendors, and write the decision records behind them.
  • Mentor senior engineers across product teams and grow the AI engineering community (design reviews, AI Unplugged sessions, internal writing).
  • Represent Truvio's AI technology with key customers, Microsoft and partners, and translate what you learn into the roadmap.
  • Spot where AI changes what our products should be, not just how they are built, and bring those ideas to product leadership.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years leading the design of production AI or ML systems at scale.
  • A track record of shipping LLM-based or agentic systems that real customers depend on, with measurable outcomes.
  • Deep systems design skills: distributed systems, data modeling, APIs, security and multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Strong hands-on coding in Python and/or C#/.NET; you still enjoy writing the hard parts.
  • Expertise in evaluation, retrieval, tool calling and agent orchestration, and a clear view of their failure modes.
  • Experience setting technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent written English: you can write a design doc an engineer acts on and a one-pager an executive decides on.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Business Central or Finance & Operations), Dataverse or another ERP.
  • Background in finance operations: accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing or treasury.
  • Knowledge graphs, graph databases or semantic data modeling.
  • Familiarity with the EU AI Act, GDPR and audit requirements for AI in regulated processes.
  • Publications, open source work or conference talks in applied AI.

Who you are

You combine technical depth with curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy tackling complex problems, challenging assumptions and turning ideas into practical solutions. You build trust through clear communication and sound judgment, and you help others succeed by sharing knowledge and working towards a common goal.

Why Truvio

At Truvio, you will join a global SaaS environment with a clear product focus and a strong connection to the Microsoft Dynamics ecosystem. This role gives you the opportunity to shape our AI architecture, stay close to production code and influence how teams build solutions for finance. Working alongside engineering, product and platform colleagues, you will help turn technical innovation into meaningful customer value.

Other information

Location:Remote, Europe (Nordic hubs or Vienna welcome). We have offices in Sweden, Denmark, UK and the Netherlands.

Level:Principal individual contributor (technical lead for AI across Engineering)

Employment:Permanent, 100 %

Start:As soon as we find the right candidate

About Truvio

Truvio is a global software company delivering solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365. We help organizations get more value from their business systems by bringing together finance, business operations and commerce. Truvio has approximately 450 employees across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Our core values: Take Ownership, Build Trust, Drive Innovation and Succeed Together, guide how we work and help our customers get more from their ERP investments. Own your growth, shape your future with us.

Ready to help shape the future of AI at Truvio? We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Position: B2B Business Development Executive
Salary: up to PHP 60,000 / month + commissions

Working Hours & Conditions: UK Business Hours (Mid shift)

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a fast-growing sustainability consultancy that helps organisations understand, reduce, and communicate their carbon impact.

With a strong reputation for delivering practical carbon solutions, including carbon audits, reduction strategies, and sustainability programmes, the business works with organisations across multiple sectors including healthcare, logistics, professional services, digital agencies, and more.

As the company enters an exciting growth phase, they are looking for an ambitious Business Development Representative to help drive expansion by connecting with organisations that are looking to take meaningful action on sustainability and carbon reduction.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys outbound sales, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities while contributing to a purpose-driven organisation.

The Role

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for generating new sales opportunities by engaging with decision-makers across various industries. You will play a key role in building the sales pipeline by identifying prospects, starting conversations, qualifying opportunities, and booking high-quality meetings for the senior sales team.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a proactive sales environment, enjoys speaking with people, and is motivated by achieving measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate qualified sales opportunities by booking meetings with decision-makers, including Operations Managers, Directors, Sustainability Leads, and senior stakeholders.
  • Conduct proactive outbound outreach, with phone calls as the primary channel (approximately 100+ calls per day).
  • Engage prospects through email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, and social selling activities.
  • Qualify potential opportunities by understanding business needs, challenges, and sustainability goals.
  • Manage and maintain an accurate sales pipeline using HubSpot CRM.
  • Keep CRM records updated with prospect interactions, activities, and next steps.
  • Follow up with warm leads generated through marketing activity, SEO, and inbound enquiries.
  • Represent the company professionally and communicate its sustainability mission clearly.
  • Collaborate closely with leadership to refine messaging, outreach strategies, and target markets.
  • Provide market feedback to support ongoing sales strategy improvements.
  • Support occasional client engagement activities, webinars, and events.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently achieving or exceeding monthly meeting targets.
  • Creating meaningful conversations with relevant decision-makers.
  • Building a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Becoming a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients.
  • Helping expand the company’s presence across new industries.
  • Experience using HubSpot CRM
  • Demonstrating progression potential into roles such as Business Development Manager, Account Executive, or Sales Lead.

Requirements

About You

You are a confident communicator who enjoys speaking with people and thrives in a target-driven environment.

You will bring:

  • Experience in outbound sales, business development, lead generation, appointment setting, or a similar role.
  • Confidence making high-volume outbound calls and engaging with new prospects.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Resilience, persistence, and a proactive approach to sales.
  • Strong written communication skills for email and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Ability to manage a pipeline and stay organised.
  • Curiosity about sustainability, Net Zero, and helping businesses create positive impact.
  • Ambition to develop your career within a growing organisation.

Benefits

What’s On Offer

  • Competitive commission structure with uncapped earning potential.
  • Clear career progression into senior sales roles.
  • Training and development in sustainability, carbon reduction, and Net Zero solutions.
  • Direct exposure to leadership and the opportunity to influence sales growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative working environment.
  • The opportunity to join a rapidly growing business making a measurable environmental impact.
  • Mid shift (UK Business Hours)
  • Remote work set up

jobs.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
jobs.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a .NET Engineer at Lateral, you will:

  • Design and build scalable, resilient cloud applications on Azure using C#, .NET and SQL, delivering solutions that are secure, high-performance, adhere to our Coding Standards and “just work”.

  • Write clean, clear, and well-tested code, embracing software craftsmanship principles to produce robust, reusable and maintainable systems. You will ensure a high bar for code quality through comprehensive unit tests and attention to detail.

  • Take ownership of features end-to-end, from initial concept through deployment. You’ll often drive substantial product features as the key developer alongside an architect or product designer.

  • Continuously improve the codebase through refactoring and refinement, balancing new feature development with paying down technical debt. You’ll adopt an iterative approach of tweaking and constantly improving the software ￼ to keep the system simple, stable, and adaptable.

  • Champion quality, reliability and scalability by implementing best practices in cloud operations (monitoring, security, CI/CD).

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Build an AI-powered healthcare platform to help detect diseases earlier.

  • Launch a new fintech product from the ground up.

  • Scale a global SaaS commerce system with millions of products

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks

  • You make your first meaningful contribution to the project.

  • You communicate well async as well as in meetings.

In the first 3 months:

  • You understand the system architecture well and can work independently or in teams on medium-sized features.

  • You design before you code (and produce design artifacts).

  • You have shipped code in Production, clean, tested.

  • You communicate clearly, raising issues early and contributing to reviews.

  • You deliver what you commit to.

After 3 months:

  • You take ownership of larger features and improvements from start to finish.

  • You make decisions with both the codebase and business goals in mind.

We measure success through:

  • Evaluating results (what you’ve shipped).

  • Quality and reliability of your code.

  • Consistency in delivery.

  • Feedback from peers and leads.

  • Your ability to work independently and unblock others.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 3+ years experience in software development

  • Deep expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem, including: NET Core, ASP.NET Core and .NET 6 or later

  • Strong proficiency with Entity Framework Coreand MS SQL Server

  • Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming(OOP), Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), SOLIDprinciples.

  • Experience with to cloud-native and distributed systems, ideally including: Azure Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Redis, Azure Storage, Application Insights

  • Proven experience building robust, well-structured APIs

  • A quality mindset: unit tests, integration tests, automation, defensive programming

  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude

  • Ability to Design before you code—express decisions through clear diagrams, validate assumptions early, and think through edge cases and trade-offs.

  • Ability to quickly understand the nature of the business and clearly communicate with stakeholders (clients, colleagues)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A commitment to making a difference, continuous learning, and collaboration

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with Large scale systems or datasets, Performance

  • Clarity in communication and design documentation.

Extra bonus points for:

  • Experience building Infrastructure

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

jobs.description:
About Trimark Associates

Trimark Associates is a leader in SCADA software, metering services, and system integration for the U.S. power industry. We support generation facilities of all sizes—from 1 MW solar sites to multi‑GW nuclear plants—delivering solutions for operational visibility, regulatory compliance (including NERC and CAISO), and reliable system control.

Our in‑house platforms, including T1‑S Vantage and True:SCADA, are built on deep expertise in metering, SCADA, and energy market integration. Clients depend on us to ensure seamless operations, enable fast controls, provide reliable data, and adapt quickly to changing grid demands.

From concept through commissioning, we design and deliver complete systems—covering architecture, software development, hardware integration, deployment, testing, certification, and ongoing support.

Role Overview

Trimark Associates is seeking a Tier II Application Support Engineer to support our mission-critical T1‑S Vantage and True:SCADA platforms. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure, and operations—ensuring system reliability, resolving complex issues, and improving overall platform stability.

You’ll collaborate with development, OT, integration, project management, and customer operations teams to troubleshoot production systems, support data flows and integrations, and drive long-term improvements. This is a technical, hands-on role for mid-level engineers comfortable owning issues from initial triage through root cause identification and resolution. Ideal candidates will have 3–5 years of experience supporting complex, mission-critical systems and working directly in production environments, along with the desire and ability to grow into full-time software development.

What You’ll Do

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in production, mission-critical applications
  • Write SQL queries to analyze data issues, database performance, and data integrity
  • Diagnose and resolve issues across REST APIs, web applications, and backend services
  • Partner with developers to identify root causes, implement fixes, and deploy changes
  • Support and monitor Windows and Linux systems and services
  • Work within a biweekly sprint cycle, contributing to planning and execution
  • Proactively identify recurring issues and implement solutions to improve system reliability and reduce support load
  • Communicate findings and resolutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related field, and/or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience
  • 3–5 years of professional experience in software development, application support, or a similar technical role
  • Experience working in production environments and handling real-world system issues
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer. This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future, including participation in STEM OPT training plans (Form I-983).

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Experience with SQL Server (writing queries, data analysis and troubleshooting; performance tuning and database management are a plus)
  • Understanding of relational database fundamentals (transactions, indexing, ACID, DML/DDL)
  • Experience troubleshooting web applications and RESTful APIs
  • Exposure to Windows Server environments and administration
  • Ability to read and understand C#/.NET code for debugging and issue analysis
  • Working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript for troubleshooting front-end issues
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in complex systems
  • Ability to support time-sensitive, high-availability environments
  • Clear communication skills for working across technical and non-technical teams

We don’t expect candidates to have deep expertise in all areas, but strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are essential.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with PostgreSQL and time-series data (e.g., TimescaleDB)
  • Linux system administration experience
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments
  • Understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
  • Experience with Azure, especially relational database services and monitoring (e.g., Application Insights)
  • Development experience with .NET/C# or other modern languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Java)
  • Familiarity with Git/source control and Agile development practices
  • Understanding of object-oriented design principles
  • Experience with SCADA systems or energy/utilities environments
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols such as Modbus and DNP3

Why This Role

  • Work on high-impact systems that support the electrical grid. You’ll have a direct impact on systems that support real-time utility operations across the U.S.
  • Gain deep exposure to data, infrastructure, APIs, and distributed systems
  • Collaborate directly with experienced developers and domain experts
  • Clear path to move into a software engineering role

Equal Opportunity Statement

Trimark is committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all people involved in Company operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company, including supervisors and coworkers.

E-Verify Statement

Trimark will provide the Social Security Administration, and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. Please note that we do not use this information to pre-screen job applicants.

Work Authorization

This role is Not Eligible for sponsorship by Trimark, including future sponsorship. Candidates must reside in the United States.

Pay Transparency

Compensation is based on market rate, job level, job related knowledge, skills, experience, education, and certifications.

Candidate Safety

Trimark engages in a structured hiring process during which you will meet with multiple team members. We do not issue offers based on email contact and will not ask for your personal or sensitive information prior to an accepted offer. Communications from our talent team will come from the trimarkassoc.com domains.

Unsolicited Candidate Referrals

Trimark values our strategic partnerships with our agency partners who may supplement our internal recruitment team’s efforts from time to time. To submit candidates for consideration, agency partners must have an executed agreement signed by Trimark’s president and a job specific requisition. Without such agreements in place, Trimark will not pay a fee to any agency. Unsolicited referrals from any source other than directly from a candidate will be considered Trimark property and will be considered to have been referred by the agency free of any charge or fee. This includes resumes, partial resumes, candidate profiles, and candidate details or information.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAt Rocket. net, reliability, performance, and customer experience are at the center of everything we build.
jobs.description:
Description

At Rocket.net, reliability, performance, and customer experience are at the center of everything we build. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to help maintain the health, stability, and performance of our hosting platform while providing advanced technical support to our customers.

The Platform Operations team acts as a critical escalation layer between WordPress Support and Engineering. This role combines infrastructure operations, platform monitoring, troubleshooting, and advanced customer support.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will help ensure Rocket.net's servers, services, and customer environments are operating at the highest standards. You will assist WordPress Support Engineers with complex issues, support VIP customers with advanced technical requests, investigate platform-level problems, and work with internal teams to deliver fast and effective solutions.

Responsibilities

Platform Monitoring & Reliability

  • Monitor the health, availability, and performance of Rocket.net servers, services, and customer environments.
  • Proactively identify infrastructure issues, performance degradation, and potential service disruptions.
  • Investigate alerts and operational events to maintain platform stability.
  • Perform regular platform health checks and ensure critical systems are operating correctly.
  • Participate in incident response and coordinate troubleshooting during customer-impacting events.
  • Communicate platform issues, updates, and resolutions to relevant internal teams.

Advanced Technical Support & Escalations

  • Provide advanced technical support for VIP customers and customers with complex hosting-related issues.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for WordPress Support Engineers when issues require deeper technical investigation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving servers, websites, networking, DNS, performance, caching, and hosting infrastructure.
  • Assist customers with advanced technical problems beyond standard WordPress troubleshooting.
  • Investigate and resolve issues involving server resources, application performance, connectivity, and platform behavior.
  • Work directly with customers when required to provide expert-level technical assistance.
  • Ensure escalated customer issues are handled with urgency, ownership, and clear communication.

Infrastructure Operations

  • Troubleshoot and maintain Linux-based production environments.
  • Investigate issues related to NGINX, Apache, PHP-FPM, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and other platform services.
  • Assist with server maintenance, configuration changes, and operational improvements.
  • Support security updates, system hardening, and infrastructure best practices.
  • Monitor resource usage and identify capacity or performance concerns.
  • Help improve monitoring, automation, and operational workflows.

Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with WordPress Support Engineers, Shift Leads, Site Reliability Engineers, and Engineering teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to Support teams.
  • Help create internal documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to reduce future incidents.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting Linux production environments.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical environments.
  • Strong understanding of web hosting technologies including NGINX, Apache, PHP-FPM, MySQL/MariaDB, and Redis.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across WordPress, servers, DNS, networking, and performance issues.
  • Experience with Linux command line (SSH).
  • Strong understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, CDN, and caching technologies.
  • Experience with Cloudflare, WAF, and web performance optimization.
  • Experience with monitoring tools and incident response processes.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently and communicate technical solutions clearly.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English).
  • Ability to work under pressure during customer-impacting incidents.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting managed WordPress hosting platforms.
  • Experience handling VIP customers or enterprise-level support.
  • Experience with high-traffic websites and performance optimization.
  • Knowledge of Bash scripting, yum/dnf , or automation tools.
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Nedata or Datadog or similar.
  • Experience with incident management and postmortems.

Benefits

So what are the advantages of working with a pretty amazing tech company?

  • Ability to work from anywhere in the world. You can travel and work in a new city every month. Work and travel without ever using your vacation time. This is a remote position.
  • Flexible Vacation. Never get denied a vacation request ever again.
  • Paid Education. We care about your career. We will help you gain new skills, and guide you on where you want to go.

Come work with a fun, driven, and amazing team at Rocket.net!

Rocket.net is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of our diverse team.

Rocket.net is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs. Accommodation may be provided in all parts of the hiring process.

We would like to thank each applicant; however, only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C++/C#)
jobs.excerpt: About NutrientAt Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents.
jobs.description:
About Nutrient

At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical.

Your Role at Nutrient...

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who likes making things work and keeping them working. You’ll join the Native team, which builds the core document technology behind our .NET SDK, Java SDK and Python SDK. The same code powers Web SDK, Document Engine, AI Document Processor and Document Web Services, so when something breaks in it, every product and customer feels it.

Your focus is keeping a large, mature C# and C++ codebase reliable. You’ll take customer-reported issues and regressions, find the root cause, and ship a fix quickly without breaking anything else. You’ll often work in code you didn’t write, so you learn it on your own and leave it cleaner than you found it.

We’re an AI-first company: we use coding agents like Claude Code or Codex every day, and we expect you to as well.

What You'll Work On...

  • Investigate customer-reported bugs and regressions down to the root cause, capture each one in a failing test, and ship fixes that hold
  • Maintain a large C# and C++ codebase across Windows, Linux and macOS, keeping builds, tests and releases green
  • Turn recurring problems into tests, tooling or small refactors so they don’t come back
  • Work with Support and other teams to reproduce hard issues and unblock customers fast
  • Review teammates’ changes with an eye for correctness and side effects

What You'll Bring...

  • You've solved hard problems in production C# or C++, including memory, threading and performance issues
  • You're an AI-native engineer: coding agents like Claude Code or Codex are the major part of how you work, and you drive them, not the other way around
  • Rigor and a test-driven approach: you write a failing test that reproduces the bug before you fix it, and check for side effects
  • Strong problem solving in unfamiliar code, and the ability to learn a new area quickly on your own
  • Speed of execution: you close issues fast and keep several moving at once without losing track
  • Clear written communication in an async team, with customers and during incidents: precise bug analyses, pull request descriptions and status updates customers can trust
  • Bonus: experience with document formats (PDF, TIFF, Office), imaging, OCR. Data Extraction

Who Thrives Here...

At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills. We’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

  • Collaborators: You work openly, listen actively, and put team success first.
  • Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels your progress and career growth.
  • Curious Thinkers: You dig into the ‘why,’ valuing understanding over simply being right.
  • Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities.
  • Owners: You take responsibility for outcomes and always look for ways to improve what's in your control.
  • Doers: You're energized by progress and motivated to create meaningful impact.

Why You'll Love Working Here...

At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

  • Fully remote and async-first: minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
  • Mission-critical product: Nutrient’s platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries.
  • Strong growth trajectory: having more than doubled revenue over the past three years, backed by Insight Partners.

Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non-merit factor.

The role focuses on building a customer-centric culture, improving service quality, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring consistent, seamless, and positive experiences across all insurance and investment products and services.

The CXO will lead customer experience (CX), service delivery, customer engagement, and experience transformation initiatives. The position will work closely with business, operations, technology, sales, marketing, claims, underwriting, and investment teams to improve satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy

  • Develop and implement an enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with the organization's business objectives.
  • Establish a customer-first culture across insurance, investment, and financial service operations.
  • Define customer experience standards, service principles, and performance benchmarks.
  • Identify opportunities to differentiate the organization through superior customer service and engagement.

Customer Journey Management

  • Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys across product discovery, onboarding, policy issuance, premium payments, claims, renewals, investment services, and account management.
  • Identify service gaps, customer pain points, and process inefficiencies.
  • Simplify customer interactions and reduce friction across digital and traditional service channels.
  • Ensure consistent experiences across branches, call centres, websites, mobile applications, and relationship management teams.

Customer Satisfaction and Retention

  • Develop initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Monitor customer feedback, complaints, service requests, and customer sentiment.
  • Establish customer feedback mechanisms, including surveys, NPS, CSAT, and customer interviews.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce customer attrition and improve policy renewal and investment account retention rates.

Digital Experience and Innovation

  • Collaborate with technology and digital teams to improve online platforms, mobile applications, customer portals, and self-service solutions.
  • Drive digital adoption and improve accessibility of insurance and investment services.
  • Leverage customer analytics, automation, AI, and CRM platforms to personalize customer interactions.
  • Champion innovative solutions that improve customer convenience and operational efficiency.

Customer Service and Relationship Management

  • Oversee customer service standards and service excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, complaints, claims-related concerns, and investment service requests.
  • Strengthen relationship management practices for individual, corporate, institutional, and high-net-worth clients.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and escalation procedures across customer-facing departments.

Employee Experience and Organizational Culture

  • Develop initiatives that improve employee engagement and internal service culture.
  • Promote collaboration between departments to deliver consistent customer experiences.
  • Support employee training and development in customer service, communication, relationship management, and service excellence.
  • Align employee experience initiatives with customer experience objectives.

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure customer experience practices comply with applicable insurance, investment, consumer protection, data privacy, and financial services regulations.
  • Work with compliance and risk teams to address customer-related regulatory concerns.
  • Promote transparent communication, fair treatment, responsible product information, and ethical customer engagement.
  • Establish processes for monitoring and resolving customer complaints and service-related risks.

Leadership and Performance Management

  • Lead and develop customer experience, customer service, and service transformation teams.
  • Establish departmental objectives, budgets, KPIs, and performance management frameworks.
  • Present customer experience performance reports and strategic recommendations to the CEO and Board.
  • Collaborate with senior executives to integrate customer experience priorities into business strategy.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Management, Customer Experience, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in customer experience, customer service, operations, client relationship management, or business transformation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, financial services, or other regulated service industries.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and implementing customer experience strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of customer journey mapping, CRM platforms, customer analytics, NPS, CSAT, and service quality management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and large-scale service improvement initiatives.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).

- Net Promoter Score (NPS).

  • Customer retention and policy renewal rates.
  • Customer attrition and churn reduction.
  • Customer complaint resolution time and satisfaction.

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.

  • Digital channel adoption and self-service utilization.
  • Customer onboarding and service turnaround time.
  • Customer lifetime value and relationship growth.
  • Employee engagement and service culture improvement.
  • Compliance with customer service standards and regulatory requirements.

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

At Neo4j, our Solution Engineers are pivotal to our company’s success. As a member of our regional go-to-market team, you will partner with our sales executives, working closely with clients to showcase how the Neo4j Graph Intelligence Platform addresses their critical business needs. Neo4j Solution Engineers play a central, hands-on role as clients consider and evaluate Neo4j technology, and support customers in an advisory capacity throughout their journey to value realization.
