Overview

LMI is seeking a Lead Full Stack Developer to lead the design, development, integration, and sustainment of a secure, web-based mission data and digital asset management application supporting a SOCOM Mission Partner. The application enables authorized users to ingest, organize, discover, preview, share, and reuse mission-relevant files, datasets, software, models, and technical knowledge. It combines a modern user experience with scalable backend services, governed data access, project-based collaboration, and integration with a secure cloud-hosted delivery environment.

This is a hands-on engineering lead position. The selected candidate will contribute production code, guide technical design, perform code reviews, mentor developers, and coordinate directly with product, platform, security, and mission stakeholders. The ideal candidate has demonstrated success building full-stack applications that handle large files and complex data, enforce user permissions, and deliver dependable performance in secure government environments.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This position is remote within the United States and requires an active Secret security clearance. Periodic travel to mission partner locations, including the Fort Bragg area, may be required for technical planning, user engagements, and integration activities. Classified work must be performed in approved facilities.

Responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on development of a secure, user-facing application for the ingestion, management, discovery, sharing, and reuse of large mission datasets and digital assets.
  • Design, build, review, test, and maintain full-stack features across responsive web interfaces, backend services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data stores, and cloud integrations.
  • Guide implementation of project-based organization, asset metadata, user profiles, file and dataset versioning, activity history, and collaboration capabilities such as comments, saved items, and feedback.
  • Engineer scalable file upload, ingestion, transfer, processing, and download workflows that reliably accommodate large volumes of images, video, documents, technical files, and structured or unstructured data.
  • Implement and optimize search, filtering, content previews, indexing, and data discovery workflows that help users identify relevant assets without unnecessary downloads.
  • Develop secure API contracts and integrations with object storage, metadata catalogs, search services, identity providers, mission applications, and other approved enterprise systems.
  • Apply authentication, authorization, role- or attribute-based access controls, audit logging, data handling rules, and secure file access throughout the application.
  • Coordinate with data engineering, platform, and cybersecurity teams to preserve data provenance, metadata, version history, security markings, and authorized handling of sensitive content.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, scalability, and observability; diagnose issues involving databases, backend services, object storage, web interfaces, networks, and deployment environments.
  • Work with product managers and UI/UX designers to translate user requirements into technical designs, refined backlog items, acceptance criteria, and production-quality releases.
  • Lead technical planning, software architecture decisions, code reviews, automated testing, integration testing, defect resolution, and release readiness for assigned development work.
  • Implement secure development practices and integrate application delivery with approved source control, continuous integration and continuous delivery, containerization, and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Mentor and guide developers, establish practical coding standards, manage technical dependencies, and maintain maintainable, well-documented application components.
  • Engage operational users and government stakeholders during demonstrations, feedback sessions, and testing; convert findings into improvements to application functionality and usability.
  • Maintain architecture diagrams, API specifications, data models, development guidance, deployment documentation, and technical decisions that support sustainment and future integration.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret security clearance, with the ability to maintain the clearance throughout employment.
  • Minimum of seven years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on work across both front-end and back-end application development.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a technical lead, senior developer, or principal contributor responsible for technical design, code reviews, mentoring, and delivery of production software.
  • Proficiency with a modern JavaScript or TypeScript front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue, including component design, state management, API integration, and responsive application interfaces.
  • Strong back-end development experience using Python, Node.js, Java, C#, or a comparable server-side language and framework, including design and implementation of production REST APIs and service integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and working with relational or nonrelational databases, data models, query optimization, and application data-access patterns.
  • Experience building applications that ingest, store, retrieve, transfer, or process files and datasets, including performance considerations for large objects, background processing, and error recovery.
  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, or supporting web applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS), including integration with storage, compute, identity, logging, or networking services.
  • Experience implementing application authentication, authorization, secure API design, input validation, secrets handling, and auditability in environments with sensitive or access-controlled data.
  • Working experience with Git-based source control, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery, containers, and Agile software delivery practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot production issues across front-end code, backend services, data stores, cloud services, and application interfaces.
  • Strong technical communication, engineering judgment, documentation, and collaboration skills, including the ability to lead work across product, platform, cybersecurity, and customer teams.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Prior experience developing or sustaining applications for SOCOM, Special Operations Forces, or another Department of War mission partner.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, Kubernetes or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, infrastructure as code, and delivery in DoD-authorized environments.
  • Experience building data repositories, asset libraries, content management platforms, collaborative knowledge systems, or large-scale data ingestion and search applications.
  • Experience with Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), managed databases, search or indexing technologies, event-driven processing, messaging, and asynchronous job orchestration.
  • Experience developing video and image previews, content metadata pipelines, geospatial or technical-file viewers, or natural-language search capabilities.
  • Familiarity with DoD Information Network (DODIN) requirements, Risk Management Framework processes, secure application delivery, and authorization constraints at DoD Impact Level 4 or higher.
  • Experience designing interoperable solutions using open APIs, reusable components, documented data contracts, and modular software architectures.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related technical discipline.

Target salary range is $122209.58 - $211317.81

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager -  BillAI
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary RethinkFirst is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Associate Product Manager to support the continued development and enhancement of BillAI, our revenue cycle management (RCM) platform.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

RethinkFirst is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Associate Product Manager to support the continued development and enhancement of BillAI, our revenue cycle management (RCM) platform.

This position will work closely with the Senior Product Manager, engineering, QA, customer support, billing operations, and other internal stakeholders to manage product requirements, coordinate development activities, and support successful feature releases.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with technical and non-technical teams, and interested in developing a career in product management.

This role will focus on product execution, operational support, and assisting the Senior Product Manager with strategic initiatives, roadmap planning, and complex product decisions. As the individual develops product knowledge and experience, they will take increasing ownership of assigned features and enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Requirements & Documentation

  • Assist the Senior Product Manager in gathering, documenting, and refining product requirements.

  • Create and maintain user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements for development.

  • Work with stakeholders to clarify business needs, identify workflow challenges, and define expected functionality.

  • Maintain accurate product documentation, workflows, and feature specifications.

  • Ensure development tickets contain sufficient information for engineering and QA teams.

2. Product Backlog & Sprint Support

  • Assist with maintaining, organizing, and refining the product backlog.

  • Prepare user stories and requirements for sprint planning and backlog refinement sessions.

  • Track the progress of assigned development initiatives and identify potential blockers.

  • Coordinate with engineering and QA to clarify requirements throughout development.

  • Verify that completed work aligns with documented requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Support the Senior Product Manager in monitoring sprint commitments and release timelines.

3. Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders submitting product enhancement requests or reporting workflow gaps.

  • Gather additional information needed to evaluate requests and understand business impact.

  • Track stakeholder requests and provide regular updates on their status.

  • Coordinate meetings to review requirements, proposed solutions, and completed functionality.

  • Document meeting outcomes, action items, and follow-up activities.

  • Maintain visibility into product initiatives, customer-impacting issues, and development progress.

4. Product Testing & Release Support

  • Participate in reviewing completed functionality before release.

  • Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) to verify that features meet business requirements.

  • Coordinate and conduct product demonstrations with internal stakeholders.

  • Prepare release notes and assist with communicating upcoming product changes.

  • Support post-release follow-up to identify issues or opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with QA and engineering to ensure reported defects are clearly documented and reproducible.

5. Customer Support & Product Operations

  • Partner with customer support and billing operations to understand recurring customer challenges.

  • Investigate reported product issues and help determine whether they are defects, training opportunities, or enhancement requests.

  • Document common product workflows and frequently asked questions.

  • Assist in creating internal training materials and product demonstrations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows, reduce manual processes, and enhance the user experience.

6. Product Ownership & Continuous Improvement

  • Take ownership of assigned product enhancements, including requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, development coordination, and release validation, with guidance from the Senior Product Manager.

  • Develop an understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, including claims processing, payment posting, denials, and reporting.

  • Become familiar with healthcare EDI transactions, including 837 claims, 835 remittances, and claim acknowledgments.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the BillAI platform's functionality, configurations, and integration workflows.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product processes, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

  • Gradually assume responsibility for independently managing smaller product features and enhancements.

  • Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to evaluate potential solutions and recommend improvements based on customer needs and business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software implementation, project coordination, or a related role.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies.

  • Experience using product management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with healthcare software or SaaS platforms.

  • Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle management workflows.

  • Basic understanding of medical claims, insurance payments, denials, and adjustments.

  • Exposure to healthcare EDI transactions, including 837, 835, 999, and 277.

  • Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience supporting software testing or user acceptance testing.

  • Familiarity with behavioral health or ABA billing is a plus.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the individual's ability to:

  • Maintain well-documented, organized, and actionable product requirements.

  • Improve the readiness of development tickets before sprint planning.

  • Ensure stakeholder requests are tracked, evaluated, and communicated effectively.

  • Support timely completion of product demonstrations and release activities.

  • Reduce the administrative and coordination workload of the Senior Product Manager.

  • Demonstrate increasing ownership of assigned product enhancements from requirements through release.

  • Develop sufficient product knowledge to independently manage smaller features and enhancements.

  • Build effective working relationships with engineering, QA, customer support, and billing operations.

  • Contribute to improvements in product workflows, stakeholder communication, and overall team efficiency.

jobs.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. A Day in the Life

Medtronic

At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.


Our Purpose


As IT PMO Lead within GO&SC IT – Manufacturing Digital Transformation, you will lead with purpose, driving portfolio governance and delivery excellence for strategic technology programs that make a meaningful impact.


Partnering with the Senior Director for Manufacturing Digital Transformation, you will provide end-to-end visibility and control across programs, enabling leaders to make confident decisions that support our mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.


You will drive financial discipline, proactive risk management, and delivery predictability through standardized governance and continuous improvement.


Come for a job, stay for a career!


A Day in The Life Of:

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned;


As the IT PMO Lead, you will connect strategy to execution, ensuring the Manufacturing Digital Transformation portfolio aligns with business priorities and that strategic commitments are delivered predictably.


You will maintain comprehensive visibility of portfolio health, milestones, budgets, dependencies, and deliverables, identify performance gaps early, and drive corrective actions, providing leadership with clear insights to support informed decisions and timely action.


Working with senior leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Delivery Leaders, and external service providers, you will strengthen governance, coach project teams, and embed delivery best practices across global teams.

Key Responsibilities


  • Portfolio Governance & Delivery Excellence: Establish and enforce consistent project management standards, governance frameworks, delivery methodologies, and performance controls to drive accountability and predictable execution.
  • Strategic Portfolio & Program Oversight: Maintain comprehensive visibility of portfolio health, milestones, budgets, dependencies, and deliverables. Identify performance gaps early and drive corrective actions to protect strategic commitments.
  • Resource & Capacity Optimization: Lead portfolio-wide resource and capacity planning, balancing demand, priorities, and available capabilities to eliminate bottlenecks and maximize delivery efficiency.
  • Financial Performance & Risk Management: Drive financial discipline through budget oversight, forecasting, accrual management, and variance analysis. Maintain proactive risk, issue, action, and dependency (RAID) management with clear mitigation plans and ownership.
  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement & Team Leadership: Partner with senior leadership, Enterprise Architecture, and Delivery Leaders to align priorities, strengthen governance, coach project teams, and embed delivery best practices.
  • Escalation & Issue Resolution: Own the structured, tiered escalation framework, ensuring critical issues are rapidly identified, escalated, assigned, and resolved with clear accountability and timely leadership intervention.
  • Executive Reporting & Performance Insights: Own the development and delivery of high-impact daily, weekly, and monthly portfolio dashboards, executive reports, and steering committee presentations, translating complex delivery data into actionable insights and decisions.

Key Skills & Experience


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8 to 10+ years of IT project, program, or portfolio management experience.
  • 3 to 5+ years in PMO leadership, portfolio governance, or enterprise program oversight.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-project IT portfolios across global teams.
  • Strong financial management, resource planning, and executive reporting experience.
  • Experience working with senior IT leaders, technology delivery teams, and external service providers.

Technical Skills & Required Capabilities (Essential):

  • Portfolio & Program Management: Manage complex IT portfolios, integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and KPIs.
  • Project Management Tools: Advanced proficiency in MS Project, Planisware, Jira, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft 365.
  • Financial Management: Budgeting, forecasting, accruals, variance analysis, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and financial reporting.
  • Executive Reporting & Analytics: Advanced Excel, Power BI, dashboards, portfolio scorecards, and executive presentations.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Demand forecasting, resource allocation, capacity modelling, and utilization management.
  • Risk & Issue Management: RAID management, risk scoring, mitigation planning, dependency tracking, and escalation management.
  • Governance & Compliance: Stage gates, project controls, change management, audit readiness, and portfolio governance.

Methodologies, Skills & Frameworks (Essential):

  • PMI / PMBOK: Structured project management, governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control.
  • Waterfall & Agile: Manage traditional and iterative delivery approaches across diverse IT programs.
  • Hybrid Project Management: Integrate Agile and Waterfall practices across enterprise technology programs.
  • Portfolio Management (PfMP Principles): Prioritization, strategic alignment, capacity planning, and portfolio optimization.
  • RAID Framework: Structured management of risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
  • RACI Framework: Establish clear roles, responsibilities, decision rights, and accountability.
  • Stage-Gate Governance: Apply standardized approval checkpoints, deliverable reviews, and investment controls.
  • Critical Path Method (CPM): Identify schedule dependencies, critical activities, and delivery risks.
  • SAFe / Scrum / Kanban: Understand Agile delivery, planning cadences, backlogs, and cross-team coordination.
  • Organizational Change Management: Support stakeholder readiness, communications, adoption, and business transition.

Soft Skills & Leadership (Essential):

  • Executive Communication: Deliver concise, fact-based updates and translate complex information into actionable leadership decisions.
  • Leadership & Influence: Drive accountability, coach project managers, and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipate delivery challenges, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions before milestones are impacted.
  • Situational Awareness: Maintain a comprehensive understanding of portfolio health, emerging risks, competing priorities, and critical dependencies.
  • Decision-Making & Judgment: Make timely, data-driven recommendations and confidently escalate issues requiring leadership intervention.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior executives, business leaders, technology teams, and external partners.
  • Accountability & Ownership: Demonstrate urgency, follow-through, attention to detail, and personal ownership of commitments.
  • Strategic Thinking: Connect project execution to business priorities, portfolio value, and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Conflict Resolution & Negotiation: Resolve competing priorities, resource constraints, delivery disputes, and stakeholder disagreements.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Operate effectively in complex, fast-changing environments while maintaining delivery discipline.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience within manufacturing, medical devices, or another regulated industry.
  • Manufacturing IT Knowledge: Understanding of MES, ERP, OT/IT integration, manufacturing applications, and digital transformation.
  • Vendor & Contract Management: Vendor performance, SOW management, deliverable tracking, commercial governance, and SLA oversight.
  • AI & Automation: Using AI and automation to improve reporting, identify delivery risks, and generate portfolio insights.
  • Earned Value Management (EVM): Assess cost and schedule performance using quantitative measures.
  • ITIL: Understand service transition, change enablement, incident management, and operational readiness.
  • Lean Six Sigma: Drive continuous improvement, waste reduction, and process optimization.

Physical & Travel Requirements

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As an AI Engineer, you will build and ship production-ready AI agents and features for the Brilliant Harvest platform. Working closely with the Lead AI Engineer and the broader AI team, you'll own well-scoped features end to end. Your work will center on agents that plan, make decisions, and take action, backed by the RAG pipelines, document ingestion, and models that power them.

This role is ideal for an engineer with a few years of experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves solving complex problems. You'll take ideas from concept to deployment in a domain where AI is transforming a legacy industry. Along the way, you'll get hands-on mentorship and room to grow into larger, more ambiguous problems.

Key Responsibilities

    Agents

  • Design, build, and ship production AI agents that plan, use tools, and complete multi-step tasks across the Brilliant Harvest platform.

  • Implement agent orchestration, memory, and tool integrations (e.g., MCP servers), with guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-stakes actions.

  • Evaluate agents end to end, measuring task success, tool-call accuracy, cost, and latency, not just final answers.

    • Build & Ship

  • Design, develop, test, document, and maintain production features for our AI platform, including the RAG pipelines and LLM integrations our agents rely on.

  • Build and improve components of our document ingestion pipelines (parsing, chunking, enrichment, and indexing), ensuring accuracy and compliance with manufacturer standards.

  • Investigate agent and answer-quality issues, tracing them back through tool calls, retrieval, and ingestion to find the root cause.

  • Help build and maintain evaluation datasets and automated checks, including LLM-as-judge, so regressions are caught before customers see them.

  • Prototype with new LLMs, agent frameworks, and tooling, and share findings that inform model and vendor decisions.

    • Engineering Practices

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions, design reviews, and code reviews, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.

  • Write clean, well-tested code, follow the team's coding standards and CI/CD practices, and suggest improvements where you see gaps.

  • Use AI-first development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar agentic tools) to work faster, while critically reviewing everything the AI generates.

  • Help analyze requirements for your features, break them into well-defined tasks, and provide reliable effort estimates for your own work.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Product, Data, Design, and QA teams to deliver features aligned with business objectives and the product roadmap.

  • Provide input on the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs for AI features, and help integrate them with backend systems.

  • Communicate progress, blockers, and technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical teammates.

    • Learning & Knowledge Sharing

  • Grow through hands-on mentorship from the Lead AI Engineer, taking on larger and more ambiguous problems as you're ready.

  • Share what you learn through code reviews, pairing, documentation, and demos, and help junior engineers get up to speed.

  • Embrace a "Systems Thinking" mindset, moving from writing every line by hand to orchestrating and critically reviewing AI-generated solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering or data science experience, including at least 1 year building AI/ML or LLM-powered applications.

  • Practical experience building LLM agents, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and agent frameworks or protocols such as MCP.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI and LLMs, such as RAG, embeddings and vector search, or document ingestion, ideally with at least one feature in production.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, plus working experience with at least one of: TypeScript, C# (.NET), or another modern backend language.

  • Working knowledge of API design, microservices, and cloud infrastructure.

  • A collaborative approach: you communicate clearly, raise blockers early, and give and receive feedback constructively.

  • Familiarity with React, React Native, or other modern frontend frameworks, and how they integrate with AI-powered backends, is an asset.

  • Experience with prompt engineering best practices and AI-first development tooling (e.g., Claude Code or similar) is a strong asset.

  • Exposure to evaluation methods for LLM applications and agents, such as test sets, LLM-as-judge, or human review, is an asset.

  • Experience working in a startup environment is an asset.

  • Familiarity with the agriculture, heavy equipment, or dealership domain is a strong asset.

What Will Set You Apart?

  • You've built an agent that does real work, not just a demo. You know agents usually fail because of vague tools, missing context, or no way to recover, and you design for that.

  • You're comfortable when the roadmap moves under your feet. You turn loosely defined problems into working software quickly, and you're building the judgment to know which shortcuts will cost you later.

  • You've shipped something real with LLMs, at work or in a serious side project. You've seen what changes once real users, messy data, and latency or cost limits show up.

  • You know RAG quality starts with retrieval. When an answer is wrong, your first move is to check whether the right document surfaced, not to rewrite the prompt.

  • You treat evals as part of the job, not an afterthought. You've written test cases or LLM-as-judge checks, and you'd rather catch a regression in CI than from a customer.

  • You've experimented with decision models like TypeSafe's Jev, which return typed choices and scores with probabilities instead of text. You know when a fast, cheap decision call beats an LLM, such as classifying a document or choosing an agent's next step.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-performing team led by Remi Schmaltz, an entrepreneur with decades of experience launching and growing agriculture businesses.

  • Remote-first role with a flexible work environment.

  • A front-row seat to how AI is changing the way equipment dealers, farmers, and contractors work.

  • A collaborative culture that values growth, learning, and impact.

  • Competitive compensation, ESOP, and benefits.

About DNAstack

At DNAstack, our mission is to power precision medicine by building software that breaks down barriers to responsible biomedical data sharing, discovery, and analysis. We build cutting-edge software and industry standards to help researchers and clinicians analyze sequencing data and make faster, more accurate diagnoses. Our platform supports national and international networks tackling rare disease, cancer, infectious disease, and more.

We’re a nimble, cross-functional team of scientists, engineers, designers, and product thinkers working at the intersection of genomics, software, and cloud technologies. Our mission is ambitious, and so is our team.

The Role

The Platform Engineering Lead sets the direction for the team behind the infrastructure our engineers and customers depend on: GCP and AWS environments, Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm, CI/CD, security and the tooling around them.

This is a player-coach role. You lead the team and stay hands-on: you review code, shape architecture and step in on implementation where it matters. You will own four things: the growth of the people on the team, the team's priorities, the platform roadmap (planned with Product), and the platform's technical direction.

What We Look For in a Lead

  • Direction first. Clear, ranked priorities, and a reasoned "not yet" or "no".
  • Shared ownership. Knowledge, on-call and decisions belong to the whole team, and we learn in the open.
  • Technical credibility. You can read a Terraform plan, review a pull request and challenge an architecture proposal, and your feedback makes people better.
  • Honest trade-offs. You make the cost and risk of every choice visible to the team, to Product and to leadership, including the case for more investment when the work calls for it.

What You’ll Do

Lead the team

  • Manage and grow the team through 1:1s, career conversations, growth plans, performance reviews and hiring.
  • Own the team's rituals, including planning, retrospectives and incident reviews.
  • Build shared ownership with primary and secondary owners, pairing, shared on-call and written decisions.
  • Coach senior engineers and build a culture of individual empowerment, accountability, and collaboration.

Set priorities and the roadmap

  • Keep one ranked list of priorities that everyone can see. Triage requests from Product, Program Management and customers against it, and decide what the team defers or stops.
  • Plan the platform roadmap with Product, so reliability, security, tooling and customer environments are planned alongside product features.
  • Report progress, risks and spend to the VP of Product Development and the leadership team.

Set technical direction

  • Set the direction of the platform and decide how technical decisions are made, documented and revisited.
  • Guide architecture and stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews and implementation.
  • Settle technical trade-offs across teams and review major changes, including new customer deployments, for cost and risk.

Make every engineer faster

  • Define how we measure delivery, including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore and build and test durations, and act on what the numbers show.
  • Set direction for the path from commit to production: fast, reliable CI, preview environments with representative genomic test data, and safe, routine deployments with progressive rollouts and automated rollback.
  • Use AI and deterministic automation to give a small team leverage, with guardrails for agent access and KPIs that track time saved. Own the platform for AI-assisted development: tooling, access, licensing and budget.

Own cost, reliability and security

  • Own the infrastructure budget across GCP, AWS and related tooling: forecast, track against plan and explain variances. Build cost visibility per environment, customer and product.
  • Set cost targets and manage vendor and licensing relationships, with renewals planned well ahead.
  • Own platform reliability: service level objectives for customer-facing environments, a clear rotation for on-call, deployments, alerts and support requests, incident response and blameless reviews.
  • Partner with our Chief Information Officer and Chief Privacy and Security Officer on SOC 2 controls tracked in Drata. You own the technical side: access, secrets, CI and audit evidence.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in DevOps, site reliability or platform engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers.
  • Experience setting technical direction and priorities for a platform or infrastructure team, and managing senior engineers.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and a CI system on GCP or AWS, and the hands-on skill to review and contribute to that work.
  • Direct accountability for a cloud budget, with examples of cost reductions you delivered and how you measured them.
  • Experience improving developer productivity, with the metrics to show it.
  • A track record of automating repetitive operational work to give a small team leverage.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or a comparable control framework, and comfort working with health or genomic data where access rules are strict and audited.
  • Strong communication, including explaining technical trade-offs and costs to non-technical leaders, and ease working across global time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Concourse CI experience. Our tooling is largely custom, so this is a head start, not a requirement.
  • Experience running many environments from one platform.
  • Experience using AI and automation to multiply output, including guardrails for agent access.
  • Experience building cost allocation or showback models, or internal developer platforms.
  • Familiarity with Java services built on Spring Boot, GA4GH standards or WDL workflow engines.

Why This Role Is Exciting

  • Impact at scale: Your work will directly influence tools used by national and international genomics networks.
  • Build something new: Shape a core function of the company from a small, senior team into a scalable, sustainable group.
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Work side by side with engineers, product managers, and scientists to turn bioinformatics into real-world solutions.
  • Mission-driven: Contribute to solving rare disease, cancer, and infectious disease challenges by enabling precision medicine.
  • Team culture: Enjoy a flexible, remote-friendly team culture along with a competitive salary, benefits, and employee stock option program.

Where You'll Work

This role offers the flexibility of remote work, with the option to work in person from our Toronto office. This arrangement supports your needs and promotes a healthy work–life balance.

Eligibility

To be considered for this position, you must be eligible to work in Canada.

  • Comprehensive health benefits: medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your dependents

jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Exerp provides software that powers the day-to-day operations of leading fitness businesses worldwide. Our Cloud team builds and runs the platform those solutions sit on.

As a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer, you’ll help make that platform reliable, secure, observable and easy for product teams to use. You’ll work across a large AWS estate (hundreds of accounts, multiple workloads, eight regions), building durable platform capabilities and well-supported ways of working. The goal is to let engineering teams deliver and run services safely without needing to become cloud infrastructure specialists.

You’ll report to the Head of Cloud Engineering, you'll be responsible for :

Build and evolve the platform

  • Design, build and run shared AWS and Kubernetes capabilities that support Exerp workloads globally
  • Create reusable, opinionated platform patterns for account foundations, networking, identity, compute, storage, deployment and observability
  • Use Terraform, Helm, Argo CD and related automation to make infrastructure and application delivery repeatable, reviewable and recoverable
  • Improve our internal developer platform and service catalogue (including Port) so teams can find, provision and run what they need through clear self-service paths
  • Assess new technologies pragmatically, weighing customer value, operational risk, security, cost and long-term maintainability

Improve reliability and operational maturity

  • Define and improve SLOs, operational readiness, resilience, disaster recovery and capacity planning for platform services
  • Build meaningful observability with Grafana Cloud, Elastic Cloud and AWS-native tooling, using well-designed logs, metrics, traces and alerts
  • Take part in incident response and problem management, helping teams restore service quickly and turning lessons into lasting improvements
  • Reduce toil by automating repetitive manual work and designing out recurring failure modes
  • Support safe change across a global estate through sound upgrade, migration, maintenance and rollback practices

Enable product and engineering teams

  • Work with developers, solution architects, security and operations colleagues to understand their needs and deliver practical platform solutions
  • Create clear paved roads for deploying, configuring, monitoring and changing hosted environments, with flexibility where workloads need it
  • Improve documentation, examples, templates and support processes so teams can solve common problems themselves
  • Coach colleagues on design decisions, troubleshooting and operational practice, and share knowledge to lift capability across engineering

Protect the business and its customers

  • Apply AWS Well-Architected principles and security best practice across identity, access, networking, data protection, resilience and operational control
  • Help maintain strong multi-account governance, including permission boundaries, SSO and OIDC integrations, policy controls and auditability
  • Contribute to cost management through better visibility, tagging, resource efficiency and cost-aware platform decisions
  • Treat customer impact, data privacy and security as first-class considerations in design and day-to-day operations

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

The platform is a force multiplier for Exerp. Every improvement to reliability, delivery flow, security, observability, or developer experience helps product teams move faster and helps protect the businesses that rely on our software. This role has a direct opportunity to shape how cloud engineering is practised across a global product organisation.

Required qualifications for this role:

  • Significant experience designing, building and running production platforms or distributed systems on AWS
  • Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, ideally Amazon EKS, covering cluster lifecycle, scheduling, networking, storage, security and workload operations
  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience, especially designing maintainable Terraform projects, modules and shared patterns at scale
  • Experience with GitOps and continuous delivery, ideally with Argo CD and Helm

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with Grafana Cloud, Elastic Cloud or similar platforms
  • Familiarity with Java-based production systems (Exerp Core is mainly written in Java, but deep Java development experience isn’t needed)

How you work

  • You own outcomes, follow problems through and speak up early when priorities, risks or dependencies change
  • You enjoy troubleshooting complex systems and keep making progress when the answer isn’t obvious
  • You favour simple, automated, well-documented solutions over heroics and repeated manual fixes
  • You’re collaborative and service-minded, but can set sensible boundaries and help teams become self-sufficient
  • You share knowledge through design discussions, reviews, documentation, mentoring and constructive challenge
  • You work well independently in a global organisation and communicate confidently in written and spoken English
  • A solid understanding of AWS multi-account environments, IAM, identity federation, OIDC, networking, DNS, VPNs, firewalls and common AWS security controls
  • Experience designing observability that helps engineers understand system health and troubleshoot customer-impacting issues
  • Scripting and automation skills in shell and/or Python
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives from discovery through to implementation, adoption and operational ownership
  • A clear understanding of reliability, security, data privacy, change management and the trade-offs of running globally distributed systems

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

Xplor is dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. We encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Who are we?

Put simply, our mission is to be the solutions and the team behind the best experiences for the world’s leading brands. Wherever and whenever needed.

With 170,000 people working across the globe, Foundever™ securely connects brands with their customers 9 million times a day in 60+ languages. Our global footprint makes us one of the few true global players in the BPO industry.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineerto support the development, optimisation, and ongoing evolution of Foundever’s data platform. This role will play a critical part in building and maintaining a scalable Data Lake and Data Warehouse architecture on Databricks, enabling high-quality operational and business reporting across the organisation.

Working closely with global stakeholders, the Data Engineer will lead data migration and consolidation efforts from existing host systems, ensuring data is reliable, secure, and fit for analytics and reporting use cases.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys building robust data pipelines, solving complex data challenges, and working collaboratively across technical and business teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Lead the migration of data from existing host systems into a modern Data Lake and Data Warehouse architecture on Databricks/Azure.

  • Design, build, and optimise scalable, efficient data pipelines and workflows to support operational and business reporting.

  • Consolidate data from multiple internal and external sources into a unified, trusted data repository.

Databricks Development

  • Develop, maintain, and optimise Databricks workflows, ensuring reliable, timely, and high-performance data delivery.

  • Implement best practices in data engineering, including performance optimisation, monitoring, and cost efficiency.

Data Modelling & Reporting Enablement

  • Design and implement robust data models to support downstream analytics, BI tools, and reporting requirements.

  • Support the migration of existing reporting infrastructure from on prem to Azure, ensuring continuity and data integrity.

  • Support the BI report setup using tableau or powerbi

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Ensure high standards of data quality, accuracy, and consistency throughout the data lifecycle.

  • Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues.

  • Ensure all solutions adhere to data governance, security, and privacy best practices.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists, analytics teams, IT, and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with US and UK-based client teams to deliver data solutions aligned to business and reporting needs.

Documentation & Delivery

  • Create and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation covering pipelines, workflows, and data models.

  • Contribute to agile delivery processes, including version control, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Your profile & experience:

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Data Engineer, ideally in cloud-based environments such as Databricks, AWS, or Azure.

  • Strong experience designing and building ETL pipelines for large, complex datasets.

  • Solid understanding of data lake and data warehouse architectures and data modelling techniques.

  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.

  • Advanced knowledge of python programming language

  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems and sources to create a unified data model.

  • Experience working with BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Experience working in agile development environments and using version control tools (e.g. Git).

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Desirable: Experience designing and automating ETL workflows, including the use of tools such as Alteryx.

If this really interests you and you are attracted to pushing yourself to a rewarding career, then please apply now and our Recruitment Team will be more than happy to speak with you.
